abstract: The author organized the project activity of computer modeling in teaching physics of IT students. The students' teams develop software products virtual - laboratories. The article presents some examples of the students' developments of virtual laboratories of Wave Optics.

articleTitle: Flow Balancing in FEM Modelling of Multi-Phase Flow in Porous Media
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the method of balancing the flows, which are obtained by the finite element solution, for modeling the multi-phase flow in porous media. The method is based on the selection of the corrective components which satisfy the minimum of functional of the balance of mixture volumes with the use of regularization. The studies of this method application have been performed by the problem which emulates the performance of exploitation and a group of injection wells. The numerical results show that the application of the proposed method ensures the conservation of mass of substances of filtering mixture, makes it possible to use the finite element mesh with bigger cells, and, consequently, to provide the solution of the problem with the required accuracy and low computational cost.

articleTitle: Threats and Opportunities of Cryptocurrency Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The reasons for the rise of interest in cryptocurrencies are shown, the prospects for their development and possible consequences for national and international economic systems, the regulation of the circulation and use of financial and monetary authorities are evaluated.

articleTitle: System of Monitoring and Remote Control of Microclimate in Greenhouses
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the idea of developing an active home greenhouse model for growing plants and flowers in an autonomous mode with the ability to remotely monitor and remotely control the process of plant care using energy-saving technologies and modern intelligent systems.

articleTitle: On a Problem of the Monitoring Devices Placement on Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of the optimal placement of monitoring systems on transport networks is considered. Unlike systems for monitoring road situations only, devices that monitor and transmit messages about traffic anomalies to all road users are considered. A weighted graph is considered as a model of a transport network. The analysis of the various algorithms for searching a subset of vertices in a graph for the placement of devices in a transport network is performed. Computational experiments have been carried out using simulation modeling.

articleTitle: Application of Genetic Algorithm in the Machinery and Tractor Park Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Several technological operations, which involved various aggregates, can be perform at the same time in annual cycle of technological operations performance. The space of solutions is a set of variants selection in the task of machinery and tractor park selection. The complexity of the valuation of received variants consists in the large amount of solution set. It is described one of methods of machinery and tractor park selection by imposition of limitations. The task is divided on subtask and the variants with minimal costs of each subtask are sought separately. The sum of minimum costs by each subtask will be equal the minimum of whole task. A genetic algorithm is proposed to reduce solution set. It allows to reduce the number of variants of machinery and tractor park selection in the calculation process and significantly to accelerate the calculations. There are defined the basic concepts of genetic algorithm (phenotype, genotype, individual, chromosome, parent) for the task of machinery and tractor selection. It is given an example of genetic algorithm application to the task of machinery and tractor park selection. The web-complex ≪PIKAT≫ is developed on base of the described algorithm for decision-making support and operating control of agricultural enterprises.

articleTitle: Voice Signal's Acoustic Characteristics of People with Cochlear Implants
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the acoustic characteristics of voice signals of hearing-impaired persons using cochlear implants. The aim of the study is to identify the acoustic parameters, the values of which differ from the parameters of voice and speech of people with normal hearing. Standard parameters for voice quality assessment, such as Jitter and Shimmer, were chosen as considered characteristics, noise component was estimated by calculating the ratio of harmonic signal to noise (HNR). The voice signal's spectrum of persons with cochlear implants was also considered in comparison with the voice signal's spectrum of persons without hearing impairment. Calculations were made of the voice harmonization coefficient (VHC6. 7. 8/1.2) determining the presence of dysphonia..

articleTitle: Systematic Analysis of the Efficiency of Low-Voltage Switching Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In article laws of change of resistance of contact connections and probability of no failure of low-voltage switching devices depending on the modes of operation are revealed and the method of complex assessment of effectiveness of functioning of low-voltage devices is described. For assessment of technical condition and reliability of switching devices of low tension is offered to use resistance of contact connections. Parameter of probability of no failure is offered to be estimated dependence of resistance of contact connections of devices on number of switching. During operation of low-voltage devices there are total failures of contacts and short-term during one switching, for refusal of contact take excess by resistance of contacts of threshold value. For switching devices by results of the conducted researches the critical value of resistance of the device is accepted at triple increase in initial resistance. At the same time definition of the quantitative characteristics of effectiveness of functioning is carried out by methods of a probability theory and mathematical statistics. The set of the received quantitative indices allows to define the actual reliability level of engagement and expands possibilities of prediction of estimates of serviceability at projection.

articleTitle: Superconducting Josephson Junction Critical Current Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The effective estimations of the linear approximated volt-ampere curve parameters have been developed using the maximum-likelihood method for the case of random measuring signal nature. Numerical modeling has been provided to prove the efficiency of the obtained estimations and the expediency to be applied in the laboratory experiments.

articleTitle: Features Calculation of the Converter Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article it is described the calculation of converters digital protection (rectifier, controlled rectifier and inverter) from external and internal damages. Such protection is used for the existing electromechanical relays, control devices, diagnostics and protection units - digital terminals, for example Russian BMRZ-100 and devices produced by ABB firm.

articleTitle: The Mechanism of Low-Temperature Transformation in Nicherome
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The mechanism of low-temperature transformation in nichrome and K-effect are considered from the point of view of the dependence of electrical properties on temperature. It is established that the K-effect was due to a change in the density of electronic states at the Fermi level in the course of atomic ordering.

articleTitle: Development of the Analytical Platform for CRM-System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article, we propose the architecture of an analytical platform that implements services of client data mining stored in CRM -systems. The architecture of the platform is focused on services that use API-interfaces. The article describes the operation of the goods recommendation and time series forecasting services, implemented on the basis of this platform, and the results of testing the first version of the system.

articleTitle: Control of Object in the Loop with Feedback Using Imperfect Sensors of Position and Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses the problem of balancing robot control with negative feedback loop. The regulator (controller) can be calculated by numerical optimization. Sensors of the controlled value are imperfect. Orientation angle sensor (gyroscope) has a limited speed, as well as binary quantization noise. An acceleration sensor (accelerometer) has the average value drift and Gaussian noise. None of these sensors is sufficient to effectively stabilize the balancing of the robot, but using them both in a single control loop can achieve the required accuracy of control in static and dynamic. Method of combining the two sensors to more accurately determine the value of a single, previously developed in theory, has been tested with simulation and with realization in acting model of the robot. The results are confirmed by their practical use with good effect, which one can see on video by the reference link.

articleTitle: An Efficiency Estimation for Multilooking and Phase Noise Suppression Methods for Spaceborne Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radars Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An experimental study of the efficiency of the radar data interferometric processing algorithms is complicated by the fact that a quantitative result can be obtained only after the entire processing procedure is finished, so it is difficult to estimate the effectiveness of the first processing stages - the multilooking and of phase noise suppression. A method for accuracy estimation interferometric data processing at such steps based on the reference digital elevation model inverse transformation is proposed. The results of the method implementation for ALOS PALSAR data with different baselines are presented.

articleTitle: Regulation Characteristics of Hysteresis Clutches Based on the Fe-Cr-Co Material
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of the analysis of the hysteresis electromagnetic clutches regulation characteristics are presented. Experimental data of the hysteresis material Fe-Cr-Co magnetic characteristics are given. It is shown that controllable hysteresis clutch based on the Fe-Cr-Co material can be an alternative to technical solutions of electric drives with torque limit control.

articleTitle: Plasma-Chemical Etching Process Behavioral Models Based on Tree Ensembles and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the modern semiconductor manufacturing technology it is essential to control the result of a wafer processing to ensure stability and high production yield. One of the promising techniques, which can provide the information about the result of a process, is predictive modeling based on machine learning models. In this paper, the possibilities of using Tree Ensembles and Artificial Neural Networks for modeling the plasma-chemical process of deep trench etching in the silicon substrate are considered. Mathematical background for machine learning techniques used for modeling is discussed, principles of regression trees generation are presented and formal descriptive algorithm of composing several regression trees in an ensemble is demonstrated. The developed predictive models were tested on physical-technological model of the plasma-chemical etching process. The results have shown that accurate and robust models based on Tree Ensembles and Artificial Neural Networks were developed in order to predict the trench depth.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of a Transformer-Rectifier Unit with a Hybrid Magnetic Core
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the AC-DC converting system of an aircraft is examined and various methods for a DC obtaining are considered. To increase the efficiency of energy converters used in aircraft, it is proposed to use a hybrid magnetic core consisting of two different alloys to combine their properties. The magnetic topology and magnetic materials used in the hybrid magnetic core are chosen. As an example, a 12-pulse transformer-rectifier unit with a hybrid magnetic core was investigated. The overall dimensions were calculated and an experimental transformer-rectifier unit sample with a hybrid magnetic core was manufactured. An experimental study of the developed transformer-rectifier unit with a hybrid magnetic core has been carried out, the shapes and amplitudes of the output currents and voltages have been determined.

articleTitle: Locate Objects Mechanical Damage Based on Fiber-Optic Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work is devoted to the development of a method for monitoring the stability of hydraulic structures (dams), which created a monitoring system, operator can make a conclusion about the reliability of controlled structures as well as data on the level of protection facilities and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Neural Network for N - Dimension Surfaces Approximation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes the method of a neural network synthesis for approximation of functions of arbitrary dimensions. The method is based on an idea that every dimension need to: 1)be divided into a number of sub-diapasons; 2) intersect sub-diapasons outputs by logical “and” condition that forms a grid; 3) scale an output value of a neuron that makes logical “and” function up to an average value of anapproximable function; 4) and the last is a summation of all scaled values of the grid. The main advantages of this method is that it allows to get pre calculated neural network that is not required learning. On the other hand, proposed structure can be learned by using one of the known learning methods.

articleTitle: Signal Modeling of the Autodyne Short-Range Radar System at Presence of the Radar Target in the Antenna Near-Zone
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main expressions for calculation of the signal characteristics of the autodyne short-range radar system are obtained, which are taken into consideration of the reflected emission diffraction from the target located in the antenna near-zone. In the basis of the autodyne model, the oscillator equivalent circuit is used with the single-circuit oscillating system. An impact of reflected emission is represented in this circuit by the varying load. The antenna emission field is approximated by the Gauss-Hermite beam. Signal numerical modeling results are presented for the case when the radar target is the plane metallic plate.

articleTitle: Economic Evaluation of Energy Service Contract Implementation from the View of its Participants
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers one of the most promising tools for implementing measures to improve energy performance - the energy service contract (ESC). When considering the contract from the view of its participants, distinctive features of investment projects were revealed. The components of the cash flow generated under the contract for the customer and the energy service company (ESCO) are determined. An evaluation model of the ESC was developed, based on the net present value ( NPV) criterion and taking into account the balance of interests of its participants. Approbation of the obtained model was carried out using the example of ESC, implemented at the energy company of the Siberian Federal District. Using the results obtained, recommendations were proposed to improve the performance based contract as a whole. The possibilities of using the obtained model in real conditions are determined.

articleTitle: Iterative Algorithm for Radius Stylus Compensation of Touch Sensor When Measured on CMMs of Complex Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When measuring on the Coordinate Measuring Machines by a contact method, an error arises in determining the touch point of the probe and the actual surface. Therefore, the obligatory stage of mathematical processing of results is the compensation of the touch probe radius. The efficiency of the known compensation algorithms is characterized by the measurement error and the processing time of the information. Algorithms, that take into account data on neighboring points of tangency or calculate the equidistant surfaces of the centers of a spherical probe, will be the most accurate. Therefore, they are used in the measurement of complex surfaces. The authors propose an iterative algorithm of probe radius compensation through successive refinement of the touch point coordinates. The algorithm minimizes the angle between the normals at each measured point to the nominal and actual surfaces. Comparison of the probe radius compensation results for the developed algorithm with known showed the advantage of the iterative algorithm. The above calculation example for the compressor turbine blade confirms a 25% reduction in the measurement error. The greatest effect on increasing accuracy is achieved with a small number of measured points and their uneven location on a complex surface with variable curvature.

articleTitle: Speed Regulation of Single-Phase Engines Used in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The use of an asynchronous single-phase motor in agriculture is associated with a number of difficulties, namely the difficulty of starting and speed control. In this paper, several solutions to this problem are presented, using special designed conversion devices.

articleTitle: Thermophysical Processes During Electrochemical Treatment with a Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the theoretical assessment of the electrode processes during the laser activation of the electrochemical dissolving by using the methods of non-equilibrium thermodynamics is presented in the paper. The solutions to the thermo-physical task for solid and liquid media of the electrochemical system taking into consideration the possible inaccuracy in calculating the temperature field are obtained. It is established that the relative inaccuracy in deter-mining the temperature field does not depend on the parameters of the laser radiation but is entirely determined by the thermophysical properties of the processed material and electrolyte. The quantitative evaluation of the thermo-physical processes is presented on the example of the laser-electrochemical processing of titanium in water solutions of the electrolyte. It is shown that the main inaccuracy in determining the temperatures under the influence of the pulse laser radiation on the electrochemical system is connected with the presence of heat removal deep into the electrolyte.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Ways of Organizing Subsystems in a Heterogeneous Distributed Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to topical issues of highly productive heterogeneous distributed computing environments organization based on personal computers connected to the communication network. The analysis and identification of the characteristics of the most significant in conditions of geographical set-up and heterogeneity are carried out. The methods of automatic optimization of the process of allocation of nodes for the subsystems formed when the computational tasks are input to the system are investigated.

articleTitle: The Translation of Sentences from Russian Language to Russian Sign Language After Homonymy Removal
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, an analysis of the sign language translation systems is carried out. Semantic features of the Russian sounding language and the Russian sign language are considered. The description of the sign language syntax is given. To solve this problem, work was carried out to resolve lexical ambiguity when translating from Russian “sounding” language to Russian sign language using the V. Tuzov's semantic dictionary. Syntactic transformations are also processed out to bring the translated sentence in accordance with the requirements of the Russian sign language. The description of syntactic transformations of Russian sentences for mapping to gestures is given. A translation algorithm is described, which includes semantic analysis and syntactic transformations. The work of the semantic module is aimed at allowing lexical polysemy to establish the correct meanings of words in the context. At the stage of syntactic transformations, the order of words in the sentence is changed. In the system there are 2 types of basic order of words: “subject, verb, object” and “subject, object, verb”. Taking into account the semantic information, the result of the system operation is the correct sequence of gestures of the Russian sign language. Thus, the proposal from the Russian language is translated into Russian sign language.

articleTitle: Technology for Monitoring Urban Air Quality on the Basis of Satellite Navigation Data, Mobile Ecometric Stations and the Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An approach for obtaining reliable information on urban air quality is considered. It is proposed to take into account the city traffic flows based on the regression model built according to satellite navigation data. The modeling of the pollutants distribution from the transport is carried out taking into account the topography of the city, 3D-models of the buildings and actual meteorological information. The estimation of the stationary source's emissions is carried out by solving the inverse problem using the data from mobile ecometric stations. The description of the technology's software implementation, as well as the device and component composition of the air pollutants sensor, are given.

articleTitle: Statistical Monitoring of Keyboard Handwriting for Continuous Authentication
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method of continuous authentication by keyboard handwriting is proposed, where differences in preferences of alternative keys are revealed, and there is a constant comparison of the reference and observed empirical distribution functions of the holding intervals of the most common keys. In addition, we calculate the rank correlations between the sequences of these intervals in frequently encountered terms and identify differences in the mean and standard deviations of the intervals. The experimental verification showed the closeness of the relative error frequencies of both types with predetermined theoretical probabilities.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Enterprises of Microelectronics
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study in the field of operating mode modeling of robot technical systems of high-tech industries. It is demonstrated that the modeling of the production system functioning in the form of multiphase queuing systems makes it possible to obtain approximate analytical solutions in line with the requirements of the predictive analytics, and could become another step to a digital transformation of electronic instrument-making enterprises.

articleTitle: Adaptation on Pilot Signals in the Mobile OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this report the effectiveness of using pilot subcarriers in receiving OFDM signals algorithm construction is observed. The synthesis of adaptive algorithms with estimation the signals' parameters by pilot subcarriers for the OFDM signal is made.

articleTitle: Fluid Flow and Heat Transfer with Natural and Mixed Convection in Czochralski Method
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Regimes of natural and mixed convection of melts with Prandtl numbers 10,78; 16; 45,6 in the variant of the Czochralski method with a fixed crucible are numerically investigated. In mixed convection regime, the forced flow is induced by a uniformly rotating crystal under a given mode of thermal gravitational-capillary convection. When Pr = 10.78 abnormally high value of surface tension leads to an increase in the influence of the thermocapillary effect and the appearance of heat exchange features.

articleTitle: Automated Synthesis of BroadBand Matching and Filtering Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage automated method of synthesis presented here allows at the first to adequately find a good initial solution to the posed problem (definition of the structure and parameters of the broadband matching and filtering two-port), in the second stage this approach allows to find the optimal solution to the complex problem, taking into account the constraints on physical and circuit realizability. In addition, the synthesis of broadband matching and filtering devices (MFD) in lumped and distributed electrical element basis is carried out, and these devices connect complex immitances of the source and the load. The characteristics of the devices obtained after the synthesis show that the solution of the complex problem of both matching and filtering gives a significant improvement in filtering properties with small losses in the level of transmitted power.

articleTitle: Software Development for Interference Analisys Caused by PCI Collision in LTE Network
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article covers some key approaches to solve the problem of minimizing the interference level in wireless networks, such as LTE and further 5G networks, caused by lack of frequency reuseprinciple. The comparative analysis was done on the basis of the author's simulation model. It was done by comparison the simulation results of user's service blocking probability based on current interference level after author's solution to minimize the interference of Reference Signals caused by PCI collision. The PCI collision could happen if the neighboring cells use the same PCI code, which is cause the interference between Reference Signal distribution in time-frequency domain. Authors developed the software for Android phones to be as a drive-test equipment to get statistic of current information about network with attached GSP coordinates. Software for server was developed to analyze and identify such problem and offer the solution of minimizing the interference between the identical PCI of neighbor cells.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Zone Converter for the Adaptive Voltage Regulation of Urban Electric Transport
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The three-phase zone converter application for the adaptive regulation of power distribution is considered in the traction power system of urban electric transport. The application of zone rectifiers is justified. The operation principles of zone converter are formulated under adaptive control realization. It is estimated the utilization efficiency of a three-phase zone converter as a method for realization output voltage regulation at equally high energy performance. It is proved that adaptive control of the output voltage makes possible to steady cross currents, to reduce consumed currents and all sections voltage of the traction network, and as a result to reduce the specific electric energy consumption.

articleTitle: CMOS Current Logic Elements: Application Features for Processing Analog and Digital Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Features of the design and circuit technology implementation of CMOS current logic elements (TLE), including multi-valued logic elements are considered. An unconventional method for processing analog and digital current signals of sensors in automatic systems of extreme control based on the use of TLE “minimum” and “maximum” with three or more input variables is investigated. The CMOS TLE description of this class is described, as well as the results of their computer simulation when working with analog, as well as binary and ternary digital current signals.

Author Keywords: current logic element “minimum” with three input variables
current logic element “maximum” with three input variables

articleTitle: Development of Functions Approximating Tabular Data on the Basis of Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is shown that the approximation of tabular data can be carried out on the basis of artificial neural networks, while the specified accuracy, continuity and differentiability of the function can be provided.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Optimization Models for Planning Water-Energy Modes of Novosibirsk Hydro Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of the planning the Novosibirsk HPP (Hydro Power Plant) water-energy modes using different versions of the optimization models are presented in this article. Three mathematical models with a different optimality criterion were analyzed. There are following optimality criteria: maximization of total power generation for the planning periods, uniformity of the inflow rate in the tail water for the planning periods and multi-objective model. Comparative study of the model has been carried out and the conclusion about application perspectiveness of the developed models for planning water-energy modes of the Novosibirsk HPP was made.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Magnetic Field on Dual Elements
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Features of the variational formulation realization for the magnetic field as the first-order differential form with external orientation are presented in the. Space approximation is performed on a special grid partition - dual mesh. A method of constructing basis functions for dual mesh is proposed. The results of computational experiments for model problems are presented.

articleTitle: Ellipsometry as a Method for Diagnostics of Heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article ellipsometric control of the composition distribution of the growing structure by depth x(z) is considered on the basis of ellipsometric parameters Y(t) and Δ(t) measured in the process of growth when growing heterostructures by molecular beam epitaxy.

articleTitle: Determination of Eddy Currents Losses in Collector-V-Type Rotor's Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Eddy currents losses in collector-V-type rotor's permanent magnets of mast's emergency dynamic braking synchronous motor with the permanent magnets excitation and fractional slot concentrated winding on stator are examined and determinated. The effect of the stator slot opening value to eddy currents losses in magnets is analyzed.

articleTitle: An Example of Synthesis of an Optimal Signal of an Invariant Message Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the methods of synthesis of systems with constant parameters, invariant to additive interference, is the method of finding the optimal signal. The demodulation operator is selected as optimal in relation to noise, and the relative invariance to noise is achieved by selecting the signal, minimizing the effect of interference on the output of the demodulator according to this or that criterion. In this article, the issues of optimal signal synthesis are considered in more detail. It should be reminded that the systems of transmission of discrete information with constant parameters are considered here and, therefore, they can be invariant only in relation to quasi-deterministic interference. Quasi-deterministic noise can be written as a deterministic time function with random parameters. In the simplest case, which we will consider further, the random parameter is one. Under the condition of relative invariance to find the optimal signal, it is necessary to minimize the value of noise.

articleTitle: Parametrical Synthesis of Full Order Observer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper presents method for synthesis of full order observer, which allows for parametric synthesis of observing algorithms for multi-input/multi-output (MIMO) control systems, such as the vector control system of induction motor drive. This method on the principle of motion separation and on the Akkermanh formula is based.

articleTitle: Traction Load Appearance Nonparametric Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes nonparametric detection of current spectrum change in the traction power grid. If spectral components in an operating measurement cycle exceed corresponding ones in a reference cycle then the decision is that there is a load otherwise there is no load. The number of correct solutions is 90% from the total number of solutions.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Multi-Phase Flow in Porous Media for Petroleum Technology Using Polymers Flood
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the numerical modeling of the multi-phase flow with the use of the finite element method in porous media. The purpose of numerical experiments is to select the optimal polymer concentration in a water solution applied as a displacement agent. The study of the polymer concentration impact on the level of oil recovery has been performed with the use of the model emulating the operation of exploitation and several injection wells. As a result of numerical experiments, the values of additional oil recovery versus oil viscosity and polymer concentration in the water solution are obtained.

articleTitle: A Modified Electret Microelectromechanical Generator with Autostabilization Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work is devoted to theoretical and experimental study of the modified conditioning circuit of electrostatic microgenerator based on the Bennet doubler and allowing to operate with any capacitance modulation depth of the variable capacitor. A mathematical model of the generator enabling to find the charge variation for each circuit element depending on the circuit parameters is developed. It has been established that depending on capacitance modulation depth of the variable capacitor the circuit is able to operate in two different modes. When capacitance modulation depth is less than 2 one can observe an autostabilization of the storage capacitor voltage and charge, but when capacitance modulation depth is more than 2 a monotonous growth of the storage capacitor voltage and charge is observed. Analytical expressions allowing evaluate capacitors stabilized voltages in case when capacitance modulation depth is less than 2 have been derived. It has been found that an increase of the variable capacitor capacitance results in increase of the energy accumulation rate in the power source and therefore to increase the microgenerator power.

articleTitle: Development of Technological Modes the Formation of a Vertical PNP Transistor in the Structure of an Integrated Op-amp for a Complementary Bipolar Technological Route
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we explore modification of the basic complementary technological route using the TCAD-simulation method for simple and reliable control of the breakdown voltage of a vertical PNP transistor in the structure of an integral op-amp. We are offer the additional doping of the donor dopant into the hidden layer. In the process of the simulation experiments of the numerical values of technological parameters, this modification was being discovered. The synergies between the technological parameters and the basic electrophysical parameters of the transistor was fixed.

articleTitle: Researches of the Mandelstam - Brillouin Backcatter Features in the Erbium-Doped Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work is devoted to the researches of the Mandelstam - Brillouin scatter characteristics in the erbium-doped single-mode optical fiber. Reflectograms of the Brillouin optical time-domain reflectometer, graphic dependences of strain and loss on the basis of research tests are analyzed. Analysis of the experimental data shows considerable differences in dependences of the erbium-doped optical fiber from the same dependences of other fiber types. The work was performed with the financial support of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation within the scope of the base part of a State Assignment within the sphere of scientific activity (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: Statistical Methods in the Problem of Studying Apology Speech Formulas and Their Satellites in the English Language
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the algorithm of the analysis of justification speech formulas in the English language. We also consider methods of preprocessing text data (normalization, part-of-speech tagging, functional tagging). Such methods as frequency analysis and Apriori (an algorithm for frequent item set mining and association rule learning) have been used for texts analyzing. Based on the statistical analysis results, 11 general justification formulas have been derived. These formulas have also been used to compose an attribute vector for the classifier. The support vector machine classifier (SVM) is used for texts classifying. After training the classifier, 12 000 texts of the language corpus have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Projection Methods for Mathematical Modeling of Eddy Flows
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An eddy incompressible gas flow is described by nonstationary Navier-Stokes equations. A Chorin-Temam projection method is used for the time integration of the nonstationary Navier-Stokes equations. A computational scheme of a discontinuous Galerkin method is applied for the H(div) finite element discretization. Mathematical modeling results of the gas flow in a channel with a variable diameter are presented. A comparative analysis of the mathematical modeling results with experimental data is given.

articleTitle: The System for Determining the Portrait of a User of Telecom Services
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the actual issues of defining the user's portrait of Telecom services, formed on the basis of the data generated by him. Pay attention to the terminology of the BigData area. We discuss widely used technologies aimed at simplification and acceleration of work with large volumes of data. Particular attention is paid to accelerating the unloading of user data.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Replacement Scheme of the Electric Impulse Device Cleaning the Coal Dust from the Surface of the Electrostatic Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electrostatic filters for cleaning gaseous media from coal dust are widely used at enterprises of the fuel and energy complex. With their help, the separation of materials by the method of separating dispersed particles using electrostatic effect and deodorization takes place. When electrostatic filters work on the electrodes-plates, the accumulation of a layer of coal dust constantly occurs. With the increase of the coal dust layer, the quality of cleaning by filters of the gaseous medium is sharply reduced, which causes the need for periodic maintenance on their cleaning. In high-power production plants, sedimentary and corona electrode plates are mechanically shaken, while the deposited layer of coal dust under the influence of gravity is poured into a special hopper and then disposed of. Among the known methods of cleaning electrodes-plates of electrostatic filters (mechanical force, generation of sound vibrations), the greatest effect is given by the use of electric impulse cleaning devices. In such a device there is a high-voltage discharge of the capacitive storage on the actuator, consisting of an inductor coil and an anchor (conductive plate). As a result of the interaction of eddy currents in the anchor with the magnetic field of the inductor coil during the transition process, a countable in milliseconds, there is an electromagnetic pulse that creates the maximum displacement and acceleration of the cleaned surface of the plates-electrodes of the electrostatic filter in the range of elastic mechanical stresses. In this article the technique to calculation of parameters of the two-circuit scheme of replacement of the electric impulse device of cleaning based on decomposition of the curve of attenuation of a direct current in the short-circuited coil of an inductor with an anchor in an exponential series is offered. The decomposition of the current curve in the inductor coil in the amount of two exponents allows to record the operator resistance of the replacement circuit of the electric impulse cleaning device, and on it to obtain formulas for determining its parameters. The use of scheme of replacement of electric impulse cleaning devices allows to use the well developed mathematical apparatus of the theory of electrical circuits to optimize the power exposure for the plate electrodes of the electrostatic precipitators. Determination of the DC attenuation curve in the inductor coil with an anchor at varying the distance between them is based on the calculation of a non-stationary magnetic field with an attached chain in the ELCUT 6.0 software package (professional version).

articleTitle: Aeroelasticity as a Basic Factor in the Effectiveness of Locators with Conformal Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Significant errors of locating caused by the phenomenon of aeroelasticity can be damped by installing deformation sensors on the unmanned aerial vehicle at points determined by modeling taking into account the aeroelasticity.

articleTitle: Model of Additional Error of Measuring Transducers Taking into Account Statistical Bonding
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A mathematical model of additional error in measuring transducers was proposed, which takes into account the linear statistical bonds between the measured signal and the quantity affecting it. The mathematical model is based on the assumption that the measured signal and the influencing quantity can be described by stationary random processes distributed according to the distribution law. This model takes into account the harmonic components of the measured signal and the influencing quantity. The presence of harmonic components in the measured signals can be explained by the specificity of the regulation law of the technological process. The presence of harmonic components in the influencing quantities is explained by seasonal changes. It is shown that taking into account the correlation between them can lead to an increase in the error increase of 2.5 times. Taking into account that the phase angle shift between the harmonic components of the random processes of input and influencing impact can influence the change in the additional error by more than 30%.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Remote Access to Traction Network Terminals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article proposes an innovative digital connection system of terminal to a traction substation computer and power dispatcher via remote access system that allows to observe and operate the In-Ter device. The power dispatcher or technical department engineer can observe the terminal In-Ter in real operation mode. This allows changing the protection terminal setpoints quickly, analyzing the line loads, emergency current, setpoints correspondence in the technical department in order to reduce protection false responses.

articleTitle: Maximum Speed of the Striker in an Electromagnetic Converter with Longitudinal Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Linear electromagnetic converter striker maximum speed depending on magnetic field change in an operating air gap has been established. It has been shown that maximum speed at the end of the energy conversion process is independent on a kind of magnetic field but it depends only on magnetic core material practical design characteristics and magnetic properties.

articleTitle: An Alternative Approach to Data Transfer Parameters Definition for Corporate Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is aimed to develop mathematical models and method of network routing optimization for dynamic mode work. Optimization is made by common network criteria. Calculation of operating ratio of throughput of a network is presented.

articleTitle: Object-Oriented Programming “On the Reactive Thrust”
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the integration of the reactive programming means into the OOP environment is considered. The reactive fields, methods, classes, their inheritance are determined. Event programming is implemented through the asynchronous call of the reactive class methods by sets (tuples) of event-values in the class fields. The event programming means also include local and network synchronization of fields and reactive classes' objects. The software architecture of the reactive OOP framework for Java is described and it's using in the Internet of things (IoT): things (devices), components of the client application and the server are created as objects of derived classes from the general reactive class with synchronized content. The IoT-server architecture is proposed.

articleTitle: Interrelationship «Composition - Structure - Property» for Acentric Selenite Crystals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For the first time the structure, chemical bond lengths and nonlinear optical (NLO) susceptibility are tabulated for more than 100 noncentresymmetric (NCS) crystals of the simple and binary selenites. It is shown that in the plane of the metal-oxide bond lengths these crystals are positioned inside of the horizontal and slope intersected ellipses of "acentricity". The crystals with high NLO susceptibility are found near the right border of the vertical ellipse, and near the upper border of the horizontal ellipse; with the moderate one - into the left and central parts of these ellipses, and with low susceptibility into the top and bottom of ellipses rosette. The un-monotonous, extreme, fuzzy dependency of the NLO -susceptibility on the oxide bond length is observed.

articleTitle: Extraction of a Useful Signal on a Thermogram When it is Converted to a Two-Dimensional Image Using a Two-Dimensional Aperture Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A useful signal extraction from noise is one of the actual tasks of signal processing. A new method for one-dimensional signal extraction from noise using a two-dimensional filter is proposed in this study. The proposed method is very effective and simply implemented in practice. The method is used only for a two-dimensional image. The method is based on the filtering process described by the equation of autocorrelation type. The results of one-dimensional signal extraction on a thermogram in the form of a structural transition for a polymer through discrete filtration are presented.

articleTitle: Compact EPR Spectrometer for Research and Educational Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The functional schemes of compact electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectrometers of two types are considered in this article: homodyne for research laboratories and autodyne- for educational laboratories. Technical characteristics of the devices are given. A comparative analysis of the developed automated compact EPR spectrometer and analogues produced by other companies is performed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Existing Technical Solutions for Electric Energy Recovery on Urban Transport
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The ways of secondary use of electric energy received as a result of recuperative braking of the rolling stock of electric transport are analyzed.

articleTitle: Russian High Tech Companies: Growth Factors and Limitations
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The competitiveness of modern economy is determined mainly by the high-technology business activities Case of Russian economy is under discussion. The paper is concentrated on the revealing and estimation the factors of growth of the companies operating in knowledge-intensive services and high-tech manufacturing sector of national economy. The empirical part is based on data provided by Business Environment and Enterprise Performance Survey (BEEPS) arranged by the World Bank. Dynamics of employees' number during three years was chosen as an explaining variable. Such approach is quiet common. Internal determinants were presented by factors related to innovative capacities, human capital, resource conditions and financial limitations. Company's age and ownership structure were taken into account also. A two-step assessment procedure was applied in order to determine and estimate the factors of growth. Significant factors were selected with the help of best subsets regression and then these factors were further analyzed using OLS. Results revealed that company's age has negative influence to its growth in both analyzed sectors; another common factor which has positive influence is presented by highly educated employees' share. Share of dominating owner and credit application turned to be positively significant for knowledge intensive services. Government subsidies and equipment purchase positively influence on manufacturing companies' growth.

articleTitle: The Role of Chlorine Atoms in Etching Silicon in the Plasma of CF2Cl2/O2
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes a model of plasma chemical etching of silicon in CCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>plasma with teflon coating of the reactor walls. It is established that the chlorine atoms lead to a shift in the maximum of the dependence of the etching rate of silicon on the oxygen content in the gas mixture to ~90%, in comparison with fluorine containing plasmas. It is shown that the proposed model of the process explains all the currently known experimental data for CCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>plasma. The model is applicable to other chlorine containing mixtures, at least when silicon is etched.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for the Exact Packet Error Probability Calculation for Viterbi Decoding
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The performance of the Viterbi decoding algorithm in a binary symmetric channel is usually estimated by a lower or an upper bounds of a bit error probability. Nowadays, there are expressions for the exact bit error probability estimation for several trivial convolutional codes. However, traffic in modern systems is packetized. Thus, packet error probability is also an important performance metric. Besides, the existed methods could not be used for the task of packet error probability estimation. Therefore this paper presents an algorithm for the calculation of the exact packet error probability for the Viterbi decoding. The algorithm is based on a recurrent search of the cases, which lead to an error free-decoding and then cumulative probabilities of these cases are calculated.

articleTitle: Universal Tensor Model of Linear Channel and Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An universal geometric visual tensor model of physical system has been developed. It is suitable for analysis and synthesis of both channels and communication networks. An example of its usage for solving optimization problems is presented.

articleTitle: Portable Surgery Aspirator for Post-Surgery Drainage with Pressure Control Based on Impedance Changes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper a small-scale portable aspiration system for post-surgery drain is represented together with the method of detecting the exudate in wound chamber to control device with the aim to reduce risk of damaging patients' wound chamber walls during the post-surgery period. Impedance measuring using the block of sensors is used as the method of exudate detection necessary for valuation of wound chamber filling with infiltrate and further pressure feeding control according to the measured impedance.

articleTitle: On the Implementation of Innovative Projects. The Effect of the Investment Leverage
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article presents the construction of mathematical models for estimating the economic conditions in which positive effect is possible for using loan capital, for implementation of investment projects leading to the growth of net present value (NPV). The authors obtained economic and mathematical calculations that allow linking the parameters of innovation and investment projects (the norm of the investor's profitability, the cost of loan capital, the time of its entry into the financial and time frame of the project, the time of the beginning of repayment of the financial obligations, duration of project). These parameters determine the effect of NPV index growth. This effect is related to the favorable conditions for loan capital raising in comparison with financing only by own funds. The authors obtained an analytical expression that determines at which point in time the loan capital should be entered into the financial and time frame of the project implementation, in order for the NPV index to increase its value. Also, the authors found out what should be the cost of the loan capital, so that its attraction would give the effect of an increase in the NPV index. The mathematical relations and the economic conclusions drawn on their basis are backed by practical results, given in a graphic form.

articleTitle: Determination of Energy Regeneration Electromagnetic Suspension of the Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The application of an electromagnetic oscillation damper on a vehicle is considered with the purpose of upgrading the running qualities of a vehicle and improving the energy indicators by implementing the generator operating mode of an electrical machine used as an oscillation damper. A mathematical simulation model of the front suspension element of the vehicle for Trolleybus Trolza- 5265 is designed. The main purpose of the simulation model is to estimate the amount of regenerated energy.

articleTitle: Measurements of the Permittivity of Materials Using the Double-Ridged Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A broadband method for measuring the complex permittivity of materials for the microwave range is proposed. The double-ridged waveguide is offered to use as a measuring cell. The developed method makes it possible to increase the accuracy of determining the complex permittivity of materials by placing the sample between the waveguide ridges at the maximum of the electric field intensity of the fundamental wave. Electrodynamic characteristics of the double-ridged waveguide with a dielectric sample are presented: cutoff frequencies, propagation constants, and the structure of the fundamental hybrid wave at the operating frequency. The measurement results of the complex permittivity of a Teflon sample are shown.

articleTitle: Transients of Synchronous Generator with PIDD2 Excitation Controller at Stability Boundary
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Stabilization of the nonlinear generator model was carried out by PIDD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> excitation controller. We've found system stability boundary on proportional control parameter axis and limits of stabilizable voltage surges or slumps on buses. Transients in the neighborhood of the boundary point exhibit five main types of stability and unstable dynamics. Nonlinear closed loop system is unstable to sufficiently small perturbations and turns out to be stable to not too small ones in the instability domain of its linearization. In a certain area the steady-state oscillations amplitude increases while the initial perturbation decreases; it can be regarded as cumulative hunting.

articleTitle: Features of the Application of Adaptive Quantization in Generators with Digital Control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The Adaptive Quantization is proposed-an algorithm for generating sinusoidal signal samples for a digital-controlled measuring oscillator. Adaptive quantization significantly improves the selected signal parameter, for example, the error of the first harmonic, reduces the dependence of the parameter on the sampling frequency, reduces the requirements for the DAC.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation Formalization of the In-Circuit Control Test Based on the Maximum Entropy Principle
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article consideres the entropy criterion used to evaluate the quality of the in-circuit control test in digital devices. The presented approach allows to analyze the in-circuit control test and to reduce its length.

articleTitle: Algorithms of Binary Texture Images Modeling
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is concerned with the problem of binary texture images with multiple types of textures modeling. An approach based on representation of a texture image by a realization of a binary random field with Gibbs probability distribution is applied to describe texture properties of binary images. Boundaries of texture regions are constructed by means of Voronoi diagrams and a stochastic cellular automaton. Results of texture maps and binary texture images modeling are demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Method for Determining the Distance to an Object and its Radial Velocity by a Single-Position Passive Locator
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of passive one-position determination of the distance and radial velocity of an object is considered. The originality of the method is confirmed by a patent.

articleTitle: Forecasting Dynamic and Statistical Properties of Underground Pipelines Under Conditions of “Safe City”
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Various methods of an automated measuring system for the state of underground pipelines are considered. An optimal way of monitoring the condition of pipeline transport systems (PTS) in the conditions of the “Safe City” is proposed. In addition, practical recommendations and applications of the proposed technology are given.

articleTitle: Metrological Assurance of Flanges Fixing Process on Fiberglass Pipes in Manufacturing Environments
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers a metrological assurance of technology of press-glue joint of flanges with fiberglass pipes in industrial conditions of industrial enterprise. The main provisions of the procedure of measurements for the process parameters for an automated information and measurement system integrated into the process equipment are developed. The results of the measurements after the secondary processing are the criteria for the quality of the flanges fixing. The novelty of the procedure of measurements lies in the continuous control of the technological operation of the flanges fixing with the issuance of a conclusion on the conformity of the measurement results with the criteria specified in the documentation after the completion of the technological process. The results of the measurement experiment on the control of the technological process confirmed the operability of the information-measuring system and the appropriateness of applying this method to proceed from selective control of finished products to continuous measurement control in order to reduce the risk of supplying poor-quality products to consumers.

articleTitle: Conjugate Heat Transfer Under Natural Convective Upward Inleakage of the Jet on the Obstacle of Finite Thermal Conductivity
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of physical and numerical modeling of the upward natural convective jet over a linear heat source and conjugate convective heat transfer of its head with a massive horizontal barrier of finite thermal conductivity are presented. Liquids with different thermophysical properties and massive horizontal barriers of different thermal conductivity are considered. Considered scenarios for the development of thermo-ascending jets on the linear heat sources, depending on the Prandtl numbers and the height of the fluid layer. Numerical simulation of free convection was carried out on the basis of a dimensionless system of Navier-Stokes equations in Boussinesq approximation, recorded in variables temperature, velocity vortex and current function, by the finite element method.

articleTitle: Laboratory Experiment on Molecular Physics with the Use of Digital Measuring System Casio
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of the use of digital measuring systems, primarily Casio system, is considered. Advantages and disadvantages of relative and absolute pressure sensors are discussed. Examples of possible application of Casio system.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of Activity Hotel Enterprises of Siberian Federal
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of analysis of financial costs efficiency is considered in hotel enterprises in Siberian Federal. The analysis was carried out using a panel data model with a structured stochastic frontier error. The results of the analysis allowed to identify the regions with the greatest economic return on investment in hotel enterprises.

articleTitle: Comparison of Sparse Solutions Obtained by Splitting the Sample into Parts Based on External Quality Criteria of Models in the LS-SVM Method
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of partitioning sample into training and test parts are considered for LS-SVM method with use of methods of optimal experimental design and external criteria quality of models. For partitioning sample into parts are given the corresponding computational schemes. The computational experiment is carried out on a model example. In it, to obtain a sparse solution from the initial sample, the training part of various volumes was extracted. The efficiency of the proposed algorithms was verified in conditions of different noise levels of the useful signal. Comparison of the quality of the obtained solutions was carried out based on the mean square error.

articleTitle: Influence of the Topology of the Distributed Series Compensation Devices on Power Transformer Losses
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper studies the effect of topologies of distributed series compensation devices on the value of losses in a power transformer. The analytical expressions for the calculation of the current in the secondary winding of the transformer of distributed series compensation devices have been derived. The calculations for finding the dependence of the value of in the transformer secondary winding losses on the line current for different topologies of the distributed series compensation device have been explained.

articleTitle: A Study On A NO2Sensor Based on SiO2-ZrO2Composite Film
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> composite films were prepared by means of the sol-gel technology from the tetraethoxysilane-based alcohol solution. To fabricate the SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas sensors, a V -Cu-Cr was deposited via an interdigitated shadow mask onto other SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si templates. The gas sensor was exposed to 40-1060 ppm concentrations of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>gas in ambient air. The sensor resistance is rather sensitive to the presence of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>impurity in air at low operating temperature (25°C). Accelerated stability tests of the initial resistance performed high stability and reproducibility of the sensor based on the SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> film. The output signals of the sensors were processed using a wavelet filter in the MatLab program to remove noise using automatic one-dimensional deletion.

articleTitle: Laboratory Facility to Study Static Electricity Phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Static electricity phenomenon as well as causes of its occurrence and all related issues emerging at the electrical energy objects are considered in the article. The presented laboratory facility allows the students to gain practical skills to study the phenomenon while learning the subject "Electromagnetic compatibility in electrical energy".

articleTitle: Algorithm of Telemetry Information Weighting Signal Processing from Territorially-Distributed Receiving Stations
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The issues of telemetry information processing of rocket and space technology products in the conditions of full-scale experiment are considered. The aim is to create an algorithm for weighing signal processing by those specified by the model in the form of two-component gamma distribution from territorial distributed receiving stations at a given probability of false alarm. Using full-scale telemetry information, the dependence of signal of telemetry information correct detection probability on the signal-to-noise ratio was obtained. It is shown that simultaneous use of information from five receiving stations allows to increase the average probability of correct detection of signal of telemetry information in comparison with sequential use of information from one receiving station at different signal-to-noise ratio and at a given probability of false alarm.

articleTitle: Scientific Infrastructure for the Support Studies the Geodynamic Process in the Seismic Prone Zones
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The novel geoinformation technology and scientific infrastructure based on the methods of knowledge engineering for performing integrated researches of geodynamic processes in seismic prone zones, for studying the physical laws of geotectonics, based on the investigation of the deep structure and monitoring of the stress-strain state of seismically active regions by the methods of active seismology and mathematical modeling are proposed. Practical implementation of geoinformation technology is based on the data of long-term geophysical studies and vibroseismic monitoring of the Baikal rift zone.

articleTitle: Analysis of Coupling Degree Influence Between Resonators on Autodyne Characteristics of Stabilized Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An analysis of autodyne characteristics of a microwave oscillator with frequency stabilization by an additional high-Q resonator with various coupling degree between resonators is performed. Advantages of strong coupling utilization between resonators, which provides improvement of the autodyne signal quality at strong reflected emission, are presented. Analysis results are confirmed by experimental data obtained for the 8mm-range Gunn-diode stabilized oscillator.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dynamic Processes of Acceleration Devices with Linear Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to the independence of the traction force from the clutch, simplicity and variety of design, there is an increasing interest in the use of linear electric motors in the process of reproducing various linear displacements, both for transport and for technological purposes. In the article, some questions of dynamics of the accelerating device based on the linear engine are analyzed. Analytical dependencies are obtained that allow you to program the acceleration at the initial stage of acceleration and the speed of the secondary motor element.

articleTitle: Analog Microcircuit MH2XA010–05 for Signal Processing of Acoustic Sensors Measuring the Temperature of Gas Flow of Jet Engines
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new integrated circuit (IC) MH2XA010-05, implemented on the structured array (SA) MH2XA010, is considered. It is intended for analog processing of signals of piezoelectric transducers in the system of measuring the gas flow temperature of jet engines by acoustic methods. The electric circuit of the IC is given; the features of functioning and experimental results of measurements of the basic parameters are described.

articleTitle: Topical Issues of Retraining of Specialists-Metrologists
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The report discusses the issues of determining the frequency of training in the field of Metrology. The authors note that an unjustified increase in the interval between the training of each metrologist leads to a decrease in the quality of products.

articleTitle: A ZVS/ZCS Hybrid Driver Integrated Circuit in 250 nm BCD Technology for Energy-Efficient Switch Mode Power Supply Units
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
