abstract: This work represents verification results of experimental samples of hybrid zero voltage/zero current switching driver integrated circuit (IC) developed for switch mode power supply units. The IC samples have been designed and manufactured in 250 nm BCD IC technology, which combines CMOS, bipolar and DMOS options. Hybrid voltage and current control method with addition of different gate voltage forming realized.

articleTitle: Impulse Synchronous Electromagnetic Machine Operation Process Investigation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Comprehensive analysis of double-coil impulse synchronous electromagnetic machines has been carried out. The example of model numerical realization in Matlab Simulink has been considered. The created model provides wide capabilities to carry out the comprehensive analysis of electromagnetic synchronous machines with reciprocating motions in different operating modes to improve their characteristics.

articleTitle: Increasing the Reliability of Test Results of Infrared Thermometers and Thermal Imaging Cameras
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the procedure and results of testing black body models traceable to contact temperature standards, comparing the calibration reliability indicators for the developed models and models with radiometric traceability and proposing an algorithm for a posteriori assessment of reliability of calibration results.

articleTitle: Load Shedding Devices in Distributed Generation: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the most important issues of modern of distributed generations (DGs) is the unintentional island situation which is also known as loss of mains or loss of grid. Islanding is a situation in which a distribution system becomes electrically isolated from the larger and remainder of the power system. This situation is only possible with a condition that there is sufficient generation to meet the island load. Otherwise, load shedding can be taken by automatic underfrequency load shedding devices (UFLS). The existing methods and devices of load shedding when the islanding of situation in micro-energy system occurs are considering in this review.

articleTitle: Nuclear Doping of Single-Crystal Silicon in the IRT-T Pool Type Research Nuclear Reactor
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model for the formation of a neutron field for nuclear doping of monocrystalline silicon ingots with a diameter of up to 205 mm has been developed. It is shown that the use of a smoothing filter makes it possible to achieve high axial homogeneity of the neutron field along the height of the silicon ingot. The calculated spectral characteristics of the neutron field in the irradiation zone of silicon ingots are obtained. An algorithm for the movement of a container with ingots during its irradiation in a vertical experimental channel of large diameter has been developed.

articleTitle: The Optimization of the Configuration Options of a Radio-Photonic Feeder Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis was performed and the method to optimize a configuration for radio-photonic feeder lines equipment by maximum dynamic range criterion for the signals of multi-element HF-VHF-UHF antenna array in the minimum own noise level was developed.

articleTitle: Multiparameter Protection of Traction Network of Railways of Direct Current
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work of existing analog protection devices and the experience of the digital terminals being implemented has been analyzed, has been proposed a variant of improving their operation.

articleTitle: Soft Capture of Movable Target by Robot-Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A plane model of a manipulator with two degrees of freedom consisting of two pivotally connected rod links is considered. The drive motors are located in the hinge joints. At the end of the last rod is gripper. An arbitrary trajectory along which the target moves is known in advance. The aim of this work is to develop such a control algorithm by motion of the manipulator, which provides for a specified time the soft capture of the target by the manipulator, without exceeding the limits of moments and the capacities of the drives. Based on the mathematical solution of the problem, an algorithm for manipulator control is developed, which is implemented in the form of an intellectual simulator used for training students.

articleTitle: Research of Three-Phase Rectifier with Active Power Factor Corrector
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the results of three-phase active power factor corrector topologies simulation are considered. The diagrams of consumed current, its THD and losses in semiconductor devices are obtained.

articleTitle: Sensitized Photovoltaic Effect in Silicon
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of organic dyes applied to the semiconductor surface on the value of photo-EMF in the monocrystalline silicon was investigated. The internal photo effect sensitization of the semiconductor was found in the dye absorption band. The optimum concentration of dye molecules on the semiconductor surface is determined, that corresponds to the dye film thickness of 10-15 nanometers. The mechanism of the sensitization based on the theory of non-radiative resonant inductive energy transfer is discussed.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Multi-Phase Flow for Various Junctions of Water and Oil Saturated Layers in 3-D Porous Media
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper analyzes the petroleum technologies which make use of injection wells. The analysis is performed on the basis of numerical modeling of the multi-phase flow in a porous medium. The mathematical model and numerical results are presented for the problems which emulate the performance of one exploitation and three injection wells. For the oil deposit model considered in this paper, the studies performed make it possible to determine the optimal models of injection in various junctions of water-bearing and oil-producing formations.

articleTitle: Prospects in the Field of Energy-Conversion Devices Design for High-Voltage Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the comparative analysis of the structures variants of spacecrafts power supply systems with the connection of accumulator battery charge and discharge devices to the output power bus and to the solar battery bus, based on the calculation of energy flows in the system and the calculation of weight dimension characteristics of the estimated components of the system was carried out. Recommendations for choosing the rational structure of space craft high-voltage power supply system in terms of improved specific weight dimension characteristics and requirements for its energy-converting devices design are presented. The need to develop energy-converting devices with high values of efficiency has been proved and the expediency of designing it on the basis of combined modules is justified. The integrated charge-discharge module for the high-voltage power supply system on the basis of the bridge boost converter with an active rectifier (1400 W), providing a reversible mode of operation, used to charge the accumulator battery, is proposed. Experimental studies of the charge-discharge module were carried out. It is proved that the module provides limitation of the battery discharge current (15 A), the implementation of transistors soft switching and the achievement of efficiency is not less than 96 %.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Radiation Heating of Semiconductor Heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of the thickness of the epitaxial layer on the temperature of the heterostructure sample Ge / Si as a result of its radiant heating is studied. It is shown that the beginning of growth of the epitaxial layer is accompanied by an abrupt increase in temperature, which is caused by an increase in the reflection coefficient at the sample boundary, due to the replacement of silicon by germanium.

articleTitle: On Approximate Performance Evaluation of Multiservice Telecommunications Network with Static Routing
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The task of approximate performance evaluation is considered for multiservice telecommunications networks with virtual-circuit packet switching at the connection level. Suggested modified calculation procedure is based on Reduced Load Approximation and allows improving the accuracy of achieved estimations under simultaneous reducing the computational effort.

articleTitle: Determination of the Dispersion of the Output Signal of Linear Systems with Random Measurements Noise for Arbitrary Instants
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we study the formula usually used to calculate the dispersion of the output signal of the control system due to interference in the measurement channel. The validity of the application of this formula is shown only for the steady-state operation of the system when all transients can be considered complete, which practically means that it can be applied only to asymptotically stable systems and for an instant sufficiently remote from the initial instant to. From the analysis of formulas and graphs it is concluded that during the transition process the dispersion of the output signal caused by the measurement noise is much higher than the dispersion value in the steady-state mode. This fact should be taken into account when determining the required control resources.

articleTitle: Procedure for Eliminating a Systematic Error in Measuring Occupied Bandwidth on Low Signal-to-Noise Ratio in Space Radiomonitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The presence of a systematic error in determining the occupied bandwidth is established. A procedure for correcting obtained estimate using the statistics of systematic error values is proposed. It is demonstrated that the proposed procedure makes it possible to reduce up to three times root-mean-square error of measuring occupied bandwidth.

articleTitle: Contemporary Binary Classification Methods and Their Application to Reveal the Potential Advertisers
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the Article a Description of Some Contemporary Methods of Binary Classification Was Given, Their Advantages and Disadvantages Were Discussed. the Comparison of These Methods'performance To Solve the Problem of Finding Potential Advertisers With the Most Probability .of Return Was Provided.

articleTitle: The Device or Measuring Properties of Sea Buckthorn Berries
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A continual need exists for constant monitoring the mechanical properties of berry sea buckthorn in field conditions. These properties may be stated as follows: stem detachment force, crushing force, strength limit of peel and coefficient of relative strength of berry. The properties mentioned appear to be important to evaluate the berries suitability to mechanical machine harvesting. The aim of this paper is to design a machine for determining these properties that will allow making unique and accurate selection of berry variety in field conditions. Dependences of crushing force and strength limit of peel on the diameter and contact area of the plunger crushing the berry have been investigated on the dedicated force measurement bench. These mathematical dependences have been used as software to design the microprocessor-based device. The field experiments have shown that the proposed device can provide high accuracy in determining the strength properties of berries.

articleTitle: Parameters Determination of Combined Fuel Cell Power Plant Based on Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The strategic direction of the world transport industry should consider the development and creation of innovative environmentally friendly, energy-efficient and energy-saving vehicles and systems by using new technology principles. Equipment improvement and its operation modes optimization will allow better usage of existing traction drive resources. Introduction of innovative technologies with modern storage devices and non-conventional fuels application will provide highly efficient electricity usage by electrical complex. The use of traditional solutions and approaches are not sufficient to realize the effectiveness of energy resources in transport, so the study of electrical energy management issues with minimal impact on the environment is a priority. The use of hydrogen as a primary energy source is one of the areas of technological innovation, which can be implemented in the transport sector. To evaluate the power plant on hydrogen fuel design an experiment was carried out, the key pint of which is to install on the urban trolleybus on-board motion parameters recorder. The obtained data was analyzed in terms of the necessary power of electrochemical conversion devices of hydrogen (fuel cells), taking into account their efficiency, driving dynamics of the transport unit and other factors. The necessity of combined power plant design based on fuel cells as a power source is proved. The further research direction is designated.

articleTitle: Complex of Virtual Lab Works in the University of Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The development of software with the subsequent creation of a complex of virtual lab works on physics for the portal of distance learning has been performed. The modules of the complex are Web-products, which are available in the network and fully integrated with the portal of the MOODLE distance learning system. Electronic simulation of laboratory facilities has allowed providing the maximum similarity of space-time variables to real physical phenomenon. The dynamic library SWC created in the work contains a large set of software tools that allow to design and implement the development of various laboratory works effectively.

articleTitle: Expert Estimates Processing and Decision-Making Taking into Account Non-Factors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes an approach to processing information obtained from experts under conditions, when the original information is expressed as both quantitative and linguistic. The approach can be applied in processing spatial information that is characterized by the presence of NON-factors. An example of the application of the proposed approach is given, for which the original data is obtained on the basis of the expert experience and the information about the new event. The expert estimates were processed by paired comparisons.

articleTitle: Decrease of the Error of Measurement of Self-Capacitance with Least Squares Method
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of self-capacipance measurement in frequency range 0.05 to 30 MHz is presented in the article. The peculiarity if the method is the using of least squares method for reducing of the error. The results of measurements for transfer standards of state primary standard of electrical Q-factor unity GET 139-2013 using proposed method are reported.

articleTitle: Detection Efficiency of Microwave Photons by the System of Two Qubits with Relaxation to a Common Bath
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this work we calculate the amplitudes of nonradiative decay of the microwave photons for the system of two qubits in a waveguide with energy relaxation to a common bath. The calculations are carried out in the formalism of the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian which includes in addition to the local relaxation channels the global relaxation of qubits to a common channel. We showed that for identical qubits the global relaxation can be matched to zero for the certain distances between the qubits. We analyze the contribution of nonradiative decay channels to the detection efficiency of microwave photons by the two-qubit system. We also find the parameters of the system at which the efficiency takes on 100% value.

articleTitle: Probabilistic and Statistical Method Application for Electric Power Losses Calculation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electric power losses calculation is required for the process losses standard assessment and for the development of activities aimed at losses reduction in electrical network. The probabilistic and statistical method basic fundamentals as well as a power consumption model are presented in the article. The method can be used for the calculation of electric power losses on both high-voltage networks with 110 kV and above and on the distribution networks with different daily load curves.

articleTitle: A Review of the Properties of Some Tests for Exponentiality
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A wide selection of statistical tests for testing exponentiality is considered. The distributions of tests statistics under true null hypothesis have been studied depending on sample sizes. Comparative analysis of the power of tests under different pairs of competing hypotheses has been conducted. Advantages and disadvantages of individual tests have been shown. Considered tests have been ranked by the test power. The conclusions are made on preference of one test or another under presence of some competing alternatives.

articleTitle: Implementation of an Intrusion Detection and Prevention System Module for Corporate Network Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper addresses an algorithm of functioning of an intrusion detection and prevention system module, based on the principles of disguise and modification of the information system parameters. An implementation of an integrated local area network security control system using the designed module is described. The proposed concept allows providing protection of the corporate computer networks and information systems from a range of network attacks (impersonation, imposition of improper route, distributed denial of service, man-in-the-middle attacks, etc).

articleTitle: Modified Optical Scheme for a Silicon Electro-Optical Modulator with a Grating Coupling Element
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A modified optical scheme of an electro-optical modulator in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) structures is discussed in the article. It includes a double etching profile for the adiabatic transformation of a compact optical mode from a small-sized rib to a wide optical beam for coupling with an optical fiber by a periodic grating element. In the design of the Mach-Zehnder interferometer, a combination of the MMI beam splitters l×2 and 2×2, which provides operating of the modulator with the zero phase shift in the interferometer arms, is used. The numerical modeling results of the modulator are presented. It confirms the practical use of the modified optical scheme of the modulator design.

articleTitle: Doubled Capacity Electrical Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The power consumption growth causes the task of wise utilization of a limited space for the electrical equipment placement. This stimulates the developers to create highly efficient equipment by using new types of electrical steel, improving the cooling system, construction upgrading, etc. The paper proposes the new design of doubled power electric machine while guaranteeing the small weight-size parameters. The advantages of the developed design and possible applications of the electric machine are indicated.

articleTitle: Apparatus for Radial Vibrotherapy and Medical Massage with Elements of Shock Wave Therapy
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the developed apparatus for radial vibration therapy, provides a technique for taking the output characteristics of the apparatus on the developed experimental stand, and examines the methods of vibrooscillation during hardware vibration massage. Besides the topical application of the classical radial vibrotherapy, and its subspecies: extracorporeal shock wave therapy in modern medicine in the treatment and prevention of diseases of the musculoskeletal system, as well as provides operating ranges of frequencies and amplitudes of exposure to biological tissue in the application of these techniques.

Author Keywords: methods of treatment in vibrotherapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy
treatment of diseases of the musculoskeletal system
operating ranges of frequencies and amplitudes of impact on biological tissues

articleTitle: Development and Research of Software and Hardware for Processing of the Measurement Information and for Visualization of that Information on the Android-Based Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work deals with a portable oscilloscope that uses a wireless channel to transmit measured information, and modern smartphones for processing and visualization of that information. The article reviews the state of the market for such portable devices, reveals their advantages and disadvantages. Based on the received data, the technical requirements for the device being developed are formed. After that, the functional diagram of the device is shown.

articleTitle: Compare Frequency Measurement Time of Direct Counting Method and Method Based on the Continued Fractions When Measured Frequency Near the Reference Frequency
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For the frequency measurement used digital methods, which are based on counting the number of periods of the measured frequency that occur within a predetermined reference time interval (the total number of reference frequency periods). The application of such methods is characterized by a high value of the discretization error. One of the approaches to reduce the discretization error of frequency measurement is the continued fractions method. On the basis of this method was developed a mathematical model and carried out an analysis of the simulation results of frequency measurement using the continued fractions for defined value of frequency and error.

articleTitle: Wireless Motion Sensor with Data Transmission Using RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A wireless motion sensor, with data transmission based on radio frequency identification (RFID) technology, designed to protect stationary objects from theft was developed. The developed device design provides continuous, autonomous operation of the sensor for up to 12 years on one set of batteries. A description and justification of the device design, as well as lifetime calculations are presented.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of the Method of Determining the Number of Bits of the Digital Filters Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of determination of the number of bits of digital filter coefficients based on the sensitivity function is considered.

articleTitle: Economic Aspects of the Sustainable Technological Development of the Oil and Gas Industry in the Context of Low Oil Prices and the Current Situation in the Energy Markets
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article examines the dynamics of oil and gas companies' operating expenses as a factor of technological development. Based on the econometric model built on the basis of panel data, it was shown that with the oil prices plunging, oil and gas companies almost halved operating expenses primarily due to technological development in the field of hydrocarbons' exploration and production. It throws down a significant challenge to the Russian oil and gas industry in efficiency gains of the hard-to-recover oil and gas reserves' development and import phase-out.

articleTitle: C-Band Digitally Controlled Phase Shifter Design
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents simulation results of the C-band digitally controlled active vector-sum phase shifter (VSPS) which is implemented in 0.18 μm SiGe BiCMOS technology. VSPS provides digital 6-bit discrete phase control in the range from 0° to 354.5° with 5.625° step. Power consumption is below 110 mW. Post-layout simulation of VSPS shows absolute phase error <;0.7° in bandwidth 4-6 GHz with absolute gain error <;0.2 dB.

articleTitle: Investigation of Unauthorized Connection to Passive Fiber Optical Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the channels of information leakage in the fiberoptical communication line, and also analyzes the main methods for their detection. The research was funded by the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation according to the Basic Research Program (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: The Rule of Electric Drive Multi Criteria Optimization Solution Choice
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Effective control of the electric machine should provide the best combination of dynamic and energy properties of the electric drive in the conditions of existing restrictions. These properties are contradictory, causing a complex (multicriteria) approach to the synthesis of control. An integrated approach to synthesis requires formalization of the control problem. The article deals with the rule of choosing solutions of multicriteria optimization, on the basis of which the problem of effective control of an alternating current electric drive is formalized.

Author Keywords: the connection of the main properties of the electric machine by means of quality indicators

articleTitle: Technical, Economic and Fiscal Aspects of Increasing the Efficiency of Development of Oil and Gas Regions in the East of Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the influence of the tax system on the development and efficiency of one of the most technologically advanced industries of the Russian economy - the oil and gas sector. It was shown that tax regulation is one of the most important tools for the short-term optimization of the costs of resource users. Calculations were carried out for the selected models in order to identify the main factors of influence on the resulting indicators. For a typical resource development project in Eastern Siberia, the maximum level of the resulting indicators, as well as revenues to regional and local budgets, corresponds to the level of oil prices of 40-45 dollars per barrel. Recommendations for changes in the existing tax system were given in order to stimulate the introduction of high-tech developments in the oil and gas sector, as well as improve the economic efficiency of investment projects.

articleTitle: Development of Radio-Frequency Electrosurgical Unit EHVCh-1.76
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the main stages and principles of the development of the EHVCH-1.76 electrosurgical unit, examines the mechanisms of the high-frequency current on the tissue. The article presents the main load characteristics of the device and methods for their correction for better optimization of modes when working with specific types of biotissues and better and faster performance of tasks assigned to the medical staff. As the results of the work is presented a working model of the device with the expanded functional, incl. a touch panel designed to improve the convenience of setting the device, argon-plasma coagulation, used for coagulation of large surfaces without carbonization of tissues, auto-shutdown functions in time and the degree of coagulation of biological tissue in bipolar coagulation, and many others.

articleTitle: Searching for Operating Principles of Miniaturized Thermal Signal Transducers
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work is aimed at using the structural synthesis methods for searching for principles of sensors, for synthesizing principles of miniaturized thermal signal transducers, working in outer space, and any engineering systems. It has been suggested the idea of signal transducers designing. The technique is based on the structure synthesis of substance and energy transformations of signals with selection of the most rational combinations of physical phenomena and using of material properties where said phenomena manifest themselves. The methods are based on a matter-energy aspect of description of signal processes having different physical nature. They include: (a) creating a bank of data on physical phenomena in the form suitable for computer-aided processing; (b) forming a working principle of a transducer as a set of physical phenomena; (c) evaluating properties of transformation structures with the use of a criterion of generalized resistances matching, developed and based on the fundamentals of theoretical mechanics and the theory of electrical two-terminal pair networks. A complex of programs for looking up new principles of engineering systems based on energy and matter transformations has been developed. In developing the complex, we used methods of the theory of analogies, similarity and modeling as well as graph theory. It has been considered the operation principle and described the construction of the heat signal transducer being the transistor analogue which can operate under extreme conditions, for example, with elevated radiation and low temperatures in space.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Torque of Reluctance Magnetic Gear
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the studying of the torque producing mechanisms in reluctance type magnetic gear. The equation of magnetic conductivity and air-gap flux density are presented in the context of the electrical machines theory. The relationships for the reduction ratio and torque are obtained.

articleTitle: Development of Artificial Neural Networks to Simulate the Process of Dichloroethane Dehydration in the Statistica Software Program
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of artificial neural networks for simulation of technological processes. Stages of neural networks designing and training in the Statistica software package as exemplified in the source data of the technological process of dichloroethane dehydration were considered. After training the neural network this program allows to build histograms, scatter grams, graphical representation of the teaching selection on the three-dimensional surface, graphical representation of the training sample on the coordinate plane, etc. These charts help the user clearly see the process of neural network training and evaluate its effectiveness.

Author Keywords: temperature in the bottom of column

articleTitle: Classification and Evaluation of Factors Having Impact on Recuperative Braking at Urban Electric Transit
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article shows the main factors having influence on the energy efficiency of recuperative braking. Classifications of these factors by various criteria are given. The estimation method of various factors influence on efficiency of recuperation is offered, which is based on imitational modeling. The proposed method gives an integral estimation of energy consumption, taking into account the braking energy usage, and also allows evaluation of the influence of various factors on the recuperative braking effectiveness. It is confirmed that the type of control system used on vehicles has a great impact on the energy efficiency of city electric transport. The evaluation of the influence of the average speed of the transport flow on the energy efficiency of the recovery is also given.

articleTitle: Designing and Simulating of Synchronous Permanent Magnet Motor with Damper Winding
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The designing results of permanent magnet synchronous motor with damping winding presented in the paper. The advantages of the motor designed comparing to the induction motors are shown. The ability to start the motor driving it by the u/f control is investigated. It is detected, that damping windings proposed provides smooth start under load.

articleTitle: POTENTIAL Complexity of Nanostructures with Unlimited Basis of Nanoelements Under Conditions of Organizing Factors and Interference
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Generalized potential complexity of nanostructures that can be achieved in the synthesis of nanostructures technology "bottom-up" of nanoelements under the action of various kinds of interference and restrictions is studied in this clause. The values of the potential complexity of the generalized nanostructures, which can be synthesized under the conditions of unlimited plurality of nanostructures at different parameters organizing factors and interference have been found.

Author Keywords: the potential complexity of the generalized nanostructuress

articleTitle: The Research of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering in Optical Fibers of Different Standards
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper examines the nonlinear Stimulated Brillouin Scatteringeffect in optical communication lines. The parameters influencing the amplification of this parasitic effect are revealed and recommendations for its reduction are developed.

articleTitle: Location Technology for Construction of Seismic Images
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The idea of original location technology for construction of seismic images is proposed. New technology different from traditional technology by structural stability for the solution for inverse kinematic problem of seismic prospecting. It is based on the application of algorithms for the operation of adaptive phased array antenna for the processing of seismic data.

articleTitle: On Some New K-Samples Tests for Testing the Homogeneity of Distribution Laws
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Properties of k-samples tests for testing the homogeneity of distribution laws have been investigated. Tests have been proposed in which the maximum of the two-samples statistics of the Smirnov, the Lehmann-Rosenblatt and the Anderson-Darling tests as applied by pairs to the k-samples was utilized. Models of limiting statistics distributions for the proposed tests as well as for the Anderson-Darling k-sample test have been made. Comparative analysis of the power of the tests has been done.

articleTitle: Algorithmization of the Spatial Method of Image Enhancement Based on Aligning the Brightness Histograms
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A detailed analysis and description of the algorithm of the spatial method of image enhancement is carried out on the basis of alignment of their brightness histograms. There is an increasing use of photo and video equipment, as well as image processing methods in various branches of human activity. Also, all stages of processing images that are necessary for extracting useful information from them are discussed in detail, while the stage of image enhancement is of particular importance, since the quality of all subsequent stages, such as segmentation and analysis, depends on it. It is noted that such a simple and effective method of image enhancement, which is based on the alignment of brightness histogram, from the point of view of its practical application, is rather poorly described in the specialized literature. To eliminate this gap, the theory on which this method is based was described in detail, and an algorithm implementing it was proposed and described. To verify the correctness of the proposed algorithm, it was implemented in Python 2.7 and tested on various images. The experiment showed that this algorithm improves the image as well as its implementation in the OpenCV computer vision library and the MATLAB package.

articleTitle: A Model of a Protected System Under Unreliable Check-Out Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the continuous time operation models of optical line terminal for passive optical access networks with a number of protection schemes. Latent failures are considered to be the main reason for optical line terminal operational faults. The proposed models take into account the events of technical check-out control of the major and redundant terminals, as well as their restoration to a normal operational state after the failure detection. Based on steady-state probabilities, calculations of stationary availability factor and total availability factor are performed, with consideration of check-out errors of first and second kind.

Author Keywords: check-out errors of first and second kind

articleTitle: High-Voltage Equipment Insulation Oils Moisture Content Evaluation Using the Method of Gas Chromatography Under Various Temperature Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Liquid insulation moisture content control is essential because liquid in “oil-cellulose” insulation system is present in several forms (bonded, dissolved, emulsive and layered). In case of load change, therefore, temperature drop water can migrate from one form into another, and, yet worse, diffuse towards solid insulation, be adsorbed and decrease tolerance to short-circuit current exposure. Emulsive water in dielectric liquid is especially dangerous as it considerably decreases electrophysical characteristics of internal insulation system of high-voltage equipment. With the purpose of timely location of dangerous condition of internal insulation it is important to know general moisture content in dielectric liquid in practice. At present out of all known methods of moisture evaluation in insulation liquids only two allow to measure total moisture concentration based on coulometric titration and gas chromatography. In the process of high-voltage equipment operation oil complex chemical content changes significantly. New compounds interfering evaluation of the target component - water, appear in oil. That's why using moisture analysis methods in old oxydized oils, optimization of technological operations realization allowing to obtain the most reliable result is very important. The present article shows results of a research of different oil brands dehydrating on different chromatography modes. Comparing data of chromatographic analysis with the results of moisture analysis obtained using Karl Fischer method; satisfactory recovery rate at evaporator temperature mode of 240-300°C can be noted.

articleTitle: Machine-to-Machine Communication: Development of a Subscriber Tracking System for a Given Area
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper defines the problem and offers solutions to calibrate the location estimation in the Machine-to-Machine (M2M) system to a given scale set out in the customer specifications. The authors developed the classification of subscriber location tasks depending on practical application. The choice of tasks is process-based and proceeds without human participation. The solutions of such problems are in demand within the smart city paradigm.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Quality of Legal Regulations to Ensure Integrated Security of info Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes a method for assessing the quality of legal regulations that regulate the environmental, information and other components of the integrated security of telecommunications and socially significant facilities. Informative automated systems implementing this method are described.

articleTitle: Prospects of Hybrid Market for Electric Power Generation and Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Methodological fundamentals of designing combined DWEI (Diesel wind power installation) is developed taking into account wind speed non-uniformity during 24 hours day. The software HOMER was used for calculations appropriate for northern regions of Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Small-Size Microstrip Radiator of the Decimeter Wavelength Range
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A compact microstrip antenna of linear polarization is proposed, which can be used as an independent antenna or as a small antenna array radiator. The geometric dimensions were reduced by bending the conductor around the dielectric. The resonant size of the antenna is determined by the length of the conductor on the outer surface of the antenna and the wrapped part. The dielectric substrate has an air gap above the screen. The chosen design allowed to reduce the dimensions of the antenna in 1.4 times, while maintaining all the field and impedance characteristics of the antenna. To increase the band of operating frequencies, it is proposed to place an additional printed resonator above the main radiator. The antenna retained its compactness by expanding the frequency band 1.5 times.

articleTitle: Matrix Analysis of Single-Layer Windings
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Single-layer three-phase winding of induction motor with variable number of poles 2:1 is considered. Methods of research of single-layer windings with variable number of poles are described. Their electromagnetic properties are presented.

Author Keywords: Windings with changeable number of poles

articleTitle: Metrological Assistance of Multiport Vector Network Analyzers for Microwave Measurements
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents a method for verifying a vector network analyzer with an arbitrary number of measuring channels in order to determine the main metrological characteristics: measurement errors of complex transformation and reflection coefficients. Basic problems of metrological assistance of vector network analyzers and its models with 8-, 10- and 12 parameters are considered. The development of a parametric model for multi-port vector network analyzer based on a 12-parameter model is performed. The process of calibration and error definition for the Rohde & Schwarz ZVA 24 is considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of Supercapacitor Discharge Profiles in the Matlab Simulink Software for a Traction Mode of the Trolley Bus
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article analyzes the operation of a traction drive with a capacitive energy storage during the electric vehicle traction mode. The proposed simulation model makes it possible to estimate the system operability, as well as represent the characteristics of the energy storage and the drive by a diagram. Conclusions were made about the capacitive energy storage applicability as a buffer energy source.

articleTitle: Development of Multifunction Laser Lab System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the problems of the development of a multifunctional laser system for the educational student laboratory of biotechnical systems and technologies. The unit is designed to study the movements of micro-objects - and nano-objects in vitro, both in the mode of laser tweezers, and in the mode of physiotherapy.

articleTitle: Development of the Intelligent Decision Support System for Situation Management of Hydro Units
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The process of situation management for hydro unit commitment requires making decisions by operating personnel of a power plant. However, current situations of power generation regimes at a hydropower plant are characterized by uncertainty and a weak possibility of forecasting. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a system for analysis the current technical state of power equipment at a hydropower plant. Control criteria for hydro unit commitment are determined in the paper. Examples of calculating situation evaluations for technical state of power equipment by methods of fuzzy logic are shown. The analysis of making alternative decisions using situation evaluations of hydro units is also performed.

articleTitle: Countering Spoofing and Improving the Noise Immunity of Consumer Equipment GNSS
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses ways to improve the noise immunity of the means of coordinate-time and navigation definitions on the basis of global navigation satellite systems (GNSS). The problems of vulnerability of the navigation equipment of user to spoofing influences are considered. Analyzed the measures to detect and counter spoofing attacks new. Shows the results of model studies spoofing attacks based on the modeling unrequesting measurement information.

articleTitle: Power Generation System for Wind Turbines Based on Novel Multizone Converters
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel configurations of multizone current source converters are proposed in this paper for wind turbine power generation system using permanent magnet synchronous generator. The system consists of permanent magnet synchronous generator, diode rectifier in couple with buck converter or alternative multizone current source rectifier, and a pulse-width-modulated multizone current source inverter. Current source converter topologies with natural advantages in terms of quality of generated voltage in the entire range of regulation, controllable power factor, and reliable grid short-circuit protection is considered to be a promising power converter configurations for use in medium voltage high-power permanent magnet synchronous generator based wind turbine power generation systems. In this regard, two topologies of multizone current source inverters for medium-voltage wind turbine power generation system were proposed, investigated and analyzed in this paper. The advantages and disadvantages of these topologies are illustrated. The comparison was performed on the basis of analysis and simulation results in terms of grid-side voltage THD, grid power factor, DC current ripple factor, control characteristic and external characteristic. Also, reverse voltages of power semiconductor switches were analyzed.

articleTitle: Modified Multiscale Vector Finite Element Method on Polyhedral Meshes for the Time-Harmonic Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the modification of the vector multiscale finite element method on polyhedral meshes in H(curl) functional space. We consider the procedure for constructing nonpolynomial shape functions on polyhedral finite elements.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of the Technical System for Diagnosing the State of the Neuronal Space of Glia and Blood Vessels with the Possibility of Stimulating Their Activity
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes methodological approaches for creating a technical system for diagnosing the state of the neuron space of the glia and blood vessels of the human brain with the possibility of implementing a stimulation mode of their activity using high-sensitivity sensors operating in the mode of receiving and evaluating low-frequency vibrations, and then radiation with frequencies from 0 to 200 Hz, to reduce stagnation in glia and reduce the stagnation in glia and decrease the probability of formation of cholesterol plaques in the cerebral vessels. The development of similar technical systems is not currently conducted.

Author Keywords: assessment the state of the neuronal space
stimulation of stagnant states of brain glia
decrease the probability of formation of cholesterol plaques in the cerebral vessels

articleTitle: Radio Navigation Signal Phase Shift Compensation Method Based on a Constellation Diagram Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Received global navigation satellite system signal phase shift compensation method based on a constellation diagram analysis is considered. The phase shift reason is mismatch of signal frequency and the demodulator settings. Restoration results of modulating code sequences of real GNSS GLONASS and GPS signals are presented.

articleTitle: The Integrated Modeling of Semiconductor Stabilitrons
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of modeling of semiconductor stabilitrons which basis two program environments are are given: OrCAD (circuitry) and Synopsys TCAD Sentaurus (technology). At a stage of circuitry modeling behavioral models of semiconductor stabilitrons which allow to submit more precisely their volt-ampere characteristics in comparison with SPISE models are investigated. Schemes of behavioral models a component included standard SPICE components of the program OrCAD environment such as passive elements, semiconductors, the operated sources of current and tension. For technological modeling compact models of semiconductor structures in the environment of Synopsys TCAD Sentaurus on the basis of the results of circuitry modeling or measurements of the concrete device reflecting dependence of output electro physical parameters on dispersion of initial technological parameters are constructed. Integration of modeling tools will improve technical characteristics, increase reliability and minimize the space occupied on a crystal. The results of modeling of an optimum technological route and characteristics of semiconductor stabilitrons confirming the received results on behavioral models are given.

articleTitle: Features of the Neural Network for Determining the Position and Geometric Characteristics of Cavernous Inclusions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the process of developing a neural network (NN) capable of restoring the structure of the geological and physical model of the medium (GPMM) based on a known picture of the propagation of a wave field. The architecture of the NN itself and its components are indicated, information on the process of its training is provided. Also, the time of operation of the NN on different devices and the results obtained are shown. The work was supported by the Novosibirsk State Technical University (Project C-19, 2018).

articleTitle: Key Generator with a Forming Contour
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Since the energy efficiency of the radio transmitting devices is mainly determined by the output stage, the solution to this problem is largely reduced to improving the circuit design and the choice of the optimal mode of operation of the power amplifier. In this respect, as shown in the article, the most promising direction is the use of “key” modes of the generator. In this article, as a generator with external excitation, it is proposed to apply a resonant inverter operating in class E mode, the load circuit of which consists of a two-circuit oscillatory system. The first contour - forming, has a very low quality, the value of which is within 1.5-2. The second circuit has high quality and provides filtering function of the output signal. As shown by the results of the study of the authors, the efficiency of the inverter considered, operating in optimal mode, reaches 90-95%.

articleTitle: The Development of Medical Diagnostic System Based on Integration of Traditional and Eastern Medicines
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article is described approach of producing of medical diagnostic expert system which based on integration of traditional western and eastern medicines. If necessary, to clarify the probable diagnoses, the doctor should receive from the patient additional information about a human personal condition (medical history, lifestyle, some laboratory tests, etc.). In determining the actual disease present, there arises the actual task of choosing the most preferred atomic diagnostic test (ADT) at each step of the diagnostic process. One of the main directions of this work is research of informativity questionnaire for patients, where such as questions with binary answers Yes or No and questions for determination of human innate nature type. To increase diagnostic precision there has been developed a program method of diagnostic criterion (informativeness) using Bayes procedure and module of analysis based on nominal entropies. One variant of the diagnostic test based on self-assessed health status suggests determining a patient's constitution due to which it is possible to specify the diagnosis, avoiding diseases that are not typical for a certain constitutional type. Application of the diagnostic model offered motivates a patient to develop a healthy life, adhere to scientifically grounded system of disease prevention, according to the causes of diseases of the given constitution type.

articleTitle: The Application of Robust Estimation to Active Parametric Identification of Stochastic Linear Discrete Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of Izanloo-Fakoorian-Yazdi-Simon filter we proposed a robust procedure for the active parametric identification of stochastic linear discrete systems, including robust estimation of parameters and optimal design of input signal. We considered the general case of the entry of unknown parameters into the equations of state and observation, the initial condition and the covariance noise matrices of the system and measurements. Using the developed software, the efficiency of this procedure is demonstrated by the example of a DC motor control system for the grouped location of outliers.

articleTitle: Research of Statistic Distributions of Nonparametric Goodness-of-Fit Tests by Large Samples
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to application of nonparametric goodness-of-fit tests in the case of large samples. The main purpose is to develop the algorithm of application of nonparametric goodness-of- fit tests in the case of large samples. The estimation of critical sample sizes for using classical nonparametric Kolmogorov, Cramer-von Mises-Smirnov and Anderson-Darling tests has been received by Monte-Carlo simulation method. The features of testing goodness-of-fit hypotheses by large samples have been described. The algorithm of application of nonparametric goodness-of-fit tests in the case of large samples has been formulated.

articleTitle: Noise Immunity Increasing of Signals Transmitting with Using of Coded Sequences Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method of code diagnostics without of information about used encoder is described. Diagnostics is based on analysis of structure of received signals. Nonbinary block codes are examined.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Robustness Coefficient for Signal Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Both the form of the noise distribution and a number of signal and interference parameters can be a priori uncertain in many practical cases of signal detection. Therefore, the ability to maintain detection algorithm performance in the case of noise environment changing is one of the key problems. In the most cases at the stage of synthesis, it is not possible to ensure the independence of the average losses of an algorithm on the noise distribution, which makes it necessary to estimate the stability of the average losses of algorithms in the case of nonparametric a priori uncertainty. This property is usually called robustness. In this paper, we propose the asymptotic robustness coefficient which can be used for estimating the robustness of signal detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Creation of the Drive of the Caterpillar Mover of a Wheel Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of ways of increase in possibility of the wheel vehicles on snow is use of the caterpillar mover. Justification of parameters of the caterpillar mover for wheel the vehicles with a loading capacity up to 3500 kg is given. The design of the caterpillar mover for modernization is chosen. Results of a research of durability the wheel bearing from speed for the wheel vehicles and the vehicles on caterpillar to the course are given at various modes of the movement.

articleTitle: Criteria and Algorithm for the Russian Language Text Recognition Based on the Frequency Characteristics Set
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Text language recognition is necessary for formal analysis of texts. The paper describes the algorithm based on frequency characteristics to identify Russian language texts varied in size. Required to solve the problem, unigram and big ram characteristics (the number of characters, big rams and digrams being used, frequency of each character) and based on them criteria (the coincidence index, the conj unction index, and comprehensiveness of characters and bigrams being used in the text) are determined. Critical values and application ways for the criteria are determined. The algorithm accuracy is obtained experimentally for different samples. Compared to machine learning methods (such as neural networks or naive Bayes classifiers), the algorithm does not require additional information and training samples, simple in implementation and rather efficient in computing.

articleTitle: Development of Laboratory Training Stand “Auto Switch Measuring Voltage Limits” Based on NI ELVIS II Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the laboratory stand created by the laboratory of the Department of Electronics and Automatics NRNU MEPhI framed on a platform of NI ELVIS II workstation for engineering education purposes and illustrated with the methodology of the study of the device that automatically selects voltage measurement limits of digital voltmeter.

articleTitle: Ecosystems as Network Forms of Business Organization
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Thearticle is aimed at developing methodological aspects ofbuilding and functioning of business ecosystems on the basis of digital platforms. The review of foreign experience in-building business ecosystems and the analysis of 1C Company - the Russian business ecosystem - has made it possible to conclude that business ecosystemshave similar basic structure including four main types of players, irrespective of awide variety of digital platforms on whichsuch ecosystems are built. Using the example of 1C Company,the main actors of a business ecosystem are identiffied, possible distribution of tasks between them are specified and the fundamental features of network ecosystem aredescribed. It has been shown that a certain level of openness of digital platformsmaximizesthecapacity of independent participants to develop digital platforms and business ecosystemsbuilt on the basis of such platforms.

articleTitle: Neural Algorithm for Radio Signals Modulation Classification of Satellite Communication Systems at Low Signal-to-Noise Ratio
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Different classification algorithms were considered in the absence of a priori information on the type of modulation, on the basis of which dictionary of feature is proposed. Simulation model was constructed. Experiment was performed to evaluate the parameters of characteristics. Correct probability dependences of modulation classification type on signal-to-noise ratio were obtained.

articleTitle: Environmental Aspects of Infocommunication Facilities Integrated Safety
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes an information system that implements an algorithm for the quality control of assessing environmental impacts of telecommunications and other socially important facilities as a part of ensuring the integrated safety of these facilities. This system conducts an expert survey and processes the outcomes of the survey through the tools of fuzzy mathematical logic. The system produces a fuzzy linguistic term characterizing the quality of an environmental assessment.

articleTitle: The Transformer and Transistor Module - The Principal Element of Control System Asynchronous Electric Drive in Systemsof Positioning
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The new unified construction of the transformer and transistor module executed on the minimum structure on one force transistor placed in the common for all phases of the transformer of a circuit allowing to minimize quantity of force semiconductor keys is considered. This unified module belongs to the transforming technique receiving application in adjustable electric drives of an alternating current for implementation of the smooth amplitude start-up, countercurrent braking and also implementation of the mode of positioning of asynchronous engines.

articleTitle: Application of Compensating Conductors to Reduce the Impact of Magnetic Field from the Power Lines on the Main Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper touches upon the problem of protection of pipeline systems for transportation of raw materials from the destructive effect of the voltage induced by the overhead AC power transmission lines. The authors propose a new method of reducing the negative impact of the overhead power transmission lines, i.e. application of compensating conductor, which is quite effective and does not require special technical control being an economical way of pipelines protection. The method of increasing the efficiency of compensating conductor application is also suggested.

Author Keywords: fraction of metal by alternating current

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Syndrome Decoding for Distributed Computer Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A solution of a self-diagnosis problem for distributed computer systems consists in determining fault-free and faulty nodes of the system by the given syndrome. This problem can be reduced to the classification problem, which can be efficiently solved by deep learning algorithms. The article contains the statement and constraints of a syndrome decoding problem, the description of the developed algorithm of syndrome decoding using a convolutional neural network and the algorithm of teaching sets generation. A software implementation of the developed algorithms was fulfilled using DeepLearnToolBox of the Matlab interactive environment. We conducted experiments on the teaching sets with various number of nodes in distributed computer system and various number of faulty nodes. The hyperparameters of the convolutional neural network: length of a teaching set, number of teaching epochs, step size of a convolution kernel, number and sizes of kernels in a convolutional layer, number of convolutional neural network layers were experimentally selected. The algorithm effectiveness was evaluated by the dependence of the number of correctly detected nodes on the number of faulty nodes in a distributed computer system. Conducted experiments show that this algorithm should be used in distributed computer systems where number of faulty nodes did not exceed 30% of the system size. Despite of small length of the teaching set, the convolutional neural network keeps a good generalization ability.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Technical Resource of the Traction Motor ofElectric Transport
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a probabilistic mathematical model for estimating the state of the traction motor of a trolleybus.

articleTitle: Estimation of Energy Parameters of Global Positioning System Satellite Signal to Use in Radar Detection and Ranging with External Illumination
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we have considered the global positioning system satellite signal and estimated the energy potentials of the considered signal by means of simulation modelling to use in radar detection and ranging as an external illumination.

Author Keywords: radar detection and ranging with external illumination

articleTitle: Controlled Switch on the Operational Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes a controlled switch based on an operational amplifier with small values of forward resistance and forward voltage, as well as with an increased value of the reverse resistance.

articleTitle: Additional Simplification of the Precision Frequency Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The development and creation of frequency synthesizers is extremely important for laser physics problems, primarily for absolute frequency measurements. Numerous technical solutions for these purposes are known, but specific requirements, including the absence of jumps in the switching of the control code and the smoothness of the phase change of the generated signal, make it necessary to abandon the use of most known technical means for these purposes and develop individual devices based on new technical solutions. To the greatest extent these requirements are met by synthesizers on the basis of a method combining phase auto-tuning and frequency summation. The accuracy of such synthesizers is enhanced by the addition of identical blocks, which are seen as extremely simple. However, as it turns out, these blocks are still quite complex. Therefore, their addition is associated with a noticeable rise in price. This paper offers a new original solution to this problem by developing such refinement blocks that do not contain phase-locked loop subsystems. The synthesizer contains a simple block generating only two reference frequencies, several identical blocks containing synchronized switches, frequency adders, frequency dividers and filters, and the technical requirements for all these nodes are extremely simple. High characteristics of the device as a whole are achieved due to the organization of the signal conversion algorithm in it. The chosen frequency ratios greatly simplify the filters. The theoretical substantiation of the working capacity of all technical solutions, confirmed by modeling, is given, as well as the functional scheme of the synthesizer.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Validation of Two-Diode Model of Photovoltaic (PV) Modules
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents simulation and experimental validation of two diode models of photovoltaic (PV) module. The main contribution of this paper is the experimental validation of the two-diode model to represent the PV cell using measurements in laboratory. The experimental validation is carried out for (I-V) and (P-V) characteristics of SUNSET PX1506 panel under STC condition and different values of irradiation and temperature. In addition, two diode model accurately provides the photovoltaic module parameters with a fast convergence. In order to verify the proposed strategy, the single-diode model has been built. The simulation and the experimental results have been compared with the data issued by manufacturers. Moreover, the accurateness of the modeling is validated by comparing with the other models. It is envisaged that the proposed work is very useful for PV professionals who require simple, fast and accurate PV model to design their systems.

articleTitle: Biophysics Model for Information Transmission Path from an Acupuncture Point to Central Nervous System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The bio-physics model for information transmission path from an acupuncture point to central nervous system is proposed; the model takes into account optical influences and can be used for further investigations of bio-physics processes taking place in skin surface under various external influences.

articleTitle: Surgical Retractor for Abdominal Operations with Automated Configuration Forming the Operative Field While Minimizing Discontinuity Tissues “AR-1”
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the design principle of operation of an innovative retractor with an electronic drive for automatically growing and retaining the edges of the wound, taking into account the mechanical properties of the tissues, calculating the maximum load on the biological tissue, and also the possibility of correcting the space of the operating area for surgical operations in the abdominal cavity of the human body. In addition, a scheme of the optimal placement of this product on the operating table is provided to ensure maximum visibility and access in the operating area.

Author Keywords: Surgical operations in the abdominal cavity
allowed loads on the tissues of the human body
tensile strength of the biological tissue

articleTitle: Using a Spectrometer «Kazan-Nova II» to Identify Drugs by Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The hardware-software complex based on the homebuild nuclear magnetic/quadrupole resonance spectrometer “Kazan-Nova II”, which allows to determine the authenticity of nitrogen-containing drugs by a nondestructive method is considered in the article. The possibility to distinguish the drugs from different manufacturers using their NQR spectra is shown, which makes it possible to use this device as a scanner of the authenticity of medicinal products, as well as for the formation of a database of reference spectra.

articleTitle: Energy Problem of Water Depression in the Soils Environing the Travel Structure of Metropoliten
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of the process of electroosmotic water depletion in soils surrounding the track structure of the underground is given. It is established that due to the fact that the structure of soils is disturbed during the construction of the underground, the electroosmotic water loss in them has its own peculiarities, therefore it is necessary to optimize the process by the criterion of specific energy inputs for mass transfer.

articleTitle: The Analysis and the Review of Methods of Echo Compensation on the Basis of a Tabular Echo Compensation and the Transversal Filter in the Duplex Systems of Information Transfer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, every year increasing considerably the flow of information transmitted via communication channels. This circumstance requires a constant increase in the speed and fidelity of information transmission. For the study of bilateral systems in order to identify the main elements affecting the quality of information transmission, a typical structural scheme of duplex message transmission is considered. To study duplex telecommunication systems, it is necessary to have mathematical models of the elements they consist of.
