In long-distance communication systems, two-way simultaneous transmission of information is carried out through two-way channels formed by two opposite unidirectional channels, combined transitional devices. It is shown that at the current level of development of digital signal processing, it is compensatory methods of separating the transmission directions that become the basis for increasing noise immunity and the efficiency of using channel resources of duplex wired and wireless systems.

articleTitle: The Laser Diode Modulation by OFDM Signal. Results of Modeling
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Nonlinear lights-current characteristic of the laser diode influence to the signal/noise ratio (SNR) is considered at direct modulation by an OFDM signal. The modeling program allows to estimate the SNR uses the fast Fourier transformation (FFT). Noise arises because of clipping of an OFDM signal and nonlinearity of lights-current characteristic of the laser diode.

articleTitle: Application of a Multichannel Approach to Speech Intelligibility Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to analysis of the multichannel speech intelligibility assessment approach, based on the choice of frequency bands with the highest value of formant intelligibility among all measurements, and further calculation of the speech intelligibility index from the obtained sample captures. Measurements are made in control points of a real premise using a traditional method and taking into account the multichannel phenomenon. The software and hardware complex, allowing calculating estimation of speech intelligibility simultaneously at several channels separately, or at the complex of channels, is developed. The complex involves a qualitative assessment of security in vulnerable control points of the room, in which an operator has the ability to repeatedly listen to records from one of the channels and by their totality. The complex significantly facilitates and accelerates the measurement process, without requiring repetitions for each control point. Thus, the most reliable assessment of premises for negotiation security is achieved. It does not require a large amount of time and measurements. The use of the multichannel approach to the assessment of speech intelligibility provides an increase in speech intelligibility compared to traditional methods. Multichannel approach to the assessment of speech intelligibility with spatial diversity of sensors is considered.

articleTitle: Laboratory Stand for the Study of the Electric Strength of the Air Gaps System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A laboratory facility which allows choosing the optimal spacing dimensions of rod-to-plane gaps while examining the breakdown strength of clearances and excluding the mutual influence of dischargers while experimentally determining differential voltage was designed. While calculating the distribution functions of breakdown voltages of a multielectrode system according to the experimental data for the isolated rod-to-plane gaps with the application of the law of probabilities multiplication, there is a close agreement with experimental data for multielectrode systems. This suggests that the evaluation of the breakdown strength of multielectrode systems, it is sufficient to have a distribution function of the breakdown strength of an individual rod-to-plane gap.

articleTitle: Laboratory Modeling of Collisionless Interaction of Plasma Flows by Laser Plasma Blobs with Ions of Different Masses
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Laboratory experiment on interaction of expanding laser produced plasma flow with magnetized background at conditions when gyroradius of ions rotation is comparable to characteristic scale of magnetic cavity is described. Practically important question on the influence of complex ion composition of plasma piston on the effectiveness of interaction at significantly super-Alfvenic velocities is investigated.

articleTitle: Possibility of Energy Recovery at the Reduction of the Gas Pressure from the Main to the Distribution Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article the possibility of generating electric energy in gas distribution stations, using the potential energy of the pressure difference of natural gas, as a secondary energy source, is considered.

articleTitle: Digital Protection of Traction Network and Setting Calculation Features
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The reliable operation of DC traction network feeders' protections is one of the main vehicles problems. The usage of special devices was proposed to solve that problem., but it did not raise the system reliability. Protection devices reacted to one parameter: current., voltage., resistance., heating of current-carrying parts. Only the digital equipment creation makes possible to create protection devices., which responds to the transient phenomena signs in the traction network.

articleTitle: Bidirectional DC-DC Conversion in the Traction Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers questions of energy storage devices used in electric transport, especially in electric traction drive of trolley bus, in order to provide an autonomous motion, overhead system's load leveling and energy recovering. For efficiency of the proposed system it is used a bidirectional DC-DC converter. During the simulation regulation curves of the bidirectional DC-DC converters were obtained.

articleTitle: Surface Acoustic Waves in SrGdGa3O7 Crystals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper investigates numerically the properties of surface acoustic waves (SAW) in a new SrGdGa<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> single crystal of tetragonal crystal symmetry (42m). It is shown that the SAW has a maximum value of electromechanical coupling coefficient ≈ 0.2% on the ℤ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+62°</sup> -cut and X -axis wave propagation direction in the crystal. For the case of the Z-cut and wave propagation direction along the X+<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">45°</sup>-axis in the crystal, the SAW electromechanical coupling coefficient is equal to 0.17%. It is shown that these two cuts of SrGdGa<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> single crystal are more suitable for SAW device applications.

articleTitle: Device for Energy Extraction from the Water Flow for the Pipeline Network Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The device of extracting energy from the water flow for pipeline network remote monitoring system based on a piezoelectric cantilever immersed in a water stream is considered in the paper. The water flow being in contact with the piezoelectric cantilever causes its oscillations and appearance of a potential on the plates of the piezoelectric element.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility of Vacuum Circuit Breakers with Electrical Equipment of Medium Voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of electromagnetic compatibility of vacuum circuit breakers with electrical equipment of medium voltage. Technical solutions are offered for the elimination of high-frequency overvoltage acting on the cables with cross-linked polyethylene insulation, electric motors and power transformers medium voltage at its switching with vacuum circuit breakers.

articleTitle: The Issues of the Bandwidth Resource and Quality of Service Control in the 5G Heterogeneous Networks with MFMAC-Protocol Using
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In that paper the possibility of using the multifunctional multiple access protocol MFMAC with 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> generation (5G) mobile networks for provision the required quality of user equipment`s' service with heterogeneous load. The dependency between frame format and input load intensity for the network with heterogeneous traffic load is derived by the authors. It brings the possibility to realize dynamic control of the frequency bandwidth resources in 5G networks.

articleTitle: Performance Peculiarities of Viterbi Decoder in Mathworks Simulink, GNU Radio and Other Systems with Likewise Implementation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The performance of convolutional codes decoding by the Viterbi algorithm should not depend on the particular distribution of zeros and ones in the input messages, as they are linear. However, it was identified that specific implementations of Add-Compare-Select unit for the Viterbi Algorithm demonstrate the decoding performance that depends on proportion of elements in the input message. It is conjectured that the modern commercial hard- and software defined communication equipment may also feature similar implementation and as such their decoding performance could also vary.

articleTitle: The Two-Channel Microwave Load Based on Planar Film Resistors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The design of high power wideband two-channel microwave load performed on basis of diplexer and planar film resistors is represented in this paper. The significant bandwidth increasing in comparison with one-channel matched microwave load design method was achieved because of application of lowering impedance transformation in high frequency diplexer channel.

articleTitle: Modeling of Thermomechanical Processes in the Electrode Material of the Plasmatron
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The associated thermoelasticity task including the equilibrium equations, the Cauchy relations and Hooke's law and the heat equation is used to study thermomechanical processes in an electrode under the action of an electric arc. The dynamics of the temperature and stressed states of the plasmatron electrode from the copper and tungsten was investigated and zones of possible brittle fracture of the material were identified. The obtained solutions showed that the high heating rates and rapid output to stationary mode characterize the electrode heating. The resistance of electrodes strongly depends on the thermophysical properties of the materials. It should be mentioned there is a sharp change in temperature along the electrode length in the area of the active zone (heating surface). An attribute of the temperature distribution are the considerable axial and radial temperature gradients, which can lead to the large thermal stresses in the electrode. The thermal action of the arc spot leads to alternating stress distribution in the wall thickness. The greatest danger is represented by the area of concentration of tensile normal stresses in the place of fixation, as well as near the core. Large thermal stresses can contribute to the formation of microcracks. The formation of cracks leads to the strong changes in the structure of the material and the distribution of the temperature in it and, as a consequence, to a decrease in the operability of the electrode.

articleTitle: The Virtual Demonstrations on the Course of Physics
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work consists the main results of the work of teachers and students of the Department of Physics on the creation of short animation clips that can be successfully used as an additional tool in the teaching process. The virtual demonstrations are collected on the Youtube channel and structured in various sections of physics and electrical engineering.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Heat Transfer in a Compact Heat Exchanger-Condenser with Variable Finning
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work presents the results of a numerical study of the effect of different combinations of geometrical factors changes on reduction of the heat-exchanger-condenser freezing surface area, including using of variable ratio of thermal resistances. The methodology for upgrading the previously developed application package and the initial results of its testing is described. The paper presents a methodology for the heat transfer calculating in a compact heat exchanger-condenser with variable finning. The results obtained with the modified methodology on the modes with constant finning coincide with the previous studies data on previously developed software packages. As a result of the research, it was found that the change in finning parameters significantly changes the temperature distribution of the heat exchange surface. In particular the change of finning along one of the tracts leads to a positive effect. The change of finnings along both tracts makes it possible to increase the surface temperature and reduce the freezing surface area.

articleTitle: Biotechnical System Stimulation of the Brain Neural Fields by Tactile Impact on the Receptor System for the Recovery of Motor Functions of a Human Body's Reactions After Stroke
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the biotechnical system, its functional, implementation and operating principle, and also examines the mechanisms of low-intensity current exposure to the skin of the index fingers to obtain practical results, which can later be used in the rehabilitation of post-stroke patients. The mechanisms of exposure are based on the physiological characteristics of the biological receptor systems of the human body, which are reflected in the section “theory”. This system intends to find its application in order to achieve therapeutic effects, development of medical techniques and algorithms of exposure in the rehabilitation of people who have suffered a stroke or cerebral infarction.

articleTitle: Using Fast Multipole Method for Magnetic Field Calculation in Complex System of Current Coils
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the approach to a magnetic field calculation, based on the fast multipole method. The implemented approach has been applied to the calculation of the magnetic field generated by a group of current coils of the electron cooling system of the charged particles accelerator. The analysis of computational costs and calculations accuracy of the multipole approach is given based on the obtained field calculation results for the system containing a large number of coils.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence of the Nanocrystal Si Embedded in the Dielectric CaF2 Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, photoluminescence from Si nanoclusters embedded in the dielectric CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> matrix and formed on the Si(111) substrate is demonstrated. Visible photoluminescence was clearly observed in a dark room at room temperature. The peak wavelength of the spectrum was a 664 nm and the full width at half maximum (FWHM) exceeded 150 nm. At a lower temperature (77 K), no photoluminescence was observed.

articleTitle: Method of Using Saturated Solution of Salts for Adjustment and Calibration Moisture Meter of Organic Liquids
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of using the method with the use of saturated solutions of salts for the preparation of samples of organic liquids of known moisture was investigated. It is shown existing methods known as mixing or bubbling with gas even a two-temperature method may not always be useful for obtaining samples of an organic liquid of known moisture due to their specific features, making them difficult to use. The following organic liquids were used for research: aviation kerosene, pentane, hexane, octane, toluene and benzene. During the experiments was to identify that selected salts do not dissolve in organic liquids samples. The verification of this result was carried out using the quartz crystal microweighing method. All the results obtained in the course of experimental studies were recorded by control devices. The proposed method using saturated solutions of salts for the preparation of organic liquids of known moisture can be suitable for adjusting and calibrating moisture meters.

articleTitle: A Numerical Simulation of the Photoelectric Pressure Sensor Optomechanical Unit
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper a numerical model of an optomechanical unit of a photoelectric pressure sensor consisting of a profiled silicon diaphragm with a rigid center, an additional die with a rigid center and an optical fiber is presented. Using the finite element modeling method, the conditions of maximum sensitivity of the deflection of the optical fiber free end from applied pressure depending on the size of the diaphragm and the positions of the rigid centers are investigated. The nonlinearity problems of the conversion characteristic of the optomechanical unit are considered.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Methods for Determining the Number of Bits of the Recursive Digital Filters Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article gives a comparative analysis of methods for determining the number of bits of the digital filter coefficients based on the error of the frequency response and the sensitivity function.

articleTitle: Studying the Regimes of Forming Carbonic Nano-Objects on Copper Island Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A brief review of catalytic vacuum synthesis of carbon nanoobjects on a dielectric substrate is presented. The authors argue that for the synthesis of carbon nanotubes during condensation from a vacuum arc discharge, it is advisable to use a copper layer as a catalyst on a dielectric substrate. The mechanism of synthesis of carbon nanotubes on a copper catalyst is described. The analysis of experimental data showed that the maximum yield of synthesized carbon nanotubes is achieved not on the solid copper layer, but on the island structure. The study is devoted to the study of modes of synthesis of the island structure of the copper catalyst and the identification of conditions for the synthesis of the island structure with a maximum perimeter of the Islands. It was found that the copper catalyst particularly contributes to the synthesis of single-layer carbon nanotubes. The level of undesirable impurities in the form of amorphous carbon and other types of carbon nanoobjects is quite low. In conclusion, recommendations on the optimal modes of synthesis of copper island catalyst on a dielectric substrate and methods of using atomic carbon on a copper catalyst from a vacuum arc discharge are proposed.

articleTitle: Noise-Resistance Algorithm of Navigational System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The algorithm of control signal modulation (transmission frame) and demodulation algorithm are elaborated in the article. The structure of receiving device is given. The article provides the results of mathematical and simulation modeling, which showed the advantages of the method elaborated over the well-known methods as the decreasing for several orders of the probability of wrong receiving.

articleTitle: Estimate of Turn-to-Turn Short Circuit Influence on an Induction Motor Operation Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to evaluation of influence level of turn-to-turn short circuit in one of rotor phases on induction motor operation quality. The modification of the classic mathematical model for currents and torque calculating in conditions of rotor circuit asymmetry is presented, and the results of numerical simulation of this mode are shown. Basedontheresultsobtained, criteriaallowedtoconcludethatitisadvisable to continue motor operation are pointed out.

articleTitle: Diffraction of Azimuthally Asymmetric Waves on Step Discontinuities in a Circular Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The general case of diffraction of nonsymmetrical TM vp and TEvp modes on irregularity in circular waveguide is discussed. The calculation is performed on the basis of the method of partial areas taking into account the features of the electromagnetic field at the metal edge. The high accuracy of the method is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Complex of Educational Laboratory Works “ Magnetic Resonance. Zeeman Effect ” for the Course of Quantum Physics
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The complex of educational laboratory works “Magnetic resonance. Zeeman effect” to the courses of atomic and quantum physics is presented. The theoretical and experimental parts of the complex are considered. The descriptions of the educational laboratory works on electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which are the part of the complex, are given.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Group Delay Time Correctors on the Basis of Two Types Directional Couplers
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A group delay time correctors on the basis of contra-directional and trans-directional couplers are considered. The formulas for calculating the frequency characteristics of the load resistors forming a given frequency dependence of the phase and group delay time are obtained.

Author Keywords: directional couplers based on coupled strip lines

articleTitle: New Method of GNSS Attitude Navigation Receivers Initial Alignment on the Customer's Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research represents the method of initial alignment of attitude navigation receivers that allows reducing by two or more times the time of initial alignment of attitude navigation receivers (ANR) on the customer's objects.

articleTitle: Two Multi-Branched Bridge Electric Chains
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The rationale for multi-branched bridge circuits with R-L and R-C identical additional branches is provided, with separate balancing and with the possibility of balancing only with the same type of adjustable counterbalancing elements.

articleTitle: High-Frequency Phase Calibrator Featuring Variation Automatic Frequency Control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Methods of construction of broadband phase calibrators. Evaluation of main characteristics of the suggested devices.

articleTitle: The A-H-Equivalent Circuit of a Synchronous Electric Machine with Tangential Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The cascade A-H-equivalent circuit of the salient-pole synchronous electric machine with tangential permanent magnet excitation is considered. The active link simulating the exciting field has been synthesized by a general solution of the partial differential equation on the base of the single piecewise continuous Sturm-Liouville eigenfunction.

Author Keywords: synchronous electric machines with tangential permanent magnet excitation

articleTitle: Conditions for Conducting Repair Work Under Voltage on Ultra-Compact Overhead Transmission Lines 110 kV
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the conditions for conducting repair work under voltage on double-circuit ultra-compact overhead transmission lines with voltage 110 kV. An analysis of the electric and magnetic fields near the wires is carried out, and the induced voltages values on the disconnected line circuit are determined. Technical solutions are proposed to ensure the safety of conducting repair work under voltage for overhead transmission lines of a new generation.

articleTitle: Signal-Adaptive Current Controller in the Cascade System of Rotor Radial Displacement Updating
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the equivalent transfer function calculation of signal-adaptive controller of the electromagnet excitation current, which is an inner control loop in cascade control system of automatic correction system of rotor radial position updating of micro electric drive, using in ultraprecision processing systems. A new approach of solving the problem of stabilizing the rotating element of motor, based on active current updating of the spatial position is offered. The calculation of automatic control algorithm is done using the method of signal-adaptive inverse model. The paper describes the way of constructive implementation of this method, structural synthesis methodology of control law, as well as the results of simulation, confirming potential of conducted research.

articleTitle: Creation of Software Product Supporting the Development of High-Tech Food Production of Functional & Special Purpose
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proves the necessity of developing a software product which could provide high-tech manufacturing of functional and specialized food products. The software product proposed in the paper will allow prompt computer modeling of the composition of food products, dishes and articlesof food with specified properties taking into account priority areas of research. A personalized approach to the population'snutrition based on individual food peculiarities lays down new requirements to digital technologies providing foodstuff manufacturing. The main potential consumers of the product under development are determined. The main parts of the software product performance specification are presented. Preliminary calculations of the cost of the proposed software product development are made.

articleTitle: Determination of the Efficiency of the Electric Field Shielding from a Pocket Personal Computer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The most common technical undertaking to ensure electromagnetic safety is shielding sources of electromagnetic radiation or defended objects. However, known shielding material do not provide reliable protection from electromagnetic radiation, and the most effective of them have a high price category. An easy-to-use and inexpensive device is offered, which allows to reduce the levels of electromagnetic radiation in a wide frequency range and is characterized by a reduced laboriousness of manufacturing. The results of measurements of levels of electromagnetic fields in a limited frequency range from the radiation source, which is shielded by various materials, are presented. Graphical dependences of the electric field shielding efficiency on the distance between electromagnetic radiation source and the meter for different shielding materials and frequency ranges are constructed. It is shown that the developed device provides high efficiency of electric field shielding. Therefore, this device can be used to normalize the electromagnetic environment at any municipal and industrial facilities in a non-aggressive environment.

articleTitle: Potential Complexity of Nanostructures with Limited Basis of Nanoelements Under Conditions of Organizing Factors and Interference
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper investigates the generalized potential complexity of nanostructures that can be achieved in the synthesis of nanostructures technology "bottom-up" of nanoelements under the action of various kinds of interference and restrictions. The values of the generalized potential complexity of nanostructures that can be synthesized in a limited set nanoelements with various parameters organizing factors and interference.

Author Keywords: the potential complexity of the generalized nanostructures

articleTitle: Expansion of Dynamic Range in Phase-Shifting Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers a new method for measuring wave fronts with large curvature. The method is based on the analysis of the trajectory of interference signals (multidimensional Lissajous figures) formed by the intensity values of various points in a series of interferograms obtained by the stepwise phase shift method. The dynamic range is increased by forming the difference phases, similar to the methods of shear interferometry and solving the system of equations equivalent to the system of equations that is obtained when solving the Poisson equation and the Dirichlet boundary conditions. In contrast to classical methods of stepwise phase shift, the proposed method does not require the determination of actual values of phase shifts, which makes it possible to increase the accuracy of measurements and significantly expand the scope of this measurement method. The method is verified by measuring the wave front, which has a height much higher than the wavelength of the laser radiation.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Radiation Without a Shift of the Frequency Comb with a Fixed Carrier Envelope Offset Phase
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method is proposed for realizing femtosecond radiation without a shift of the frequency comb with a fixed carrier envelope offset phase in the absence of a local oscillator laser.

articleTitle: Adjustable Weight Assigning Element for Multi-Sensor Data Transducer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This study establishes that the existing designs of weight assignment elements intended for use in optical communication systems do not meet precision, weight-size and reliability requirements for multi-sensor measuring transducers based on fiber-optic digital-to-analog (DAC) converter technology. To address this problem, we developed a design of a high-precision weight assigning element that may be used in multi-sensor data transducers.

articleTitle: The Urgency of the Threats of Attacks on Interfaces and Field-Layer Protocols in Industrial Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to analysis of condition of executing devices and sensors of Industrial Control Systems information security. The work contains structures of industrial control systems divided into groups depending on system's layer. The article contains the analysis of analog interfaces work and work features of data transmission protocols in industrial control system field layer. Questions about relevance of industrial control systems information security, both from the point of view of the information security occurring incidents, and from the point of view of regulators' reaction in the form of normative legal acts, are described. During the analysis of the information security systems of industrial control systems a possibility of leakage through technical channels of information leakage at the field layer was found. Potential vectors of the attacks on devices of field layer and data transmission network of an industrial control system are outlined in the article. The relevance analysis of the threats connected with the attacks at the field layer of an industrial control system is carried out, feature of this layer and attractiveness of this kind of attacks is observed.

articleTitle: CdSe Quantum Dots as White Light Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Properties of CdSe quantum dots are considered from the point of view of the order-disorder phase transition. It is shown that near this transition there is a dynamic structure of the quantum dots. Due to fluctuations of the order parameter, this structure is restructuring constantly. In turn, this event leads to fluctuations in the transition energy. The fluctuations are described thermodynamically. Using the order parameter allows to explain the influence of ligands on the nature of light emission by quantum dots in the colloidal solution. Properties of quantum dots of the core-shell type are also explained from the position of fluctuations of the order parameter.

articleTitle: Modeling the Performance of the Supercapacitor Battery for Car Start-Up
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper it was described various types of Supercapacitor technology, using for powering smartphones, tablets and electric transport systems. Parameters of energy storage devices were compared in terms of energy and cost efficient. The proposed battery technology is on the verge of carrying the revolution in road transport and energy storage of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Phase Current Curve Analyzing of Hysteresis-Synchronous Motor Powered with Autonomous Voltage Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Phase current curve and back electromotive force analysis results obtained for hysteresis-synchronous motor powered with autonomous voltage inverter are presented. The article shows filtering capabilities of a hysteresis-synchronous motor electromagnetic system applied in gyro-equipment for inertia navigation systems of stand-alone objects. A gyromotor phase current generation mathematical model for autonomous inverter commutation intervals is provided.

articleTitle: Short Phrase Speaker Identification in Noisy Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of speaker identification, which uses short phrases in noisy environment. The speaker identification in harsh conditions (short phrases, noisy environment) is an actual task, since it is in harsh conditions that the possibilities of the methods used in identification are manifested. Short phrases are characterized by a minimum content of informative elements (phonemes). Usually the duration of short phrases varies hundreds of milliseconds up to several seconds, which leads to certain difficulties in identifying a person by voice. As a method of extracting voice attributes, it is proposed to use the Morlet wavelet transforms. The speakers identification results obtained on basis of the k-nearest neighbors method are presented. Identification results were obtained on the basis of voice records from the database “Acoustic speech signals for the identity system by voice data.” Noisy conditions were formed by additive overlap of different noise levels on voice records. The most important types of noise in real conditions were used white noise, speech-like noise and street noise. The approach proposed is recommended to be used in identification systems with access control of information security.

articleTitle: Influence of Expert Estimation Function on Optimal Designing Results by Example of Transformer Calculation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with an optimal designing of electrical machines using the genetic algorithm by example of transformer design calculation. It is useful to operate an expert estimation function under an optimization. It is presented in the paper how factors of this function affect on optimization results.

articleTitle: Influence of Impurity Atom on the Width of Single Photon Superradiance in N Qubit System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We study the rate of superradiant emission for 1D N-qubit chain where N-1 qubits are identical and one impurity qubit has a different excitation frequency. It is shown that for relatively large frequency detuning between the impurity and other qubits in a chain, the impurity does not affect the width of superradiant emission for N-1 qubits. The transition from N qubit superradiant emission to that for N-1 qubits occurs in a narrow range of frequency detuning not exceeding one percent from the qubit excitation frequency.

articleTitle: Current Rate Changing Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The parameters of transition processes characteristics could be defined on oscillogram data obtained by means of remote monitors access received from a power section. Alsothis data helps to analyze protection operation and adjust setpoints. The article is focused on current rate changing analysisat different traction network operation modes.

articleTitle: Algorithms of In-Station Optimization in the Simulation Model of a Hydropower Plants Cascade
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the schematic diagram of mathematical model of Pamir's electric power system where cascades of hydroelectric power stations dominate in power generation. The problem of active power flow optimization between the hydropower units is considered in detail with the help of mathematical models purposely designed to address the problem. The algorithm based on the gradient decent method that provides optimal solution of the optimization problem in terms of water flow minimization is also presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Electro-Hydraulic Drive Systems in the MathCAD Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of investigation of a volume electrohydraulic drive in the environment of MathCAD allows to carry out investigations of dynamic conditions in cooperation of volume hydraulic drives with electric motors as a unique electro-hydraulic drive systems. Theory elements and results of computer experiments are stated.

articleTitle: Losses in a Superconducting Quarter Wavelength Coplanar Resonator
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we present results of the experimental investigation of quarter wavelength coplanar resonator at millikelvin temperatures. Also, a comparison with the data obtained from analytical expressions and from electromagnetic simulations is made. It is shown that the previously developed design methodology of such resonators is in a good agreement with real parameters of the system. It is experimentally shown that in the manufactured sample there are parasitic two-level defects, in fact objects of the quantum nature which presence explains small dispersion of the expected parameters. Their influence on the main characteristics of the system was studied.

articleTitle: Relative Permeability Curves Determination Using Numerical Inversion
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of relative permeability curves determination based on inversion of experimental data obtained in the laboratory studies of two-phase (oil/water) flow in porous media is considered in this paper. Investigation of the method is presented. Optimal parameters of equations describing relative permeability curves are determined using inversion of experimental data. The study has shown that relative permeability curves obtained using the method under consideration are in good agreement with analogous curves obtained using classical approaches and at the same time this method allows obtaining relative permeability curves over the entire range of the parameters changes and for the minimal experimental datasets.

Author Keywords: Multiphase fluid flow in porous media

articleTitle: Generalized Functional Model and Classification of Routing Methods in Multiservice Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of the current state of the routing in multiservice communication networks has been made. A new classification of methods of routing in communication networks has been developed. This classification gives an opportunity to reveal a variety of routing methods embodiments both serial and (multi-path) parallel.

articleTitle: Automatic Data Generation for Software Testing Based on the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Software testing is a fairly labor-intensive process, while not having obvious benefits and results, but being no less important than any other stage of the program life cycle. One of the main tasks of the testing phase is the development of initial test data that allows you to adequately evaluate the program code and find the most important parts of the program. Intelligent technologies, in particular, the genetic algorithm, allow you to determine the most informative data suite, that will fully assess the quality of the program and identify program errors. In this paper, we propose and investigate an approach for possible integration of a genetic algorithm and a system for generating test data.

articleTitle: The Novel Approach for Design of Initial Parameters of Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna with a Cardioid Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The modified representation of the magneto-electric dipole antenna is presented and analyzed by the method of space transformation. The one electric and one magnetic dipole can be properly combined to yield a cardioid-shaped pattern for linearly polarized electromagnetic waves. The shape and the half-power beam-width of the pattern are examined. This modified representation offers important advantages in prediction of the initial geometrical parameters to be used in full-wave electromagnetic optimization by proper solver such as “WIPL-D” “CST Studio Suite” “Ansoft HFSS” and so on.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Growth of Production Efficiency in Modern Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The considered numerical methods allow to fulfil optimization of metrological maintenance systems through knowledge of specific values of controlled parameters.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Comparing Methods of Skin Repair with a Burn
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Over the years, many methods have been developed for various types of burns, but in most cases these designs are introduced as a protective agent to cover and protect burnt tissue from bacterial infection, and not as a treatment. In this article, 3 cryotherapy methods were introduced and compared, cryotherapy is introduced not only as a protective agent, but also as a method of treatment, helping the tissue recover as quickly as possible. The main goal of this study is to simulate and compare the 3 cryotherapy methods to reduce the temperature of the burnt tissues of the human body in order to facilitate the healing and regeneration of tissues. The simulation was carried out by the finite element method, using a biological module that reproduces tissue perfusion. A comparative analysis of the three cryotherapy methods was carried out.

articleTitle: The Problem-Oriented Software of Electromagnetic Simulation for Development and Design the Wide Range of Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This chapter is devoted to a problem-oriented software of electromagnetic simulation for development and design the wide range of radio systems. The SONIIR experience to develop and apply the electromagnetic simulation software is considered.

articleTitle: Active Parametric Identification Stochastic Systems Using Walsh Functions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For stochastic linear continuous-discrete models with unknown parameters included to the equations of states and measurements, to the initial conditions and the covariance matrices of dynamics and measurement noises, the problem of active identification with the use of the input signal representation in the form of a linear combination of Walsh functions is solved.

articleTitle: Pulse-Resistive Neutral Grounding of Three-Phase Power Network and its Physical Model
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method of pulse high-resistance neutral grounding has been developed for power distribution networks. The grounding of the neutral grounding resistor occurs with intermittent ground faults when the neutral-to-ground voltage derivative (duN/dt) is high enough. The vast majority parameters of power networks are such that the voltage derivative at permanent earth fault (duN~/dt) is much less than at restriking one (i.e. duN/dt<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>>>duN~/dt). It allows effectively controlling resistive grounding mode of the network neutral and eliminating direct resistive grounding disadvantages caused by the increased fault current of the industrial frequency. The pulse resistive grounding efficiency is theoretically proved. A low-voltage physical model of power network with different methods of neutral grounding including pulse-resistive one is designed and manufactured.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Required Number of Handwritten Signatures to Form a Sample
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A problem of remote user authentication on the server using biometric data is observed. Two-factor authentication technique using the mobile devices is proposed. The method allows to use biometric features inseparable from owner of the device, characterized by the features of his handwriting. Number of signatures required for successful sample creation is evaluated.

articleTitle: An Analytical Model of Circular Elastic Element of the Pressure Sensor with Radial Compression Integrated into the Model
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A circular, hardly claimed isotropic elastic element is analyzed under the conditions of simultaneous effect of transverse mechanical loads and compressive mechanical stresses in the plane of this elastic element. An exact solution providing the distribution of strains is obtained. Some simplified equations defining the strains near the edge of the elastic element are obtained. Additionally, the similar equations are provided for the point of center of this element. All obtained analytical equations are practically convenient. An increasing of sensitivity of this elastic element after simultaneous application of the transverse load and compressive planar mechanical stresses is shown in this paper as well.

articleTitle: Recovery of Subvertical Target Objects Differently Placed Relative to Airborne Electromagnetic Survey Profiles in Complex Media
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the possibilities of the geometrical non-linear 3-D inversion for finding the subvertical target objects differently placed relative to airborne electromagnetic survey profiles in the conditions of laterally inhomogeneous overburden layers and significant changes of relief height and depths of subhorizontal borders between the geological medium layers. The mathematical model of geometrical non-linear 3-D inversion and approach to the parametrization of the geological model are presented. The results of 3-D inversion of synthetic airborne electromagnetic data show that the subvertical object can be detected in its different locations relative to airborne EM survey profiles.

articleTitle: Decrease in the Error at Elimination of Phase Ambiguity by Method of Equivalent Wavelength
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes a method for reducing the phase error in a multifrequency method for eliminating phase ambiguity in digital, including holographic, measuring systems. The proposed method involves obtaining a series of interference patterns with different wavelengths and decoding them by the phase shift method. Reduction in error is ensured by combining the integer values of the phase obtained for an equivalent wavelength with the averaged values of the phase of the original wavelengths, which allows to eliminate the effect of accumulation of errors and, accordingly, to reduce the overall error in determining the phase. This allows us to extend the range of applicability of the method for eliminating phase ambiguity when several wavelengths are used. The method was tested by deciphering test patterns with a given noise level. The method showed stability to phase and amplitude noise.

articleTitle: Organization of Noise-Resistant Radio Communication Under Conditions of Far North
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For overcoming the complex noise the authors suggest using the invariant equation that is true for any linear quadripoles and exactly - the ratio of relation of complex spectra at the input and output of any linear quadripole is a permanent magnitude. To solve the task stated the authors have elaborated the method of signal forming and its demodulation. The supercycle signal, cycle signal, timing signal, and the information signal, itself, are separated from the abovementioned formed signal. There are the testing results at the mathematical and simulation models which show the essential benefit in the noise-resistance of the offered system of communication in comparison with the traditional methods of the analogue schemes building.

articleTitle: Device for Stimulation of Hemopoiesis in the Human Body After Chemotherapy in Oncology
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the authors describe device for supporting bone-marrow hemopoiesis stimulation(DHS) of the human's organism using a magnetic field through amplitude modulating parameters and deviation of the basic frequencies of effect. The effect is performed on blood formation areas. In addition, the article contains DHS functional diagram and the software for the DHS unit control. The authors suggested algorithms for searching active frequencies and characteristics of frequency and amplitude modulation of the magnetic field that make it possible to increase amount of blood cells and test it on animals. Moreover, the article contains results of experiments conducted in intact animals.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Assessing the Possibility of Network Traffic Interception
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the most common information security problems is the network traffic interception in the transmission network from the sender's node to the destination node. As a result of this interception confidentiality of the transmitted data is violated. Not only a user of the network, takes losses, but also the network itself, as the attacker can disrupt its operation, which may lead to large costs of efficiency restoration.

articleTitle: A Powerful Single-Mode Diode Laser with Automated Control as the Source of Pumping of the Ytterbium Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A powerful single-mode distributed bragg reflector tapered diode laser with a low-noise automatic power supply has been developed. The output characteristics of the tapered diode laser are investigated. Using such laser as a pumping source, the free running mode of a Yb:KYW laser is obtained and investigated. It is shown that a compact precision femtosecond frequency synthesizer based on a Yb:KYW laser pumped by a diode laser of the similar type can be created.

Author Keywords: Distributed bragg reflector tapered diode laser

articleTitle: Electrooptics of Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystals and Holographic Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystals Doped Inorganic Oxides Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electrooptical properties of polymer dispersed liquid crystals have been studied, as well as the holographic and polarization diffraction gratings doped by inorganic nanoparticles of oxides Y2O3, CeO2:Y2O3, Nd2O3:Y2O3. The doping effect on electro optical properties of the composites on the base of nematic liquid crystals, times of response to the electrical impulse, and diffraction efficiency of the holographic gratings has been demonstrated. Nanoparticle doping results in the reduction of driving voltage. Nanoparticles CeO2:Y2O3 in the polymer dispersed liquid-crystal impose more intensive influence on the driving voltage reduction than N d2O3: Y 2O3 nanoparticles. Moreover, it is demonstrated that the diffraction efficiency of the holographic gratings doped by rare-earth elements particles reduces, whereas the efficiency of the polarization diffraction gratings rises.

articleTitle: Verification of Mathematical Models with Lumped Parameters of Hydraulic Elements for Numerical Simulation of Transient Processes in the Channels of Hydroimpulsive Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work is devoted to the verification of hydraulic components used in the program for calculating complex hy-droimpulsive systems. The components are composed of hydraulic elements with lumped parameters: one- and two-ports and contain inductance, resistance and capacitance. Their mathematical description consists of nonlinear algebraic and differential equations. Transient processes that occur when the piston is suddenly stopped (blow against the wall) or connection of channels at different pressures are investigated in a model of a hydraulic hammer system with two hydraulic chambers, including hydraulic components, a flow source, a striker, a gas-liquid battery, and a slide valve. Calculated oscillograms of the system's dynamic characteristics (pressure in the hydraulic components and the accumulator and displacement of the piston) are presented. The results of the calculations are compared with the experimental data obtained on the physical model of the hydraulic hammer device. The influence of the inductive component is shown and various approaches to its consideration in numerical simulation are analyzed. It has been established that it needs to be taken into account in order to obtain a reliable picture of processes occurring in hydroimpulsive systems, which is important in studying the dynamics of control devices that affect the stability of operating cycles. It is shown that in the study of the general integral properties of the system, it is possible to use models without inertial components, which greatly simplifies the calculation process, reduces the counting time.

articleTitle: Influence of Solar Flares on VLF Radio Waves Propagation Over JJI - Irkutsk Path
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses the impact of solar flares on the amplitude of VLF radio waves propagating along the JJI - Irkutsk path. It is shown how the amplitude of the 22.2 kHz signal responds on perturbations in mid-latitude ionosphere during solar flares in 2017. Continuous measuring of parameters of the sounding signal was performed using the designed in the Irkutsk National Research Technical University VLF receiver. Analysis of the results showed linear dependence of the amplitude response and variations of X-ray intensity.

articleTitle: Method of Connecting SEB NET-PATH to the Telecommunications Equipment of JSC Kazakhtelecom
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we consider the telecommunications network management system of branches based on the Irisngen hardware and software complex meets all the requirements and performs all tasks assigned to it, ensuring reliable monitoring of Karaganda's telecommunications networks. Telecommunication Management Network - a concept developed and approved by the International Telecommunication Union, defines the principles of creating a unified management system for networks of different levels and scales that provide different types of services. The possibility of using such a management system is due to the absence of a rigid binding of Telecommunication Management Network to any transport system and features of a particular network. All the information necessary for monitoring and control is located in a single database, which can be changed and updated with descriptions of new management objects, and all Telecommunication Management Network service data can be exchanged using the existing transport system of the managed network. Elements of Metro Ethernet Cisco network are represented by the following products: Cisco 7200 series routers, Cisco 7600 OSR optical router. The Cisco 7200 series includes two subseries: the Cisco 7200 and the Cisco 7200VXR. Cisco 7202, Cisco 7204 and Cisco 7206. These models provide installation of two, four and six modules (port adapters), respectively. In the special slot of routers of this series, the processor module NPE (Network Processing Engine) is installed.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Analysis Tools
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The classification of existing software for calculation of uncertainty is offered. The criteria of comparison of universal software are defined, the examples of developments relating to different groups are given.

articleTitle: Combination of Electric Corona Discharge and Gravity in Seed Presowing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper overviews directions for electrotechnology treatment of grain seeds before sowing. The hypothesis of the germination enhancement of seeds if treated with corona discharge is presented here. Besides, the description of electrotechnology installation and facilities for it including manufacturing process quality obtained as a result of scientific tests are also provided in the paper.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of Electricity Metro
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One problem of the metro power supply system is inefficient consumption of electrical energy, namely low quality indicators. The paper considers the main methods and ways for increasing the power factor of metro substations and their comparative analysis conducted by authors.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Possibility for Development of a Fast-Acting Capacitor Bank Based on Controlled Switching
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents investigations of transients at uncontrolled and controlled switching of a capacitor bank by a vacuum circuit breaker. It is shown that the use of controlled switching allows reducing transient currents and voltages to the values being sufficient for implementation of a fast-acting capacitor bank.

articleTitle: On the Stabilization of Hybrid Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of stabilization of some types of systems that are mathematical models of hybrid dynamic processes is considered. The results on the stabilization of discrete-continuous systems are presented. For a linear hybrid 2-D system in the scalar case, sufficient conditions for stabilization by a regulator which does not lead the system beyond the limits of a given class, are obtained.

articleTitle: Encoding of Information Generated by UnknownSource Without Memory with Infinite Alphabet
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of encoding of a source with an infinite, countable alphabet arises, for example, when compressing a sequence obtained by quantizing the results of orthogonal transformations of a random process [2]. Encoding of positive integers is also used in Ziv-Lempel codes [3].

articleTitle: Researching the Characteristics of Latex Particle Suspension Exposed to Nonuniform Alternating-Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Research techniques of bioparticle properties are being widely discussed by scientific society. The study reviewed the research technique of bioparticle properties by means of the “Biofizik” Measuring &Computing Complex (MCC) which is based on the principle of dielectrophoresis. In addition, the study contains the findings of performed experiments, confirming the accuracy of studies executed by the “Biofizik” MCC.

articleTitle: Multi-Arms Bridge Circuit with Extended Functional Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The extension of the functional capabilities of the multi-arms bridge electrical circuit is substantiated. It has kept separate balancing with impulse power supply and balancing with the same type of adjustable elements.

articleTitle: Adaptive Reinforcement Learning-Based Routing Protocol for Wireless Multihop Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a research on a topic of development of an adaptive packet routing scheme for wireless multihop networks, based on reinforcement learning optimization algorithm. A brief overview of classical approaches for data routing in multihop networks is provided, emphasizing main drawbacks of such algorithms, caused by ineffective hop count routing metric used in traditional multihop routing algorithms. Then, an approach based on reinforcement learning theory is presented, that has a potential to select more effective routes, relying on feedback information from neighboring nodes. An algorithm based on reinforcement learning optimization function is proposed, as well as additional functions are introduced for initial route weights distribution and dynamic route probability selection, depending from the current packet loss ratio (PLR) and receive signal strength indicator (RSSI) factors. The elaborated adaptive routing scheme then has been tested in real wireless multihop topology, where a programming implementation of the proposed algorithm - RLRP protocol, showed better routing performance characteristics in terms of PLR and RRT (Route Recovery Time), compared to a traditional improved proactive scheme of wireless multihop routing, implemented in widely used B.A.T.M.A.N. (Better Approach to Mobile Ad hoc Networking) protocol.

articleTitle: Considering AODV and OLSR Routing Protocols to Traffic Monitoring Scenario in FANET Formed by Mini-UAVs
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: With small UAVs (unmanned aerial vehicles) or drones having become widely accessible, new prospects were opened for applying them in event tracking, search and rescue operations, disaster recovery, and goods delivery. Flying Ad hoc Networks (FANETs) is a subdivision of a prominent Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET) paradigm. This paradigm deals with the multiple mini-UAVs deployment. FANETs are characterized by several specific features, when compared with other ad hoc network types. Moreover, they present some major challenges to the research community. One of them is the FANET routing protocol design. The protocol must be able to create an effective route between UAVs as well as to adjust it to the promptly changing topology in real time. In the present work, possible FANET application scenarios are described together with the existing mobility models for simulators, with special reference being made to flying devices and relevant realistic motion. Monitoring traffic is a potential field where FANETs may replace intensive labor and an involved observational infrastructure. All results were obtained experimentally. Simulation modeling based on ns-2 network simulator was applied as a research method. The study was made of AODV and OLSR routing protocols to choose the best one for mini-UAVs FANET.

articleTitle: Subjects Authentication Based on Secret Biometric Patterns Using Wavelet Analysis and Flexible Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article investigates the problem of reliable authentication tools construction based on secret dynamic biometric patterns of a subject. Developing such tools, it is proposed to use wavelet analysis of keystroke dynamics, handwritten and voice passwords, as well as hybrid neural networks that adapt to the characteristics of the biometric pattern of a person. The estimation of informativeness of the features, obtained using wavelet decomposition of dynamic biometric patterns with Haar, Daubechies, Morlet, Mayer, Shannon, “Mexican hat” and others bases, is given. The reliability of subjects recognition by features of voice, keyboard and handwriting in the process of secret and open biometric patterns reproduction is provided.

articleTitle: About Applying AODV and OLSR Routing Protocols to Relaying Network Scenario in FANET with Mini-UAVs
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Ad Hoc Network is one of the promising technologies for constructing communication networks. Self-organization principle underlies such wireless networks as WSN (Wireless Sensor Networks), MANET (Mobile Ad Hoc Networks), VANET (Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks), and FANET (Flying Ad Hoc Networks). FANET is concerned with the deployment of multiple mini-UAVs. FANETs possess some unique characteristics, if compared to other kinds of ad hoc networks, and develop some major challenges to the research community. One of the problems is designing FANET routing protocol. The protocol should form an effective route between UAVs and adapt it to rapidly changing topology in real time. The performance of AODV and OLSR routing protocols in mini-UAV ad hoc networks is investigated with ns-2 simulation tool. AODV and OLSR routing protocols were studied in the article to choose the best for flying ad hoc network of mini-UAVs. This article describes real possible FANET application of relaying network scenario and describes available mobility model for simulators. For the research purpose the network structure imitation model was built in ns-2.

articleTitle: Using the Numerical Optimization Method for Tuning the Regulator Coefficients of the Two-Wheeled Balancing Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article is devoted to tuning the regulator coefficients of the automatic stabilization system of a two-wheeled balancing robot. When calculating the regulator coefficients analytically, it is necessary to set the desired distribution of the system roots. This distribution can be defined based on general requirements for the quality of the system transient processes such as the maximum level of overshoot and the maximum duration of the transient process that define the sector in the complex plane within which the roots should be placed. But the issue of choosing the distribution within this sector remains open. This task becomes even more complicated if there are nonlinearities in real devices. It is shown that the root distribution in the form of Newton binomial gives not a good enough result because it is not possible to correct the transient process towards more speed or less oscillation on this case. The technique that allows tuning the coefficients of the regulator of the stabilization system by performing the numerical optimization procedure is proposed in the paper. In this case, it is possible to change the form of the transient process depending on the specific requirements for the system by changing the form of the cost function. The results of the work are confirmed by numerical simulation and experimentally.

articleTitle: Space-Time Probability Density of Detection of a Photon in Laser Beam of the Femtosecond Range
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main principles of the previously constructed photon quantum mechanics allowing one to calculate the probability density of detection of the photon using the its wave function in the coordinate representation both in classical experiments and in experiments with single photons are presented. The theory is supplemented by solving the Cauchy problem for the corresponding equation, to which the photon wave function satisfies. The results of modeling the photon wave function with Gaussian pulse distribution for femtosecond laser radiation are presented. It is concluded that for well-polarized radiation the probability density of photon detection is proportional to the envelope of the square of the “electric field strength”. The Young's interference experiment is explained from the point of view of photon quantum mechanics. It is claimed that the coherence of the radiation should be consistent with the “separation” of the wave function of the photon falling on the beam splitter in experiments with single photons. This statement substantially weakens the dilemma of wave-particle duality, but it sets new challenges for the further development of physics. It is emphasized that for their solution the new experiments are needed to identify the properties of the physical vacuum. The physical nature of the photon is discussed as a result of the propagation of a spin wave with Planck parameters in a physical vacuum.

articleTitle: The Information Task of “Calculating Technical and Economical Indexes” and its Concern with Assurance of Normal Operation of Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the nuclear power engineering, methods of detection failures and diagnostics, as well as systems of information support of operators in the order of improving the safety and reliability of the operation play an increasing role. A task that is solved within the information support system is the task of calculating technical and economical indexes and its connection with the assurance of the normal operation mode of nuclear power plants. The technical and economical indexes characterize the efficiency, faultness, and durability of the power equipment in its operation process. On the basis of the information task of calculating the technical and economical indexes, objective information on the technological processes run efficiency and actual power equipment is obtained. Conditions of optimal NPP performance are determined in the process of its technical and economical indexes analysis. So, the analysis of these indexes is one of the most important tasks of the NPP APCS. The information task of calculating the technical and economical indexes in the real-time on the basis of the intelligent data analysis and models of predicting the risk potential of the critical infrastructure will enable one to prevent approaching the technological process to critical modes.

articleTitle: Smart Phase Locking of the Frequency of Two Identical Lasers to Each Other
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the main aspects of ensuring phase-locked looping of two lasers to each other. This problem is extremely important for laser physics. In traditional systems, this binding was carried out by using two circuits, namely frequency tuning and phase tuning. The tuning loop provides capture conditions, but in capture mode, it interferes with the operation of the phase loop and reduces the accuracy of the entire system. In addition, this solution is unnecessarily cumbersome, which increases the cost of the system and complicates its implementation, configuration and use. The proposed technical solution is based on the use of other types of phase detectors, namely, frequency-phase detectors. To be able to use them, a pulse shaper must be introduced into the system, which converts the input harmonic signals containing amplitude modulation and high frequency noises, and probably, low-frequency noise, to standard fixed-level signals with sharp edges. In this case, the propagation of fronts due to the remnants of high-frequency noise is strictly unacceptable, which requires the use of a Schmitt trigger, and for its effectiveness requires a relatively constant amplitude of the input signal. If this is not the case, an automatic level stabilization system is required. All these changes in the aggregate are still simpler than using two auto tuning circuits. In addition, it provides great ease of implementation, customization and use.
