The designed unit is designed to work as a component of the hardware-software complex of nondestructive testing of reciprocating- machine. The electrical part of the unit, with the exception of temperature sensors, is housed in a sealed housing made of oil-resistant material. The unit is powered by a galvanic battery with a capacity sufficient to operate the device continuously for twelve months.

articleTitle: A Stabilized Algorithm of Nonparametric Identification for a System with High-Level Noise Measurement of Input Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the problem of nonparametric identification of a dynamical system is solved. The mathematical model of a system is represented by the Voltaire integral equation of the first kind. This is the ill-posed problem because Hadamard's conditions are not met. In this case, it is usually considered that the input signal of the identified system is accurately specified, and the output signal is recorded with a random error. However, such a requirement is rarely satisfied in practice, since both the input and output signals of the system are measured and recorded by measuring instruments of the same accuracy class. Consequently, both the input and output signals are specified with random measurement errors. In this article, a new regularizing identification algorithm based on the discrete Fourier transform is constructed. The algorithm takes into account the high noise level of the input signal as in the construction of the regularized solution well as in the choice of the regularization parameter. An iterative algorithm for calculating the discrete Fourier transform coefficients of a regularized solution is proposed. This algorithm has a high rate of convergence. The choice of the regularization parameter is based on the verification of statistical hypotheses. This approach allows estimating accurately the optimum value of the parameter even there is a large measurement's noise level of the input signal. The researches of this algorithm showed its higher accuracy then similar algorithms, which do not take into account the noise of the input signal measurement. The proposed algorithm can be generalized for a stable solution of the Fredholm equation of the first kind with an ill-defined kernel.

Author Keywords: Volterra integral equation of the first kind

articleTitle: Construction of Adapted Three-Level Model of Control Processes of Information Security System of Critical Information Infrastructure Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Critical information infrastructures in the Russian Federation need to be updated in a timely manner in order to avoid the implementation of various security incidents. The authors proposed an algorithm that allows to make timely decision- making by simulating the processes of the systems. Modeling of the system allows to evaluate the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Effective Use of Supercapacitor Batteries for Urban Electric Transport
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the calculations to determine the main parameters of the storage device of a supercondenser are carried out that meet the requirements of using it for the urban electric transport system.

articleTitle: Dependence of Wages on the Duration of Training and Length of Service in the Russian Economy Sectors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper studies an influence of such characteristics of human capital as the duration of training and length of service on wages of workers in the Russian economy sectors. It is shown that in 2016, industries whose development under current conditions greatly depends on the human capital of the highest level as a rule do not attract specialists as the accumulation of human capital leads to a fairly low wage growth.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of Salt Reserves Simulation Model by AnyLogic Software Package
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article raises the issue of salt reserves depletion in Ishimbai region of the Republic of Bashkortostan. To forecast this issue, it is proposed to develop a simulation model of salt reserves depletion in AnyLogic software package which takes into account factors that affect this depletion. With the help of these factors, it is possible to simulate the process of salt extraction with the display of depletion dynamics of these reserves in tabular and graphical form over the years, and also see how along with this parameter the well productivity, the number of commissioned wells, the number of conserved wells and other important parameters would change. Based on the initial data and derived mathematical dependencies, the remaining salt reserves and the number of working and conserved wells for 40 years were predicted. According to the obtained data, dependence diagrams of the number of working wells versus time for different values of salt reserves were constructed, and it was predicted for how many years there would be enough salt reserves from the number of wells being developed.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Routing in Conditions of Input Self-Similar Traffic and External Destructive Influences on Elements of a Multiservice Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The spectrum of routing methods that could be applied to communication networks is very broad-from simple, fixed procedures to rather complex ones (1). Each of them has its advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Formation of the Charge and Current Densities Waves Under the Decay of Quasistationary States of a Quantum-Size Single-Barrier Heterostucrures
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is considered the nonstationary emission of electrons from heterostructure as a result of the scattering of the Gaussian electronic wave packet. It is shown that the generation of propagating waves of charge and current densities can be realized outside the system as a result of a quasistationary states excitation in a heterostructure by a pulsed electron source. The results of numerical simulation of the formation of charge and current density waves outside the heterostructure and analytical and analysis of their spectrum by frequency and wavelength are presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Broadband Distributed Impedance Transformers with Predetermined Phase Response
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Synthesis of a broadband active impedance transformer with a phase response corresponding to a second order lattice X-section in a distributed elemental basis based on the previously presented method for the synthesis of broadband matching devices with predetermined phase response is considered in this paper. As a result of synthesis, the y-matrix of the broadband transforming two-port network is obtained. The functions of its own parameters represented in the form of Foster. Applying various conditions of circuit realizability in the synthesis process, we obtained structures convenient for realization on microwave on regular transmission lines, one of which is investigated at various parameters of a given phase response. As a result of the research, it is found that the structure has a wide ability to reproduce the phase response of a second-order lattice X-section with different parameters, and also reproduce the linear phase response characteristic while maintaining an acceptable level of the power conversion coefficient in a given frequency band. Thus, the efficiency of the previously proposed method of synthesis of broadband matching devices with predetermined phase response is demonstrated, and also the possibilities of active impedance transformers on regular transmission lines are shown.

articleTitle: Providing of Smooth Switching of Sine Signals for Precision Frequency Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Laser systems are widely used to create highly stable frequency standards, as well as for absolute frequency measurements. One of the most important components of such systems is a precision frequency synthesizer. Despite the fact that there are many ready-made developments in this area, most of them do not meet the highest requirements for such synthesizers in terms of smooth frequency switching without any jumps in the phase or amplitude. Modern developments in this area are sometimes too complicated. Simplification of such devices while providing these characteristics lies in the ways of abandoning the phase subsystems of auto-tuning in the intermediate nodes of such systems, replacing it with simple switches of different frequencies, depending on the value of the frequency that is required to synthesize. However, the switching of signals of different frequencies inevitably must cause jumps in the generated signal at the moment of switching. This approach seems to contradict the task posed. This paper investigates ways of solving the problem of smooth switching of signals in such a way that the frequency undergoes a change at the output of the switch, but there would be no phase jumps in the generated signal. An analysis of the ways of solving this problem is given, a functional diagram for the switch providing the required smooth switching is provided, reliable and correct operation of the switch is confirmed by the results of the simulation.

articleTitle: Fischer Information Matrix Modeling for Accuracy Increase of Parametrical Identification in the Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The modeling procedure of Fischer information matrix in the Simulink environment is considered on the example of the second order dynamic object in this work. The construction of Fischer information matrix is organized in the form of the several levels blocks. The each block corresponds to the certain formula entering the scheme of Fischer matrix formation. The least-square recurrent method is used for the determination of unknown parameters for the dynamic object. The behavior schedule construction of the parameters estimates for an input signal like a meander is executed. The convergence schedule of the gain coefficient is provided.

articleTitle: Using Solid Electrolyte Cells to Measure the Partial Pressure of Oxygen in High-Altitude Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The present report reviews the description of an oxygen analytical solid electrolyte cell with a sealed gas comparative medium that can be successfully used in an oxygen analyzer in high-altitude aircraft. It is shown that the method can be used in the design of a mass-produced gas analyzer. The success of this equipment depends on the continuous monitoring of the oxygen partial pressure. The operation of the oxygen-producing unit is based on a measurement method based on the use of a measuring potentiometric solid electrolyte cell. Its main difference from other similar cells is that it uses a gas mixture with comparative partial pressure of oxygen as a comparative medium, which is in a sealed comparative chamber. The comparative medium is prepared using the same electrolyte cell, but operating in coulometric mode. The comparative environment is periodically renewed. It is shown that this method can be used in the design for the production of a gas analyzer as a serial model.

articleTitle: Simulating the Process of Oil Production from Stripper Wells in IThink Software Package
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In recent years, the oil industry has been subject to negative trends. Exploration and production drilling has significantly decreased, thereby reducing the number of new deposits being developed. Despite all negative factors, the oil industry continues to operate, but for this purpose already operated deposits with low production rates are used. Stripper wells in the current circumstances are unprofitable, but termination of their operation causes damage through irreversible losses of non-reproducible hydrocarbon feedstocks in the bowels of the earth. This article considers the development of a model of the oil production process from stripper wells in iThink simulation software package. The data from Ishimbay oil field were used as initial data.

articleTitle: Optimum Nominal Method for the Best Scenario Choice
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: At a design stage of complex technical systems there is a problem of the best development scenario choice which minimizes emergence of risk situations. For her decision it is offered to use optimum nominal efficiency function. The task is solved in two stages. At first, it is necessary to develop multiple implementations of each scenario. At the second stage it is necessary to carry out several series of pulse modeling, then to group scenarios on pessimistic and optimistic. The introduction of the optimum nominal efficiency function will allow to formalize process of selecting the best evolution scenario in the design stage in fuzzy cognitive models. This function will complement expert methods and selection under the conditions of interval uncertainty and fuzzy basic data.

articleTitle: Automatic System for Modeling of Forming, Receiving and Processing Radar Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper was described automatic system for modeling of forming, receiving and processing radar signals. In system are modeling movement trajectories of aircrafts which based on Bezier curves. The model takes into account the movement of the transmitting and receiving directional diagram of the radar antenna. Based on trajectory and movement of the beam are forming reflected chirp signal. In the paper was described software model of the automatic monitoring system. For designing system was used measurement equipment and software from National Instruments.

articleTitle: Aggregate Factors of Switchings and Integrated Voltage Harmonics of Three-Phase Multilevel Voltage Source Inverter with Nearest Vector Selecting Space Vector Control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the model of the nearest vector selecting space vector control (SVC) of any arbitrary MLVSI circuit with any arbitrary number of any equal feeding DC voltage levels. Using the LabViewsimulation results for instantaneous SVC, the aggregate factors of switchings and integrated voltage harmonics (ASIHF) dependences on phase voltage amplitude modulation index are obtained and compared with the corresponding results of the quarter-wave symmetric space vector PWM (SVPWM).

Author Keywords: integer and fractional parts of delta voltages relative values
n-order aggregate switchings and integrated voltage harmonics factors (ASIHF)

articleTitle: Networks Based On Periodical Fragmentations in Broken Symmetry Group Model
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article networks clustering methods based on a plane (space) symmetry fragmentation variants will be considered; routing in these networks based on broken symmetry groups (BSG) will be analyzed. A method for structuring a sensor network with a method clustering based on symmetry.

articleTitle: Backward Volume and Surface Magnetostatic Modes Identification by Distributions of Radio Frequency Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The technique of identification of spin-wave modes in a rectangular yttrium iron garnet (YIG) films is presented. The experimental structure consisted of a YIG film placed on a microstrip transmission line has been studied. To analyze this electrodynamic problem CST Microwave Studio based on finite element method was used. While simulating this structure, frequency dependencies of insertion loss and return loss have been analyzed and compared to the ones obtained experimentally. Modes identification was performed by visualizing magnetic fields distributions at the resonant frequencies. Every mode was described by the numbers of half-wavelengths along corresponding direction.

articleTitle: Multimedia Support for Physics Laboratory Works in Groups with Auditory Constraints
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of using multimedia teaching resources to have students with auditory constraints working independently on preparations for the front laboratory works on the course "Physics" of the technical university is considered in this article. Recommendations for designing and implementing how-to videos to the laboratory works for students with hearing impairments are described.

Author Keywords: deaf and hard of hearing students

articleTitle: Systems and Algorithms of Work for Protecting Electric Traction Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper reviews the electric traction network analysis, the distinctive features of its functioning, innovative switching to digital protection, the first results of trial operation, proposals for further improvements using the monitoring and the level increase of the automation operating system of the traction feeder network.

articleTitle: Single-Wire Resonant Transmission Line Tesla
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents an experimental material on the single-wire resonant transmission line Tesla. On the basis of the stated material the direction of further researches on this subject is formulated.

articleTitle: The Unsteady Natural Convective Heat Transfer in a Vertical Flat Layer of Liquid After Sudden Heating of the Bottom
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of numerical simulation of flow evolution and unsteady conjugate natural convective heat transfer in a high vertical cavity with massive walls of finite heat conductivity after sudden heating of the bottom of the region are presented. The outer surfaces of the vertical walls are thermally insulated. On the inner surfaces of the walls defined the condition of perfect thermal contact, i.e. the continuity of the fields of temperature and equal heat fluxes. After heat is supplied to the bottom of the cavity, an upward flow of hot liquid is formed, which oscillates between the walls, alternately touching and reflecting from them. To meet the upward flow as periodically and in time, and in space vortices of cold liquid fail. As a result, a heat wave starts to run in massive vertical walls.

articleTitle: Investigation of Physics Fields Distributions in Prostate Gland During Transrectal Treatment Instanced by Phantom and Biological Model
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results on investigation of physics fields (used in the device developed in NSTU-NSMU inter-university laboratory for medical electronics) distributions in prostate gland during transrectal treatment instanced by phantom and biological model are represented. Investigations of the ultrasonic and thermal effects were carried out in the phantom made of the base of gelatine solution; of the laser radiation and magnetic field - in the biological model (muscle of cattle). The pictures of the physics fields distributions in the prostate gland are presented as isolines. It is shown that the device provides spatial combining of the influencing factors, temporal combining is ensured by simultaneous use of all the influencing factors. The obtained pictures of the physics fields prove the possibility of using the device for development of new procedures for treatment of a chronic prostatitis in a specified area of a prostate gland (according to data agreed with the leading urologists of Novosibirsk).

articleTitle: Retracted: Scalar and Bitorsion Biofields of String Volume Resonators Aura
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An attempt was made to involve the mathematical apparatus of the theory of scalar and binary fields with the explanation of the mechanism of quantum resonances in volume resonators of human biofields using string theory. The attempt is based on the identity of an equilateral hyperbola describing the relationship between the intensity of the magnetic field and the dynamics of the behavior of the center of displacement of the human spinor motion, which is well known to the stability diagram of two-mirror volume resonators with hyperbolic mirrors. Geometric visualization of the two-torsion field in the form of a cross of two cardan non-synchronous rotating shafts passing through input-output holes of pairwise connected pseudospheres is obtained. Lobachevsky, whose shells are natural obstacles to the wave processes passing inside the resonators. Guide pseudo-spheres are associated with strings on the surface of the associated bells, laid from the top to the bell rings of the bells. With the use of Vedic knowledge in the language of field theory, interpretations of such concepts as the wheel of Samsara, the chakra and the caduceus are given. A hypothesis of the emergence of love between a man and a woman as a discharge between virtual charges of different signs with simultaneous quantum resonance in all three-dimensional cavities of chakras is proposed.

articleTitle: Power Consumption Measuring Method of the Battery-Operated Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method of the battery-operated electronic devices power consumption measurement has been developed. Proposed method allows to estimate the device operating time from one set of batteries. The method is based on the analysis of the large capacitor discharge by the electronic device powered from it. Simple measuring setup for measurement is used. Setup consists of a constant current source, a large capacitor composed of several parallel electrolytic capacitors and a digital oscilloscope. Results of the power consumption measurements and average current consumption measurement accuracy estimation is presented.

articleTitle: Information Processing About the Dynamic Object in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this work for the unknown parameter determination of the fourth order dynamic object the possibility of giving the test signals on the system input is supposed. As test signals the sinusoidal signal and a signal like a meander are used. Formulas for the calculation of Fischer information matrix are given in the steady state that allows to simplify mathematical ratios significantly. The recurrent scheme modeling of a least-squares method in the Simulink environment is executed. The received results are presented on schedules.

articleTitle: Detection of Hidden Images Based on Contrast of Intensity Distribution of Terahertz Radiation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the possibility of using of backward-wave oscillator (BWO) terahertz (THz) system for detecting of hidden images is presented. THz image of a hidden test logo behind an optically opaque sheet at frequency 0.9 THz is obtained. Based on the intensity contrast filtering, the technique of drawing the logo image on the paper surface is shown.

articleTitle: Features of Estimation of Resistance of Separate Grades of Wheat to Influence of Various Stress Factors on Change of Biological Potentials
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experiments on measurement of biological potentials of separate grades of wheat in the conditions of influence of the most typical stress factors are discussed: the increased and under temperature, salinization of the soil, influence of herbicides and toxins, existence of sporous diseases of cereals. The purpose of researches is the choice of informational and significant parameters of the measured signals that allowing to estimate resistance of concrete grades to influence of the listed stress factors. As a result of the conducted researches it was shown that for different types of stress factors various parameters of signals are informative, at the same time their statistical characteristics improve at multi-fold carrying out an experiment with one sprout. At the same time numerous influence of unstable elevated temperature can lead to death of a sprout owing to what multiple carrying out experiments demands automation of process of formation of temperature influences.

articleTitle: Efficient Stream Cipher with Theoretically Proven Properties
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we present the new stream cipher based on the Shannon's algorithm, which cryptographic properties have been theoretically proved in 2016 by B. Ryabko. Here we describe the method of applying this algorithm for stream encryption in modern information systems. In addition, the paper presents the results of an experimental study of cryptographic properties of the practical implementation of this method.

articleTitle: New Steganalysis Method for Text Data Produced by Synonym Run-Length Encoding
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article we present a new method of stegoanalysis revealing the text produced by the synonym runlength encoding steganography. During this research, it was shown that RLE embedding method changes statistical structure of extracted message and this fact could be used for stegoanalysis. In the constructed method we compare the probability distribution of runs (with length no more than 5 bits) in the message extracted from the analyzed container with reference distributions corresponding to empty and filled containers. The Kullback-Leibler measure is used as a divergence measure of two probability distributions. It was shown that the proposed method makes it possible to detect a secret message in the container having 500 synonyms, while the false negative error is 1.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and the false positive error is 1.3%. In comparison with known analogs, the proposed method has higher accuracy of steganalysis with smaller size of input data.

articleTitle: The Problem of Electromagnetic Torque Ripples in Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The effect of the current phases shape of the stator winding on the electromagnetic torque of a synchronous motor with a modulated magnetic flux and a smooth harmonic rotor was studied, as a result of the study the ripples of the maximum electromagnetic torque were found, which amounted to 7.36<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> of the mean value of the torque. It has been proposed to introduce a modulating coefficient in the form of a harmonic series in the law of changing of the phases current of the stator winding, allowing to correct the ripples of the maximum electromagnetic torque to 0.28% of the mean value.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Inhomogeneous Cylindrical Focusing Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For inhomogeneous permittivity along cylinder radius the two methods of electrodynamics analysis was developed. The methods have high accuracy and small needing computer resources. Synthesis of cylindrical focusing structures was made.

articleTitle: Research of the Noise Immunity when Using Fractional Frequency Reuse in Mobile Satellite Service
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The investigation of the directivity pattern side-lobe level impact of the concentric ring antenna arrays to noise immunity of the receiver when using fractional frequency reuse was provided. The frequency planning of radio networks is necessary instrument to address issues of assigning frequency bands for mobile satellite service in conditions of limitations of frequency and energy resources. Only frequency planning allow to achieve high level of efficiency of bandwidth assigned for network. The concept of equivalent cluster dimension was introduced, which characterize the work of the spatially separated antenna beams in combined channels. Demands on the side-lobe level of satellite transponder antenna arrays were described and data throughput was calculated based on Signal Interference Noise Ratio.

articleTitle: Ensuring Measurement Accuracy of Grounding Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The accuracy of measuring parameters of a grounding device depends, first of all, on the degree of protection of a grounding meter from the effects created by an electrical installation and a measuring circuit. The report considers such factors as asymmetry current of an electric network, direct currents in the earth, magnetic influence of a current measuring circuit on a potential measuring circuit, resistance of an auxiliary current and potential electrodes. A scheme for grounding meter verification, taking into account external influences, is proposed.

articleTitle: Determination of Insulation Heating with Registration of the Cable Lines Joint Wiring
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with heating of the cable lines insulation, which is one of the main factors determining its condition. To study the thermal process, which has a random character, we have analyzed the statistical data of various heating factors: the load current, the reverse sequence current of the fundamental frequency, the currents of the higher harmonic components, as well as the interharmonic components. It is shown that the heating temperature largely depends not only on the current flowing through the cable, but also on the presence of higher current harmonics, and also on the number of cables laid side by side in the same trench. It is proposed the method taking into account during temperature calculation the thermal influence of the cables laid side by side. The result shows that the heating temperature of the cable increases with simultaneous laying and the proposed method makes it possible to estimate such increase in temperature in order to avoid heating the cables above the permissible value, especially taking into account the possibility of the higher current harmonics flow through the cable.

articleTitle: Diagnozing of Electric Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The determination of the current technical resource of the electric transport system is an important characteristic that allows one to define not only the current reliability of the system, but also to predict it for the future. If the maintenance of electrical equipment is carried out to restore the reliability, failure flow is not stopped, then the intensity of equipment failure will be artificially overstated. The timing of service impacts will also be overstated unsuccessfully.

articleTitle: Determination of the Brillouin Frequency Shift Depending on the Strength of the Optical Fiber Tension
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article justifies the need to determine the tension of the optical fiber (OF) in the operated communication cable. The conditions leading to cable failure are determined. A solution of this problem is proposed with the help of Brillouin reflectometry. The dependence of the change in the Brillouin frequency of the scattered light on the magnitude of the force applied to the OF is found. The dependence of the relative elongation of OF on the magnitude of the force applied to it is found. A graph of the dependence of the change in the frequency of the scattered light on the magnitude of the force applied to the OF is plotted. The dependencies found can be used for designing and calculating distributed fiber optic sensors.

articleTitle: Radiation-Convective Heat Transfer from Crystals in Vertical Directional Crystallization Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Numerically in with conjugate formulation the radiation-convective heat transfer from the crystals in the Czochralski method, Stepanov method and floating zone method is investigated. The calculations are performed in the ranges of Grashof numbers from 1000 to 25000, with the gas Prandtl number equal to 0.68. Calculations of convective heat transfer were carried out by finite element method, calculations of radiation fluxes were carried out by zonal method. The relative role of thermal conductivity, convective heat transfer and radiation heat transfer is investigated.

articleTitle: Plastic Deformation of Tungsten Carbide of a Hard Alloy and its Destruction During Reinforcing Finishing Treatment with an Ultrasonic Tool
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The working capacity of indenters made from hard alloy VK8 under conditions of reinforcing finishing treatment with ultrasonic tools was investigated. The morphology of the surface of the wear pad and its state after cobalt (Co) etching-out was studied using electron microscopic methods. It was determined that at low processing speeds the boundaries of the WC appear clearly, which is associated with intense interfacial slip and destruction along these boundaries. When the treatment speed reaches 50 m/min and above, the WC boundary is lubricated, which is caused by intensive plastic deformation of cobalt and destruction on this phase. It was shown that the wear of the carbide tool VK8 mainly occurs as a result of fatigue failure and the curve of wear versus the processing speed has a nonlinear character. It was found that along with plastic deformation of cobalt at small and medium processing speeds, plastic deformation by sliding takes place in some tungsten carbides WC. Slip bands are thin and extended within single carbide only. The expansion of the slip bands is impeded by the high fragility of tungsten carbide. The slip bands lie at a depth not exceeding 0.6 μm, The destruction of tungsten carbide along the slip bands with a slight expansion of them is extremely rare. At processing speeds of 80, 120 m/min, no slip bands are observed, apparently, the temperature in the friction zone reached at these speeds is sufficient for processes such as polygonization.

articleTitle: Determination of the Phase Angles Synchronizing Backup Power with Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article defines the allowable synchronization phase angles of backup power and powerful synchronous motors, provided that the dynamic stability. This condition is also used to optimize the value of the synchronization phase angle. The obtained results can be used to select and configure automation devices. The results of field tests are presented.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of Diesel Starter of Start Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A mathematical description of electrical starting system of diesel motors was designed in the paper and a startup process simulation of the diesel motor in the MatLAB Simulink was run.

articleTitle: Modeling of an Electro-Optical Modulator Based on the Quantum-Confined Stark Effect in an InA1GaAs Double-Layered Waveguide on the in P Substrate
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the design and results of the numerical simulation of an electro-optical modulator based on the quantum-confined Stark effect (QCSE) in InAlGaAs layered structures with the multiple quantum wells (MQW) on the InP substrate. The new design includes the use of the double-layered rib waveguides that can provide a technological and efficient coupling with the optical fiber.

articleTitle: Features of Power Equipment Operation with “Distorting” Loads
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The aim of the work is to study and analyze the emergence of resonant modes in modern power supply systems caused by an increase in the number of consumers, rectifying loads. This causes harmonic distortion of currents and voltages which negatively affects the performance of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Use of the Fuzzi Inference System for Evaluation of the Cable Lines Insulation State
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the evaluation of the cable lines insulation state of various electrical networks. It is shown that the isolation state is influenced by the large number of factors, some of which are indeterminate and can not be expressed in the quantitative form. Modeling the impact of different types of load on the insulation of cable lines is difficult to formalize, since there is a variety of these loads and it is quite difficult to take into account the impact of various external factors. Solving such problems, the use of the fuzzy logic apparatus, which allows more fully to take into account all the mechanisms acting on the insulation of loads and external conditions, is very effective. It was proposed to use the fuzzy inference system to assess the state of isolation, which ensures processing of both quantitative and qualitative information, that allows obtaining more valid results, in comparison with the use of only quantitative information.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Forces Design Algorithm for Magnetic Systems with the Tooth-Slot Zone
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the investigation of magnetic conductance derivative in compressor linear magnetic system tooth-slot zone operating air gaps. The total magnetic conductance maximal component is found. The investigation results permit to simplify further design and selection of a magnetic system with the tooth-slot zone that provides maximal traction force.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic Parameters of Synchronous Geared Electric Machines with Massive Magnetic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of the concept of equivalent conductivity of the air gap in a synchronous geared machine the analytical solution for electromagnetic field in the active zone has been found. It takes into account the influence of eddy currents in the massive magnetic circuit on the electrodynamic (inductive) parameters, the moment of the motor, and the output characteristic of the generator. The obtained generalized frequency dependencies can be used for geared machines engineering and operating in low-speed electric drives.

articleTitle: Calculation Peculiarities of the Converting Unit Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the calculation of the digital protection setpointfor converting unit (rectifier, controlled rectifier, inverter) from external and internal damages.

articleTitle: Differential Evolution for Multi-Variant Evolutionary Synthesis of Nonlinear Models
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We propose a new multi-variant evolutionary algorithm based on differential evolution for solving the problem of construction of nonlinear models (mathematical expressions, functions, algorithms, and programs) using the given experimental data, sets of variables, basic functions and operations. We compare the proposed algorithm with the standard genetic programming algorithm (GP) and the Cartesian Genetic Programming (CGP) one. We show that the proposed algorithm exceeds the GP and CGP algorithms both in the time required for search for a solution (more than by an order of magnitude in the most cases) and in the probability of finding a given model.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of Infrasonic Waves Propagation Through Vegetation into Ground
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the processes of propagation the infrasonic acoustic waves in the lower atmosphere are investigated if a vegetable layer is presence. Analysis can carry out using 2D-simulation (instead 3D-simulation) due to enough large distance of from a source to forest massif. A three-layer model “Air-vegetation layer-ground” is considered. Authors study the problem of an interaction the acoustic waves falling at a given angle on the ground with vegetable layer and seismic waves arising in the ground. A question about the vegetation influence to amplitudes of the acoustic and seismic waves excited in the ground is investigated. The influence of a friction coefficient to the attenuation velocity of the acoustic oscillations in the vegetation is also estimated. An algorithm and a program for calculation the acoustic pressure levels in different media using wave equations for air, Euler's gas dynamics equations for vegetable layer and elasticity equation for the ground have been implemented and realized.

articleTitle: To the Questions of Energy Efficiency of Autonomous Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the question of increasing the energy efficiency of generators which rotates from an internal combustion engine intended for remote agricultural consumers, and designed to generate a voltage of different level at a constant frequency of rotation or to maintain a constant voltage level at different frequency of rotation.

Author Keywords: diesel power plants with different frequency of rotation

articleTitle: Dynamic and Energy Performances of Voltage Active Converter at its Operation on Elevated Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For a three-phase voltage active converter, when it is supplied from an ideal 400 and 800 Hz network, a relay current control system is designed. The system provides control of the network currents and their phase shift relative to the network voltages, as well as stabilization of the output voltage at the levels of 270 and 540 V. In the MATLAB / Simulink environment, a simulation model of the system was created. The results of the simulation testify to its good dynamic and energy performance and output voltage converter high stabilization.

articleTitle: Personal Computer User's Activity Monitoring Software Development for the Enterprise Business Process Optimizing
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents one of the possible approaches to optimize the business processes of the enterprise by monitoring the activity of users of personal computers. Problems of existing solutions are reviewed. Open source software development for the employee time tracking is described.

Author Keywords: idle time and active time monitoring

articleTitle: Adaptation of an Inductive Energy Store on a Diesel Railway Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Is considered a conversion device that ensures matching of the characteristics of the superconducting inductive energy sources and receivers of electric energy of the traditional performance in a power unit of an Autonomous perspective of the locomotive.

articleTitle: Modern Technologies in Assessing the Quality of Medical Services in the Digital Society of Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The development of the information society of Russia has led to the use of modern Internet technologies in everyday life, which required the reaction of public authorities to the emerging trends and the adoption of a strategy for the development of the information society in the Russian Federation, proclaiming the use of new information technologies, such as social networks and information platforms in the implementation of projects to improve the availability and quality of medical services and goods as a strategic goal. The implementation of the identified strategies in the development of digital society in Russia, as well as an objective tendency of increase of consumer requirements to the medical services quality in the public and private health sectors, the growth of consumer dissatisfaction with quality of services require the implementation of tele-medicine in addition to new technologies in all activities of medical organizations, particularly in the quality control system of medical services. The marked increase in the activity of consumers of medical services in social networks and information portals is not currently used in the practice of assessing the quality of medical services. This requires responsible researches to identify the factors hindering the introduction of new technologies in the practice of assessing the quality of medical services adapted to current trends in the activity of consumers of medical services in social networks, as well as to determine the directions of work to activate patients and medical personnel in the field of evaluation and participation in decision-making, and the formulation of the goal-setting of Internet companies to develop software products for the automation of collection and processing of consumer feedback in social networks in the medical market.

Author Keywords: social networks as new technologies of assessment

articleTitle: The Device of Formation of the Width Modulated Signal on Feedback Current
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The new circuit solution of the device of formation of the width modulated signal for duple schemes of inverters of tension of pulse sources of secondary power supply where in the circuit of the generator of sawtooth tension tilt angle on a condenser charge interval on a signal to proportional current of a chain of feedback changes is considered. In this case, the duration of the pulse-width modulated signal is determined by the rate of increase of the sawtooth voltage until the reference level is reached. The simulation results showed decrease in time of restoration of a saw to the value determined by speed of a key and increase of linearity of sawtooth tension due to stability of current of a charge of the condenser.

articleTitle: Studying the Thermal and Physical Processes in the Material Surface Layer Under Ultrasonic Plastic Deforming
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article shows that ultrasonic plastic deforming possesses unique mechanical and physical characteristics that provide the creation of regular structures without local peak stresses in the surface layer material. It is proved that while studying the deformation zone that appears under ultrasonic plastic deforming it is necessary to take into consideration not only the deformation processes but also the thermal phenomena. The equation of thermal conductivity describing the development of heat transmission processes in the deformation zone when the deformer contacts the processed surface is presented. The dependence of the heat generation density on the applied action under ultrasonic deforming is obtained. The rearrangement of the thermal conductivity equation allowed obtaining the dependence that describes the temperature distribution in the deformation zone.

Author Keywords: the diameter of the plastic print

articleTitle: The Prospects for Electro Kinetic Dehydration of Wood During its Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem situation related to the drying of wood, which requires significant energy costs. To solve the problem, the traditional technology of wood drying is analyzed and the main shortcomings are identified. The use of an electro-osmotic phenomenon is proposed to remove moisture from the mass of wood, which will reduce energy consumption for wood drying.

Author Keywords: electro osmotic energy and mass transfer

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Increased Temperature Effect on Induction Motor Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper studies the effect of increased temperature on the performance of the three phase induction motor. An electrical, mechanical, and thermal model of an induction motor is used to study the change of the motor parameters. The proposed model is developed using Matlab-Simulink. The experimental work is implemented in order to investigate the effect of temperature rise on the induction machine. Simulation and experimental results were obtained to monitor the effect of increased temperature on the stator resistance, stator current, rotor speed, stator flux and motor torque at different loads.

articleTitle: Test Chip Development for Evaluation of 180 nm SiGe Integrated Circuit Technology Operation Under Cryogenic Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with designing a test chip for evaluation of cryogenic conditions operation of 180 nm SiGe integrated circuit technology process. Test chip consists of basic devices (active and passive) set and a low-frequency low-noise cryogenic operational amplifier. Some design issues and potential problems are discussed.

articleTitle: A Method for Central Frequency Phase Variations Measurements of GMSK Modulated Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents a new method that can be used for phase distortions estimating of signals with GMSK modulation. This algorithm has been tested out using GMSK and MSK model signals. The method is also applied to phase distortion variations measuring of VLF radiowaves propagating in the Earth-Ionosphere waveguide. In this paper we demonstrate a comparison of our modified algorithm and the method of phase reconstruction. The experimental results show that the suggested method has a high accuracy and signal processing speed.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Mathematical Models for the Coefficient of Conductor Resistance Increase Due to Higher Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of higher harmonic components of the alternating current (AC) on the increase of resistance of current-carrying cable cores and wires is shown. It is caused by forcing the current to the conductor surface, that is called the skin effect. The comparative analysis of various mathematical models was carried out. After that, coefficients of the increase of AC conductor resistance in relation to direct current (DC) resistance were determined. Obtained coefficients can be used for correct and reliable calculations of active power losses in electrical networks and power supply systems.

articleTitle: The System for Measuring the Speed of Movement of the Active Electrode of the Electrosurgical Unit
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The control system of the output power of the device is developed depending on the change in the speed of moving the active electrode, designed to minimize the thermal injury to tissues during electrosurgical operation. A research was made of the operability of the system and the accuracy of measuring the speed of movement of the active electrode.

articleTitle: Neural Network Load Current Observer for DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A neural network load current observer is proposed for a boost DC converter with an autotransformer. The settlement relations for producing the training data are resulted, the requirements to a set of input signals of a neural network of the observer are formulated. Additional solutions are considered that ensure an increase in the accuracy and stability of the proposed observer under conditions of asymmetry of electromagnetic processes in the autotransformer. The structure of a neural network is received and its training is conducted for a specific set of converter parameters. Modeling of the observer's work as part of the converter for various loads and supply voltage has been done. The recommendations for using of proposed observer are made.

articleTitle: The Criteria of Antenna Pattern Distortion Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the criteria for estimation of antenna pattern distortion. The criteria is based on the numerical comparison of reference and real directional diagrams and is called integral error. Threshold values of integral errors are calculated in accordance with an amplitude distribution function for summary and difference antenna pattern.

articleTitle: The Online Method of Input/Output Unified GAS Reciprocating Generation Unit in Island Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main problem of island mode operation small capacity station is maintaining active power balance. For this purpose it is necessary to determine when the enabled and disabled of generators, their number and the capacity load during dispatching control. The main technical constraint and conflicting constraints were determined. In this paper one of the methods of these contradictions removal is considered based on taken into account of the influence of static characteristic of active power from frequency for different load types. The impact estimation of frequency decrease on active power consumption was made.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Shunt Active Power Filter Based on Parallel Multilevel Inverters
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents energy quality performance evaluation of an active power filter (APF) based on parallel multilevel NPC inverters. High power energy conversion systems are usually engage modular power converter structures. They can be parallel or cascade ones. In this research it is shown that usage of parallel structure for active power filtering provides several advantages such as power sharing, improved compensation quality and efficiency. In particular, three-level NPC converters in parallel connection with interleaved PWM for APF are considered. Technical considerations of the energy quality performance are presented for more common case of k inverters in parallel. Simulation results are presented to prove the theoretical conclusions.

articleTitle: Providing the Forming Accuracy During the Electrochemical Deep Hole Drilling of a Small Diameter by the Cathode - Tool with a Complete Electro - Isolating Coating
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problems of forming deep holes with a diameter of less than 1.0 mm by the electrochemical drilling with the use of a hollow cathode-tool having a complete electro-isolating coating are considered. The limitations in providing the hole forming accuracy connected with breaking down the flow hydrodynamics in the processing zone because of decreasing the value of the side inter-electrode gap by the isolating coating thickness are determined. The interrelation between the maximum attainable depth of the hole processing in copper and the thickness of the isolating coating is found. It is proved theoretically and confirmed experimentally that there is a loss of accuracy in the hole forming at a processing depth exceeding the maximum attainable value according to the conditions of the stable anodic dissolving process.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models and Calculation of Reliability Indices of Scalable Distributed Computer Systems Under Full Restoration
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Mathematical models for calculating the reliability indices of distributed scalable computer systems are proposed. Analytical solutions are obtained for calculating the mathematical expectation and variance of the number of serviceable machines in computer systems with the complete restoration of failed machines. The solution for calculating the size of the reserve to maintain the CS in a state of high performance was obtained.

articleTitle: Design Requirements to Telecommunication Long Ethernet Twisted Pair Cable
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When implementing new information services in information and telecommunication systems, the tasks of increasing the range of IEEE 802.3 u (Fast Ethernet) network interfaces are relevant. The approach to the solution of this problem, which is based on the modernization of the symmetrical cable design, is considered. The feasibility of using U /UTP design and category 5e characteristics in such cables is substantiated. Estimates of the individual components of losses in the metal, dielectric and screen, as well as the total attenuation coefficient are presented.

articleTitle: Identification Methods for Linear Regression Based on Data of Household Budget Surveys
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article various methods for estimating the linear regression parameters in the case of errors in the explanatory variable are considered. Williamson algorithm modification is proposed. A comparison to other approaches by simulation study is made. The advantages and disadvantages of the proposed method are revealed.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation of Compressed Images Based on Prediction Errors of Pixel Values
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers metric objective quality assessment of compressed TV images based on the prediction error values of sums of pixels of the original and decoded images. The results of experimental results of processing test images by the proposed metric and mean squared error are given.

articleTitle: Thin Polymer Films for Chemical Sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the study thin films of polyimide, fullerenes, polyanilines and their derivatives are considered to create chemical sensors. Various types of chemical sensors in the form of such thin-film electronic devices as a resistor, a capacitor, and a field-effect transistor are considered. The creation of thin films was carried out by vacuum thermal deposition of aluminum from a tungsten basket and organic material from the Knudsen cell. To obtain polymer films, spin coating from solutions was also used. The dependence of the current through resistive structures on the basis of thin films of fullerenes and polyanilines on the relative humidity of air, the concentration of ammonia vapor in air and reaction time of these structures are investigated. Capacitive air humidity sensors were made with a polyimide film as a dielectric and their main characteristics were measured. The current voltage characteristics of a field-effect transistor with a transport layer of a thin film of polyaniline with different values of air humidity are measured. The results of the studies showed the promise of using thin polymer films to create chemical sensors.

articleTitle: A Determination of Optical Fibers Types on the Spectrum Profile of the Mandelstam - Brillouin Scatter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The investigation deals with the type classification of optical fiber on the reflectogram obtained by the Brillouin reflectometer. The program for determination of optical fiber type by the Brillouin reflectogram is presented. The values of Brillouin frequency shift for some optical fiber types are given. The possibility to classify optical fibers on types and manufacturers using reflectogram is of practical interest. The work was performed with the financial support of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation within the scope of the base part of a State Assignment within the sphere of scientific activity (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: Induced Voltage as a Factor Identifying Electric Safety and Cost-Effectiveness of Electrical Grid Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Technical and economic provisions are considered to enable the electrical injury to be sharply reduced or entirely eliminated when electrical installations are operated under the induced voltage. The possibility of getting by the utility the additional income based on the induced voltage measurements and electrical injury decrease is analyzed in details.

articleTitle: Calibration of GLONASS Measuring Station with a Parabolic Antenna in the Part of a Pseudorange Bias
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research describes the method of calibration corrections obtaining in the part of pseudorange bias for navigation receiver from receiving and measuring station following GLONASS signals with the use of a parabolic antenna. Calibration of navigation receiver is performed with regard to the antenna reference point of the parabolic antenna. The work offers an algorithm of definition of a parabolic ANTENNA reference point.

articleTitle: Design of Long-Haul Coherent DWDM Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers issues related to the design of high-speed long-haul coherent DWDM systems. Nonlinear noise reduces value of OSNR significantly. A method for calculating a coherent communication system is represented by a traditional OSNR estimation.

articleTitle: Constructing Skeleton Images of Integral Strain Gauge Reaction in Discrete Space
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The articles considers the matters relevant to the assessment of the reaction of integral strain gauges (ISGs) for the analysis of pressure and deformations occurring because of cyclical workload on the surface of metal constructions and machinery details. It is pointed out that the images of the reaction of ISGs can be considered as identifiable objects with vaguely defined structure. The author outlines the necessity to implement specialized algorithms for preliminary processing of ISG reaction images used for the creation of a feature space of the object in question based on the definition of geometrical and morphological parameters of an image. The article describes an algorithm of skeletization of ISG reaction images given maintained coherence. Computer realization is presented afterwards.

articleTitle: A Technique for Large-Scale 2D Seismic Field Simulations on Supercomputers
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An algorithm for the simulation of elastic wave propagation in 2D isotropic inhomogeneous media with complex geometrical structure is presented. A parallel implementation of the FDTD method of fourth order in space to perform calculations on high-performance computing systems with different architectures (CPUs, GPUs, or Xeon Phi coprocessors) is discussed. The proposed technique of mathematical modeling with the use of MPI and CUDA is used to design program codes for computations for a realistic long-distance model. Program codes for single device and multi device use are developed. A large-scale geophysical model of the Baikal rift zone is reconstructed. New synthetic data depicting the structure of the seismic field for the rift zone are presented.

articleTitle: Robust Voltage Tracking Control of Three-Phase Four-Wire Split DC Bus Inverter via Time-Scale Separation Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of controller design is investigated for a three-phase four-wire split dc bus inverter with output filters and loads. The proposed time-scale separation technique for controller design gives the possibility to achieve a high accuracy of three-phase voltage generation subject to variations of source voltages or load resistors. The discussed approach to problem of three-phase inverter controller design provides high power quality with small harmonic distortion. The efficiency of the discussed design methodology is highlighted by simulation results.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Electromagnetic Fields in Circular Waveguide with Complex Radial Ridges
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The solution of the problem of spectral electrodynamic analysis of a circular waveguide with radial metal ridges and with thin flanges is presented. The calculation algorithms of cutoff wave numbers and components of electromagnetic fields of TE- and TM -waves are developed on the basis of the partial regions method taking into account field singularity at metal ridges. The spectral characteristics of the waveguide are investigated. The visualization of electromagnetic fields patterns of the dominant and higher order modes is realized.

articleTitle: Influence of a Reflected Emission Level on Signal Formation in Autodynes with Oscillation Frequency Stabilization
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Calculations and analysis of amplitude and frequency responses are performed for oscillators stabilized by the additional high-Q resonator. The distinguished features of the autodyne response formation are presented for weak and strong reflected emission from the radar target. It is shown that the main reason of autodyne response distortions in the case of strong reflected emission is an anharmonic of variation of the resistive and reactive components of the complex load conductivity as well as the nonlinearity of frequency functions of resistive and reactive components of the oscillating system.

articleTitle: The Asynchronous Motor Start Calculation with the Motor Soft Starter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article a modification of the algorithm for calculating currents and torques during a soft start and automating the processing of a calculation data array is considered for a concrete example of an asynchronous motor.

articleTitle: The Calculation of the Intensity of Rain Causing Digital Communication Failure Through the Atmospheric Channel
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The performance of an open communication channel is determined by the propagation medium. If the propagation medium is different from the free space (outer space), the structure of the electromagnetic wave is distorted. These distortions are determined by the interaction of the wave with the inhomogeneities of the medium. Atmospheric distortions in the optical range have a different character. Amplitude and spatial effects are observed. Amplitude effects are manifested in the form of temporal changes in the field, leading to a decrease in power, power fluctuations, and frequency filtering of radiation. Spatial effects are manifested in the form of a change in the direction of propagation or distortion of the beam in a direction transverse to the front of the wave. The results of calculating the maximum precipitation intensity for various values of the modal radius of raindrops leading to disruption of the connection are given.

articleTitle: Band Vocoder Modification Based on Khurgin-Yakovlev Representation and Fienup Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A band vocoder modification based on Khurgin- Yakovlev representation and the use of Fienup algorithm is considered. It is shown that the application of these algorithms makes it possible to improve the quality of reconstructed speech signal at the output of a strip vocoder by 1 point in accordance with GOST R 50840-95, ensuring the quality at the level of 4 ... 4.2 points at transmission speed of 4.8 kbit / s.

articleTitle: Development of Classification Methods Based on Cumulative Curves Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with cumulative curve splitting as one of classification methods. Parameterization selection problem for cumulative curve fitting is addressed. The most relevant parameterizations are determined for different distribution functions of initial data. Cumulative curve splitting approaches are compared.

articleTitle: 3-D Modelling of Marine Electromagnetic Technologies Taking into Account Induced Polarization
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the mathematical models for calculating 3-D electromagnetic fields and 3-D induced polarization fields in marine electromagnetic technologies using arbitrary-oriented galvanic electrical lines. The mathematical modeling is performed for the perspective but poorly studied technology of marine electrical prospecting in which the vertical source and receiver are used. The numerical results, which demonstrate how the distortion in the source and receiver verticality influences the electromagnetic signal measured by this technology, are presented. Additionally, the induced polarization effect on the measured signal is analyzed. The approach to designing a field experiment for this technology is proposed.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Measurement Devices and Tools
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper a method of computer modeling of measurement devices and instruments is described. A software package for virtual laboratory creation is developed. Models of measurement devices have user interface identical to real devices and can simulate the behavior of various devices. The created models of virtual measurement devices can be implemented for experimental data analysis provided in common used format *.s2p.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Ultra Wide Band Communication System in Terms of Data Rate Dependency and Sampling Rate Dependency of an Indoor Wireless Channel Impulse Response
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A work represents the investigation of an influence of indoor channel impulse response characteristics of bit error rate performance of Ultra Wide Band communication systems. The bit error rate dependency on a data rate and a sampling rate of an indoor channel impulse response is estimated. The applied MATLAB model in the exploration is described.

Author Keywords: indoor ultra wide band channel model

articleTitle: Counter of Transformer Resource at Non-Symmetric Load Phase
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The intellectual microprocessor system of control and registration of a resource of isolation of windings of a transformer for each hour, days, month is offered. The program of the meter-recorder provides for the calculation of the heating process of the winding and the wear rate of the insulation, taking into account the ambient temperature and the dependence of the active resistance of the transformer windings on the heating temperature.

Author Keywords: intensity of wear of isolation of
the active resistance of the winding. - Example

articleTitle: Motion Registration on a Protected Object in Absence of a Person with a Device with Wi-Fi Adapter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main purpose of this work is development of a system for motion tracking of a person without a device with Wi-Fi module on a protected object. A number of measurements and experiments were made to analyze the dependence of the signal level change at different positions of person in premises and with different numbers of people. In the paper an approach to register unauthorized access to the object is considered, its advantages and disadvantages are given. The issue of traffic registration on an object and its protection against unauthorized access remains relevant. In many buildings corporate and public WI-FI networks function properly, it is proposed to use the already deployed infrastructure to identify presence of people in the room and their location. There is no doubt that it is more cost-effective to install a separate access control system. Due to rapid development of WI-FI technology and the need of organizations to monitor movement of people in protected premises, the issue of registering traffic on an object with the help of WI-FI is becoming more relevant. The results of experiments on recording motion using the deployed Wi-Fi infrastructure are given in this article.

articleTitle: The Novel Center-End-Fed Dipole-Like Antenna
