publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The modified waveguide-fed dipole-like aerial is presented and analyzed by the method of induced electromotive forces. To excite the arms of an aerial the two equivalent-magnitude and in-phase excitations are created by using the standard circular waveguide. Since the area around the radiating arms is free of any conductors (with exception of an infinite ground plane), the proposed aerial is characterized by high polarization purity of radiation. Such a radiator may be used as the building block in the manufacturing of any arrays as well as for the radar mounted on a small missile warhead. The proposed aerial is also a suitable candidate for mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Cyclic Electromagnetic Drive Design with respect to Heating Transient Process
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New design relations have been derived from the allowable heating condition for a cyclic impact electromagnetic drive with respect to temperature exceeding in the heating transient process. The regulation curve design procedure is considered for a two-coil cyclic impact electromagnetic machine in the short-time mode.

articleTitle: Resources of Developing Hi-Tech Spheres in Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article authors analyze resources of developing hi-tech spheres in Russia. On the base of Cobb-Douglas specification authors show interdependence between gross domestic product, investment in basis capital, average annual number of employees of enterprises and organizations, internal current expenses for scientific research and development, number of employees that are assigned to R&D, activity of postgraduate training programs and doctoral studies, relative share of innovational goods, works and services in gross amount of goods, works and services.

articleTitle: Research Characteristics of Mandelstam - Brillouin Scatter Spectrum in the Polarization Maintaining Fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of experimental researches of characteristics of the Mandelstam - Brillouin scatter spectrum in the polarization maintaining single-mode fibers are presented in this work. Reflectograms obtained by BOTDR are given. Analysis of the experiment results revealed significant dependence differences of the polarization maintaining fibers from the same dependences of others optical fiber types. The work was performed with the financial support of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation within the scope of the base part of a State Assignment within the sphere of scientific activity (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: Operation Characteristics of LED Filament Bulbs
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The experimental results showed the characteristics of LED filament bulbs for a long-term operation. The reduction of luminous flux and luminous efficacy was determined during a 10 000-hour operation. Radiation spectra of the lamp in the wavelength range from 400 nm to 750 nm were measured before and after 10 000 hours of work. A built-in device was tested by switching it on and off. Experimental findings revealed 31 % decrease of luminous flux and 35 % luminous efficacy. The blue component of the LED lamp spectrum, chip radiation, in relation to the phosphor emission spectrum, increased by 0,25 relative units in contrast to the initial spectrum and the change was 41 0/0. While testing the power device of the lamp, the numbers of cycles reached 19440 without the efficiency loss that is in accordance with the standard GOST R 54815 - 2011, 38,9 thousand hours of service life at least. Moreover, the lamp samples were tested to find out their operating life at high ambient temperature of 45°C for 1000 hours. In addition, the luminous flux decreased by 2,5 % in contrast with its value before the experiment.

articleTitle: Experimental Installation for the Investigation of the Influence of the Methods of Feeding on the Relative Humidity of Capillary-Porous Materials with the Built-In Software
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the peculiarities of management of the processes of hydrothermal treatment (humidification, drying, wet-heat treatment) of capillary-porous materials, including crops under conditions of low pressure (vacuum). In traditional technologies, only one of the above-mentioned processes is provided in specialized installations, during which the temperature or pressure [1,2] are controlled separately, if the process takes place in a sealed chamber., and these parameters are controlled., first of all., based on the requirements of safe operation of the installations. In the considered experimental setup it is possible to perform in parallel-sequential processes of humidification, drying., wet-heat treatment under reduced pressure (vacuum) [3,4]. In this set-up with integrated program management monitored and regulated not the individual parameters - temperature and pressure, and their interrelation, which characterize the condition of the working environment of steam under reduced pressure. The temperature sensors T and pressure P are connected to the computer, where their readings are compared with the program [5], which reflects the dependence P=f(T) for the state of the working environment of each process [6]. In the event of misalignment parameters (pressure and temperature) that characterize the condition of the working medium in the chamber, a signal is supplied to the solenoid valve control, which, actuating, ensures the flow of portions of water in the steam generator, located at the bottom of the working chamber, before the onset of harmonization between the indicators of T and P. When drying., the temperature rise is ahead of the pressure increase and the water portion is not required., so the temperature level of the resulting dry steam is maintained.

articleTitle: Influence of the Output Resistance of Measurement System to I-V Characteristics of Gunn Diodes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is noted that there are significant distortions in the measured current-voltage characteristics of Gunn diodes presented in the literature: self-heating effects and/or smoothing of the discontinuity in the current-voltage characteristic. It is indicated that the self-heating effects are eliminated at the short-pulse measurement of the I-V characteristics, but such measuring systems, as a rule, have an output resistance that comparable (or greater) to the resistance of a Gunn diode. It is shown that an increased output resistance of the measuring system leads to a smoothing of the discontinuity in the I-V curve. A requirement for the output impedance of the meter based on the permissible distortion of the I-V characteristics is establish.

articleTitle: Impact of Mismatch on Microwave Power Dividers Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the impact of mismatch in microwave transmission lines on the parameters of power dividers is researched. Equations for evaluation of the difference in the power division factors in comparison with the matched mode are obtained. The analysis allows to establish the allowable requirements for the mismatch. The analysis was carried out on scattering matrices and the loaded N-port network matrices.

articleTitle: Parametric Automation of a Two-Speed Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents a model of parametric control of an induction motor due to separation of the stator windings into two independent groups. The calculation of mechanical characteristics in the limiting modes of operation is given. The vector diagram of currents and flux linkages of a two-speed asynchronous motor is presented.

articleTitle: Using HYB Sparse Matrix Storage Format for Solving Linear Systems Obtained by FEM Discretization on GPU
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we consider the use of the CSR and the HYB sparse matrix storage formats in application to matrix vector multiplication to solve three dimensional (3D) problems of geoelectromagnetism on a graphics processing unit (GPU). The subroutines for both complex- and real- valued sparse matrix-vector multiplication in the CSR and the HYB formats were implemented and parallelized on a graphics processing unit. The programs developed were verified on linear systems with large sparse matrices that were obtained by solving a forward magnetotelluric problem with the finite element method. We present the investigation results on how bandwidth affects the matrix-vector multiplication time for matrices in the HYB format. We compare computational time of matrix-vector multiplication for large sparse matrices stored in the HYB format with the same operations on matrices in the CSR format. It was done for both complex- and real-valued matrices. Experiments showed that acceleration by 20-25 percent can be achieved using the HYB format for real-valued matrices in comparison to the CSR with the parallelization on graphics processing unit NVIDIA Tesla C2075.

articleTitle: Researching of Heat Consumption Influence at Generator Unit Load in Cogeneration System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In recent years, there is an increasing attention to distributed generation in Russia. Distributed generation power systems often use cogeneration (combined heat and power generation) technology. In this paper, the influence of heat consumption at generating equipment loading in cogeneration system is investigated. As an example of cogeneration system, the distributed generation object using gas piston units is taken. In the course of the research, it was found that fuel use efficiency can be increased due to connection the cogeneration plant to the system. Connection to the system allows to vary the generated active power thereby changing the generation of heat energy through cogeneration and to reduce the fuel costs of the station. Also, in the course of the research it was found that the coefficient of fuel utilization is directly proportional to the power loading of cogeneration equipment and is inversely proportional to the number of operating generators. With the correct optimization and connection to the system, it is possible to improve various indicators, including more efficient use of fuel at the station, which in turn will reduce costs and emissions into the earth's environment.

articleTitle: Adaptive System for Automatic Control of Output Effort of Electromagnetic Sausage-Filler
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A promising direction in the development of machines for filling sausage meat is the use of a pulsed power electric drive, which is based on an engine with a linear trajectory of motion of the working member. In this case, the use of a linear electromagnetic engine is preferable due to the simplicity of design, small dimensions, reliability in operation, determined by the absence of excitation windings, relatively high specific parameters. To maintain the output parameters of an electromagnetic sausage-filler with a linear electromagnetic engine (pressure, speed of movement of the filling piston), it is necessary to provide a variation in the output force. In most known electromechanical pulse systems with linear electromagnetic engines powered from alternating current sources, the control of the output tractive force is provided by varying the duration of the voltage supply pulse. The voltage level of the supply pulse is not regulated and limited by the values of the line or phase voltage of the power supply. The article proposes a system using a programmable logic controller and a strain gauge as a feedback element, which makes it possible to smoothly move the armature of a linear electromagnetic engine with simultaneous automatic correction of the output traction force depending on the change in load parameters.

articleTitle: Mutual Coupling Effect of Adaptive Antenna Array on Wave-Slowing Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive antenna array on wave-slowing structure was presented. The antenna elements mutual coupling of the adaptive array was investigated. In the article the problems of obtaining the minimum difference of amplitude and phase characteristics at the upper hemisphere are considered. The impact of hexagonal wave-slowing structure on the nonidentity of antenna element characteristics was investigated at several frequency bands. Moreover, the problem of reducing multipath was considered.

articleTitle: Compact Printed Yagi Antennas with Monopole Driver
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the printed Yagi antenna with the monopole driver designed at the working frequency of f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>=9.3 GHz is considered. The presented antenna has small weight and dimension indicators, at the same time possesses acceptable characteristics of matching and also an acceptable form of the directional pattern. By results of a research schedules of the module of reflection coefficient of the antenna and also the 3D directional pattern of the antenna at the central frequency of f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>=9.3 GHz are received.

articleTitle: On the Errors Arising from the Use of Discrete Surface Models for Land Clutter Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper analyzes influence of a discrete model of reflective features of the earth surface on the error of echo signal simulation. It is shown that the discreteness leads to the errors in calculating a power of the signal simulated. An evaluation of the error level and its dependence to the discretization step is obtained. The requirements to the sampling period determining the adjusted error level are presented.

articleTitle: Reduction of the Matrix Polynomial Decomposition of the Transfer Function to a Coprime form Using the Sylvester Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Is considered bringing of the matrix polynomial decomposition of the transfer function of the object to a coprime form. Violation requirements coprime decomposition leads to the appearance in the same roots “numerator” and “denominator” as in single-channel systems and in multi-channel systems. To check on the relatively coprime compiled of the system of linear homogeneous equations: in other words, a matrix of Sylvester and the desired matrix vector of the “elements” coprime decomposition.Then, using the [q,r]=qr(R) command of the Matlab package, where R is the Sylvester matrix, the linearly dependent columns are checked in the direction from left to right. If the diagonal elements of r are non-zero, then the original polynomial matrices are coprime, and if there are zeros on the diagonal, we look for the right coprime polynomial matrices. Is proposed an algorithm for calculating a coprimedecom-position is presented and one example illustrating algorithm.

Author Keywords: left and right matrix polynomial decomposition

articleTitle: Unitary Transformations in the Problem of Modal Control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of modal control consisting in assigning the spectrum of a closed system has long been known and well studied. But the problem of choice of eigenvalues still remains an open topic for researches. In this paper we propose a method for choosing the eigenvalues of a closed system. The selection criteria is the minimization of control resources. The proposed approach based on unitary transformations of closed system and conversion to a complex space.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis of Multiport ConverterOperation Modes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Multi-portconvertersareusedinspacecraft where an important criterion is the weight and size indicators. Inthispapertopologyofmulti-port converter, which ensurerequired work modes isproposed. Mathematical analysis of electromagnetic processes was conductedand dependences of the output voltage and current of the battery were obtained.

articleTitle: Numerical Determination of the Effective Elasticity Tensor of an Heterogeneous Solid
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Today, the computation of the effective characteristics is of great interest due to the development of new materials. In this paper, we consider the numerical method based on the heterogeneous multiscale finite element method with polyhedral supports to determination the effective elasticity tensor of three-dimensional objects with the complex internal structure. We obtained that the numerical homogenization results are in the good agreement with the analytical formulas. However, the method based on the heterogeneous multiscale finite element method allows us to solve effective characteristics for very complex material.

articleTitle: The Novel Reentrant Devices and Related Reduced Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The novel reduced networks on a base of the nontraditional reentrant structures are proposed. By properly choosing their parameters, it is possible to create the versions of the devices those have suitable range of input voltage standing-wave ratio (VSWR) performance and transfer functions. Prototype of one of these devices has been successfully realized on a standard printed circuit board implementation. The proposed devices with the modified reentrant structures are suitable candidates for mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Modification of Daugman's Integrodifferential Operator Using Bresenham's Algorithm for Iris Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed Daugman's integrodifferential operator which is used for iris localization. The several problems meeting at operator's implementation stage are considered in detail. One of these problems is selecting a step size for the numerical integration. We have presented examples of cases when using large step size leads to localization error. The detailed analysis of such examples is provided. The issues with a computational efficiency appear when using too short step. To increase the efficiency, we have proposed the method based on Bresenham's algorithm for computation of operator's integral part. Adaptation of Bresenham's algorithm allowing to compute operator in separate arcs has been proposed. The algorithm uses only integer-based arithmetic which improves the speed and accuracy. A high speed of the proposed method in comparisons with the conventional one has been confirmed.

articleTitle: Third Order (m, k)-Method for Solving Stiff Systems of ODEs and DAEs
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The Cauchy problem for stiff systems of ODEs unresolved with respect to derivative arises in electrical engineering, chemical kinetics and other important areas. Authors derived an L-stable (5, 3)-method for solving the first index systems of DAEs. An algorithm of the alternating integration stepsize based on this method is formulated. The algorithm allows freezing the Jacobian matrix of the system to be solved. Numerical results confirming the efficiency of the new algorithm are given.

articleTitle: Overhead Power Transmission Lines Economic Efficiency Diagnostic Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The overhead power transmission line diagnostics is a part of a current production operation of electric grid company. The list of diagnostic types has to be developed on the basis of technical and economic factors. The solution of technical tasks is primary, and the additional diagnostic types should be used if the cost advantages are available. One of the assessment methods for overhead power transmission line diagnostics is described in the paper. The assessment technique for overhead power transmission lines economic efficiency diagnostics is considered and its cost advantages calculation is given.

articleTitle: Phased Array Antenna Element for Active Magnetic Positioning System Based on Semiconductor Hall-Effect Sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The purpose of the work is to develop Hall-effect sensors and to test their capability to receive pulsed magnetic fields of subnanosecond range. The magnetic field sensors under investigation were manufactured from GaAs layers on semi-insulating substrate by means of vapor phase epitaxy and molecular beam epitaxy. On the base of the existent HSs without any additional signal processing, it is possible to create active magnetic positioning system with the range of 1 meter. To increase the range up to several meters, the quantity of phased-array antenna elements can be increased and signal accumulation can be used.

Author Keywords: pulsed magnetic fields of subnanosecond range

articleTitle: On Usage of Neuromorphic Engineering in Autonomous Robots
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the opportunities and problems of using neuromorphic engineering in intelligent autonomous robots. The digital and digital-analog kinds of neurochip architecture for usage in robotics are discussed, in particular, three kinds of digital architecture: hard architecture, flexible architecture and growth architecture of neural networks.

articleTitle: The Development of the Subject Domain Observation Complex for Management Purposes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of ontological designing of complex objects in an organized and socioeconomic activity is proposed. It has a practical application in the activities of air transport complexes. To meet the challenge of the development monitored metrics objects we completed an analysis of the main provisions of measure theory, logic and philosophy. The method was used to develop shell expert and automated decision-making systems for human resources management, social groups and organizations.

articleTitle: The Vibrational Method for Studying Acoustooptic Interaction at Infralow Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the processes of acoustooptic interaction at infralow frequencies are studied usingseismic vibrators as sources of low-frequency acoustic oscillations propagating in the atmosphere and laser measurement lines as optical receivers of oscillations. The source and receiver types being proposed to investigate the acoustooptic interaction determine the novelty and originality of the approach. The results of experiments for estimating the characteristics of the acoustooptic interactionat infralow frequencies are presented.

articleTitle: Selection of Methods for Filtering the Signal when Measuring at Coordinate Measuring Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The actual tasks of surface metrology are the control of the production process and the optimization of the operation of the workpieces. An important problem in the processing of measurement information is the filtration of the received signal. Known methods and standards are considering only the processes of measuring roughness and roundness. Therefore, we carried out studies on the applicability of filtration methods in the general case for coordinate measurements. The article presents an overview of the filters that have received the greatest application in other fields of technology. Based on the review, a filtering strategy has been developed for coordinate measurements. We recommend the following sequence: elimination of gross errors based on the Grubbs test, discrete Fourier transform for revealing systematic errors, minimization of a random error with the help of a bilateral Gaussian filter, surface reconstruction after filtering based on the inverse Fourier transform. The proposed filter sequence was tested in the plane measurement and confirmed the high efficiency of minimizing the random component of the signal.

articleTitle: Noise Immunity of Reception of Signals with Code Division in Hydroacoustic Channels
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of noise immunity of reception of broadband (noise-like) signals in hydroacoustic channels is carried out taking into account interference of the traditional CDMA system (Code Division Multiple Access) and ZCZ-CDMA (ZCZ-Zero Correlation Zone) technology under conditions of multi-path (multi-beam) signal propagation. The gain in noise immunity is shown when using ZCZ-codes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Educational Data in the Decision-Making Support System of University
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper shows that the analysis of educational data for the improvement of business processes in the university is one of the modern trends in the education system. Some directions and results of research in the field of educational data analysis, which were conducted using data from the NSTU Information System, are presented. The data that are useful for administrative decision-making for educational process and other areas of university's activities to be improved by the university administration were obtained because of research. Used in the research the proprietary data cleaning software, as well as the subsystem of report storage and delivery was proposed.

articleTitle: Building a Quality System for an Electronic Component Base for High-Tech Industries
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main aspects of quality assurance for the electronic component base (ECB) installed in the flight samples of space vehicles are considered. It is shown that the homogeneity analysis of ECB batches is now becoming a vital task, especially for ECBs with a high level of integration. The economic justification for creating special batches as a way of centralizing the equipment of space vehicles on the principle of equal reliability is given.

articleTitle: A Phase Shifter Based on Trans-Directional Coupler with DC Isolation of RF-Path and Control Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Novel reflection type phase shifter schematic and design based on trans-directional coupler with DC isolation of RF-path and control circuit are proposed. The coupler is implemented as a 3-D vertically installed planar structure. Analog phase shifter prototype using GaAs varactor diodes operates over a 3.5 to 5.3 GHz (40<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) band and allows obtaining controllable phase shift of 0-65° with 0.15 dB amplitude variation at 4.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Assessment of Output Voltage Quality of Three-Phase Multilevel Inverter with Nearest Vector Selecting Space Vector Control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the nearest vector selecting space vector control (SVC) of any arbitrary MLVSI circuit with any arbitrary number of the equal feeding DC voltage levels. The linear mode LabView model for the SVC digital controller is designed in two variants of the reference signals sampling. The MLVSI output voltage THD and integrated voltage harmonics factors (IHF), needed for computing of the load circuit voltages and currents and their quality indices, are estimated as functions of the sampling frequency index).

Author Keywords: integer and fractional parts of delta voltages relative values

articleTitle: Digital Pulse-Width Modulator with Asynchronous Change of Compare Register Value and Short Delay Time
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of signal delay time in implementation of digital pulse-width modulators (DPWM). The paper demonstrates that the most essential component of delay time in a digital modulator is the time required for implementation of DPWM, and that it is almost always understood that the DPWM is a type 1 PWM. It is shown that the maximum delay time in such approach to DPWM implementation within the range cannot be less than one PWM conversion period. A new approach to DPWM implementation is proposed, suggesting an increase of the number of signal measurements within a PWM period and an asynchronous change of the compare register value in the digital comparator. Signal delay in the proposed DPWM is reduced <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> times, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> is the number of signal measurements within a PWM period. The proposed approach essentially results in implementation of a DPWM as a type 2 PWM.

Author Keywords: Digital control systems for switching converters

articleTitle: Time Series Compression in Telecommunication Systems for Environmental Monitoring of Polluting Emissions
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The structure of adaptive automated telecommunication system of ecological monitoring is described, which provides collection, processing and forecasting of concentration levels of toxic, explosive and polluting emissions of industrial enterprises. A developed algorithm for compressing time series of pollutant concentrations with data processing based on wavelet decomposition is presented. Results of its modeling by software are given.

articleTitle: Development Platform for Controlling the Infrastructure of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work presents a technology for remote monitoring and control of devices connected to the Internet. The architecture of the platform is proposed, which allows automating the process of monitoring and management. A prototype with an example of functioning was developed and demonstrated. This work was supported by RFBR grant No-16-37-00240.

articleTitle: Up-to-Date Thermal Imaging Systems in the Multichannel Automated Measurements
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A highly informative methodology, the essence of which is to obtain the parameters of an object under study by means of the data synchronous acquisition from several measurement channels, predominantly based on different physical principles, is described. Up-to-date infrared thermography (IRT) as a leading research tool included in such a multichannel (multimodal) measuring system is considered in some detail. The IRT-aided multichannel approach is demonstrated with studying the physiological characteristics in humans. The measurement synchronism of different technical means is realized by the computerization and automation of the experiment. The programmable microcontroller ESP32 served as main operating and readout unit. With a time resolution of 100-200 measurements per second, the experimental data were obtained. It made it possible to reveal the human physiological characteristics as follows: the extremities temperature change, pulse waves and their velocity in the radial artery, breathing dynamics, blood pressure evaluated in two different regimes of brachial cuff air filling - inflation and deflation. The brachial cuff inflation also served as external interventional impact on the organism. It is found that, after the brachial artery cross-clamping, the pulse wave velocity in the radial artery is capable of doubling in comparison with that measured before compression. It is shown that the multimodal technology is a promising means in modern experimental science.

articleTitle: Ignition Coils Quality Control Device of Internal Combustion Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is shown that the work of all nodes is interrelated, and often the failure of one of them leads to the impossibility of further movement. Conclusions are made regarding the critical components, which include the ignition coil, which forms a high voltage for the formation of a spark. Its technical condition is considered and its regular control is offered.

articleTitle: Development of High-Speed Iterative Code and Its Efficiency at Digital Signal Transfer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article, based on mathematical analysis, an algorithm for a certain noise-proof code based on repeated decoding is developed - a high-precision iterative code. To investigate this algorithm on the basis of computer simulation in the Matlab 7.0 Simulink environment, a model of a noise-immune encoding system was developed, based on parallel-cascade high-precision coding and iterative decoding. A comparative analysis for the energy gain of the algorithm with a simple Gray coding algorithm is made. The results of modeling are presented.

articleTitle: Multiscale Nonconformal Finite Element Methods for Solving Problems with Moving Boundaries
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A Stefan problem with a moving boundary in a heterogeneous two-phase medium is considered. For solving the Stefan problem, we use a discontinuous Galerkin method in a nonsymmetrical “Inner Penalty” formulation. We propose to split the problem solution into a discontinuous component in the phase transition zone and a continuous component outside the phase transition zone. A multiscale method allows to reduce a number of freedom degrees by using the discontinuous Galerkin method in the phase transition zone only. Results of solving the two-phase Stefan problem in the medium with ice and water regions are presented.

articleTitle: Analytical Research of Electromagnetic Processes in Direct Current Starter-Generator System «Synchronous Generator with Combined Excitation Active Rectifier» (Generation Mode)
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The electromagnetic processes in the system with synchronous generator with the combined excitation for the parametric control of the excitation current are considered. Proposed three scenarios for the design of such system and control methods of flux linkage of winding of excitation. The possible modes of operation of the system are identified. The comparison of three scenarios of system design is carried out.

articleTitle: Water Heaters and Installations with Infrared Radiators when Complex Waveform Current Supply
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The development of effective modes for low-voltage electrode water heaters associated with the need for more advanced technical means of electric water heating for individual processes and for installations with infrared radiators is relevant. The article presents the results of experimental researches of the influence of electric mode with complex waveform current supply on the technological and energy parameters of the installations. The purpose of the work is research of the temperature fields of dark radiators and low-voltage electrode water heaters when changing the parameters of electrical modes (frequency spectrum and voltage amplitude) to develop recommendations for the selection of effective modes of operation of the units. The influence of the electromagnetic component, along with the temperature, on the processes of water heating and the parameters of infrared radiators is established: it is proved that the value of the power factor of the installations increases at the same temperature rise speed. The mode with complex waveform current supply causes the increase efficiency of the electrode water heaters and installations with infrared radiators.

articleTitle: Program for Automatic Phasing of the Currents of Transformer Differential Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes a problem with differential protection of traction substations' transformers. An algorithm for differential protection has been developed that allows determining similar phase currents on the high and low voltage sides and indicates the possible type of error for any load character. The proposed algorithm and software can be applied by any errors made during the assembly of the current circuits of differential protection. The developed software can be used as the wizard for protection engineer. The software has been developed in the MATLAB programming environment.

articleTitle: VDI Cloud Computational Resources Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: VDI Private Cloud infrastructure building issues are under the closest consideration in this article. The government facilitates foreign software substitution in favor to Russian and open-source applications, so it becomes necessary to create a single data center in every state department. This data center - should provide users with a no pportunity of remote access. VDI Private Cloud solves this problem, however, it requires estimation of computational resources amount. Estimation of server-no desforvirtualization cluster can be based on the bin packing problem algorithms. The supposed algorithm helps to find minimal number of servers for the case of peak workload.

articleTitle: Instrumentation for Testing the Possibility of Using CCD Image Sensors in Gated-Viewing Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes the instrumentation for testing undocumented possibilities of CCD image sensors. The instrumentation is a layout of a gated-viewing surveillance device that represents an optoelectronic device allowing managing its CCD image sensor with freeform signals, receiving an image and demonstrating the image to an operator. The experiments carried out at the device showed the possibility of constructing a gated-viewing system on an interline transfer CCD sensor provided that it is managed in undocumented way. Such system does not require the use of an image intensifier in its construction due to what it has smaller weight and overall dimensions comparing to classical gated-viewing devices based on an image intensifier.

articleTitle: Numerical Scheme for Modelling the Electromagnetic Field in Airborne Electromagnetic Survey Taking into Account Follow Currents in Transmitter Loop
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes a numerical scheme which makes it possible to calculate the electromagnetic signals in airborne electrical survey problems for the complex form of the current impulse and follow currents in the transmitter loop. In order to calculate the electromagnetic field, the finite element method is used. For taking into account the time-depending current, the “convolution” procedure, which is based on the piecewise constant approximation of the current function and field calculation for the current in the form of the Heaviside function, is used. The problem related to the error of this approximation, in the case when the transmitter loop is located at some altitude above the Earth surface, is discussed. The results of verifying the proposed computational scheme, comparative analysis of computational costs and analysis of the follow current effect are presented. The results of the numerical experiments show that, on the one hand, when the modeling of the airborne electromagnetic signals is performed, it is necessary to take into account the current form (including the follow current), but, on the other hand, this can be performed most accurately and with low costs by the approach proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Substantiation of Parametric Method of Melt Temperature Measurement
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental and theoretical studies on the justification of a new approach to measuring the temperature of melts using an optical fiber pyrometer are given in the paper. The paper presents an analytical review of alternative methods and means of measuring the melt temperature. Proposed from the melt using a special crucible to form a radiant cavity type model a blackbody. A functional diagram of the device measuring the temperature of the melt by the proposed method. Calculation and experimental results on the substantiation of spectral characteristics of crucible materials are presented. The experimental dependence of the absorption of quartz glass brand QI at room temperature and family dependency in the range from 500°C to 1100°C when the temperature of the radiating cavity of a blackbody from 500°C to 1100°C. On the basis of classical representations of the calculations of the coefficient of blackness of the crucible radiative model type, a blackbody given its design.

articleTitle: A Polynomial Method for Synthesizing a Two-Channel Regulator Stabilizing a Three-Mass System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of synthesizing linear multichannel regulators for multichannel objects using matrix polynomial expansion, along with classical synthesis methods, such as synthesis in the state space, using full and reduced order observers, and others, is finding increasingly widespread. In the polynomial method of synthesizing multichannel regulators, as a rule, a transition from polynomial representations to matrix numeric ones is used, which in some cases leads to equations with a degenerate Sylvester matrix. In this paper, based on the results obtained by Chen, Kailath and other authors, a detailed formalized synthesis algorithm is presented based on the formalization of algorithms for the synthesis of multichannel systems, analysis of calculations of numerous examples of multichannel regulators. The proposed algorithm allows us to find the general solution of a system of linear equations. As a result, we obtained polynomial regulator matrices containing free parameters that can be set arbitrarily. In other words, when setting free parameters of the controller, it becomes possible to obtain a variety of polynomial matrices of the “numerator” and “denominator” of the regulator, which makes it possible to provide additional properties of the automatic control system.The proposed algorithm synthesizes a two-channel regulator that stabilizes the three-mass system and provides exactly the desired characteristic polynomial matrix of the system.

Author Keywords: algorithm for synthesis of multichannel regulators

articleTitle: Noise Stability of Adaptive Reception OFDM - Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of an diversity fading OFDM signals receiving interference immunity, considering the finite channel parameters changing speed is processed. Showed that in case of slow-fading (to OFDM symbol length) signals the diversity receiving with pilot signals training is ensuring the insignificant error rate loss comparing to optimal reception.

articleTitle: Signal Models in Telecommunication Systems of Audio Exchange in Conditions of Acoustic Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers models and methods for estimating signals during the transmission of information messages in telecommunication systems of audio exchange. One-dimensional probability distribution functions that can be used to isolate useful signals and acoustic noise interference are presented. An approach to the estimation of the correlation and spectral functions of the parameters of acoustic signals is proposed, based on the parametric representation of acoustic signals and the components of the noise components. The paper suggests an approach to improving the efficiency of interference cancellation and highlighting the necessary information when processing signals from telecommunications systems. In this case, the suppression of acoustic noise is based on the methods of adaptive filtering and adaptive compensation. The work also describes the models of echo signals and the structure of subscriber devices in operational command telecommunications systems.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Probability of a Symbolic Error in the Rice Channel
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article considers the Rice channel. This channel is used for signal propagation in urban conditions. For consideration, the communication channel is approximated in real conditions of signal propagation in the system. The main performance indicator of any communication system is investigated and calculated - the probability of error. Note that the probability of error is bit and character. In this article, we are talking about the probability of a symbolic error in the propagation of a signal over a communication channel. Estimating the values of the symbolic error, it is possible to conclude that the communication channel is immune to interference. In this paper, we calculated the probability of a symbol error with three different types of modulation, and plotted the dependencies of the error probability on the signal-to-noise ratio. The probability of error from the signal-to-noise ratio, demonstrated on the graphs, allows us to determine the dependence of the symbol error probability on the modulation factor M, and also allows us to draw conclusions about the use of one of the modulation methods for efficient operation of the communication channel. Efficiency and productivity of the communication channel are the main indicators that should be paid attention. An increase in the data transfer rate is an important criterion of the communication system.

articleTitle: Current Source and Voltage Reference for Broadband Receiver in BiCMOS 130 nm
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In developing the broadband receiving systems much it pays great attention to the noise path properties. It is also important to ensure the stabilization of DC modes in the required temperature range. The source of the reference currents and voltages greatly influences on thermal stability of the entire system, in addition, it affects the noise properties of the amplifying stages. The article compares the schemes of obtaining reference currents by the criterion of thermal stability, noise properties, and also resistance to technological dispersion. Article described the current source and voltage reference circuit, optimized by the criterion of the lowest noise level. The thermal stability of the voltage reference is 34.64 ppmJ°C and 26.37 ppmJ°C of the current source, the PSRR is -19.6 dB in the frequency range 0.1 ... 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of the Onboard Radioelectronic Equipment Thermal State in the Unpressurized Compartment of the Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A mathematical model of the aircraft avionics thermal state describing the heat exchange of the on-board equipment housing with a honeycomb structure made of a carbon fiber composite, the process of heat transfer of the onboard equipment elements and the air is developed. The considered heat transfer process in a heterogeneous medium is described by the boundary value problem for the heat equation with boundary conditions of the third kind. To solve the direct problem of the on-board equipment housing honeycomb structure thermal state, the Monte Carlo method on the basis of the probabilistic representation of the solution in the form of a diffusion process functional expectation is used. The inverse problem of the honeycomb structure heat exchange is solved by minimizing the function of the squared residuals weighted sum using an iterative stochastic quasigradient algorithm. The developed mathematical model of the on-board equipment in the unpressurized compartment thermal state was used for optimizing the temperature and airflow of the thermocontrol system of the blown on-board equipment in the unpressurized compartment of the aircraft.

articleTitle: Reception of Signals with Code Division in Hydroacoustic Channels
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of using noise-like signals with a zero correlation zone (ZCZ - Zero Correlation Zone) in multipath (multi-beam) hydroacoustic communication channels is investigated. The report synthesizes adaptive algorithms for receiving noise-like signals in hydroacoustic channels with multipath (multi-beam) signal propagation.

articleTitle: Analysis Method for Transient Single-Phase Fault Removal on EHV Transposed Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper some aspects of single-phase auto-reclosing on EHV transposed lines equipped four-legged shunt reactors are discussed. It is shown that the proper representation of the actual line transposition should be adopted to determine the recovery voltage and secondary arc current. When balanced transmission line model is used the real mutual capacitances and inductances are replaced by average values, which will result in lower secondary arc current values than those that will actually occur. This common practice should be avoided. Additionally a mitigation procedure based on four-legged shunt reactors and switched capacitor banks is presented.

articleTitle: Theoretical Basis of Entropy in Determining the Homogeneity of the Composite Material Used in the Agro- Industrial Sector
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Typically, a composite material based on butyl rubber with a different electroconductive layer is used for heaters. Carbon black is considered as an example of electroconductive layer in the article. The determination of the homogeneity of carbon black in the distribution of butyl rubber is still an actual task. The uniformity of temperature on the surface of the composite heater depends directly on the uniformity of carbon black, the higher the homogeneity of carbon, the lower the resistivity of the material. The authors developed an information-entropy method that is based on the theory of probability and the concept of entropy to determine the homogeneity of the material. This study clearly demonstrates that the use of the information-entropy interval is more expedient for estimating the homogeneity (carbon black) in a composite material, since it has higher informativeness, mathematically justified, easy to use and universal (can be used for any distribution law).

articleTitle: The Effect of Terrain Model Discreteness on the Errors of Land Clutter Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses the errors of echo signal models arising from a discrete representation of the reflective properties of the earth surface. The dependence of the modeling error on the sampling interval is obtained for the covers, the reflectivity of which is a piecewise function. The common dependence is concretized for the reflectivity defined by a piecewise linear function. Special attention is given to the determination the maximum error for the case in which an antennas cans a transition from one land cover to another.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet Range Waves in the Spectrum of Biologically Active Areas Induced Radiation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Authors have formulated the hypothesis about existence of ultraviolet range waves in the spectrum of the biologically active areas induced (stimulated) radiation. The results of the investigations proving the hypothesis are presented. It is revealed that the ultraviolet range waves can be observed during information transfer from one biologically active point to another, provided both points reside on the same meridian, when one of the points is optically stimulated.

Author Keywords: ultraviolet range of the stimulated radiation spectrum

articleTitle: Models of Measuring Signals in Automatized Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: As a real way of estimating dynamic errors, the representation of measured signals as stationary random processes can be used. It is shown that the measured signals of petrochemical and chemical-technological processes can be described using a stochastic model that takes into account the random component according to the normal distribution and the harmonic component. This statement was subjected to verification based on the parameters of the petrochemical technological processes that were obtained as a result of measurements taken from the rectifying tower. The statistical parameters of the investigated processes were determined, and a correlation function was also drawn up. Hypotheses were tested on the stationary of the processes under study in accordance with their mathematical expectation and dispersion. The hypothesis of the random component of the proposed model was tested according to the normal distribution. t is proposed to use the apparatus of the theory of random processes to evaluate the accuracy characteristics of measuring transducers.

articleTitle: Telemetric Medical System to Support Cardiological Screening
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes a distributed medical information system that supports medical screening. It's functional provides a high patient capacity, safety, economic effectiveness and affordability. The information system uses portable cardiographs to estimate the factors of risk and generate projects intended for the prevention of cardiovascular diseases. We present the technology of collection, protected transfer and processing of data during a selective cardiological screening carried out in the Tyumen region. We demonstrate the usefulness of the method that increases the quality of patient's classification. This method uses the preliminary permanent segmentation of data considering age, gender and other features compared with the results of preliminary specified diagnosis. Our approach can be applied to the data obtained from portable (wearable) devices in screening proj ects, remote diagnosis, and preparation of specialists and carrying out medical examinations.

articleTitle: Development of the Stabilizing Algorithm for Pendulum Systems Based on Modal Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to discuss the stabilization problem of electromechanical oscillatory systems via modal synthesis technique. The use of such method is suitable only when mathematical model containing physical characteristics of real object is calculated. In this paper, objects of research are two types of model systems: torsional pendulum and horizontal spring pendulum. The regulator based on the modal synthesis was suggested to solve the problem of model high oscillation level. Such regulator with other elements of stabilizing system gave the opportunity to reach predetermined requirements of transient process quality. Simulating stabilizing system by means of Matlab Simulink integrated environment allowed us to prove that the system completes predetermined initial conditions in a required transient time.

articleTitle: A Ku-Band Foldable Reflectarray
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the present paper a possibility of constructing foldable reflectarrays was demonstrated. An elementary cell was calculated for different frequencies and incidence angles. A reflectarray was synthesized and calculated numerically. An experimental prototype having the ability of camouflaging in urban environment was designed. The reflectarray was measured by the near field scanning method. A good agreement between measured and calculated characteristics was achieved.

articleTitle: Low Noise Synchronous Drive Based on the Slotless Electric Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents theoretical studies aimed at the creation of an electric drive for the artificial heart apparatus with dimension constraints, which is different by high efficiency with low noise and vibrations. Simulation of the magnetic field of the electric motor, the electric drive and the control system was carried out using the FEMM and PSIM software products. The low noise synchronous electric drive with slotless electric motor was designed and manufactured based on the research results. Drive tests confirmed the correctness of the calculations made.

articleTitle: RFID Systems and Their Development
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The review of prospects of RFID systems is carried out and the example of some designs of antennas is given. As a result of the survey, it was found that the most attractive antenna for such systems is dipole antenna. In this work we used a traditional-shaped radiator with a cutout inside the resonator, and two bevels at two angles of the radiator, which makes it possible to make the antenna work at two frequencies (two operating ranges of Vietnam). The antenna operates in the band 866-867 and 920-921 MHz, with amplification factors of - 0.2 dB.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Control Algorithm for Induction Motor Drive of Electromechanical Unbalance Vibration Exciter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The present work is devoted to the design of the energy-efficient control algorithm for an induction motor drive of an electromechanical unbalance vibration exciter. The control law under consideration consists in maintaining the direct and quadrature components of the stator current at the same level. Such an algorithm allows to minimize the effective values of the stator phase currents. A synthesis of the control system using this algorithm was carried out on the example of the selected induction motor drive. For the comparative analysis of the results, the control system for the electromechanical unbalance vibration exciter with the similar power unit and the constant reference of the rotor flux linkage was also synthesized. The dynamic characteristics of the developed systems were calculated in the MATLAB/Simulink software package. The simulation results showed the efficiency of the developed control algorithm for the induction motor drives of the unbalance vibration exciters.

articleTitle: Diode Laser with HF Modulation of Pump Current for Rubidium Frequency Standard
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The emission spectra of a semiconductor laser with an external resonator whose length is matched with the frequency of the clock transition, when the pump current is modulated by an HF generator, were studied.

articleTitle: To the Question of Development of the Universal Model of a Three-Phase Electric Motor with the use of Computer Simulation Tools
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of development and realization of mathematical model of three-phase asynchronous electric motor with a squirrel-cage rotor are considered in this article. The peculiarity of the considered mathematical model is to provide the possibility of organizing the power supply of the stator windings of the electric motor from various sources, including, non-sinusoidal output voltages, as well as for various unbalanced voltages on each of the stator windings. It is possible to study the characteristics of asynchronous electric motors on the basis of the obtained model, while the accuracy tests are not inferior to the results of experimental studies. The mathematical model of the electric motor is realized in the environment of computer simulation Matlab Simulink, the detailed compilation of this model in blocks and their interrelation is shown. The adequacy of the developed model is verified by comparing the results obtained with the characteristics constructed using the known electric motor model.
